'Uqba ibn Nafi' erövrar Maghreb och grun: 'Uqba ibn Nafi' conquers the Maghrib and founds Kairouan
1023–1024 e.Kr.; framställningarna skilj: AD 1023–1024; accounts differ on the administrative date
1155 f.Kr., enligt Metropolitanmuseets k: 1155 BC, according to the Metropolitan Museum’s chronology
1155 f.Kr., enligt Museo Egizios daterin: 1155 BC, according to Museo Egizio’s dating
12 mars 632 f.Kr., enligt Pankeniers omr: 12 March 632 BC, according to Pankenier's conversion
1219 eller 1208 f.Kr., beroende på krono: 1219 or 1208 BC, depending on the chronology
1274 f.Kr., enligt museets kronologi: 1274 BC, according to the museum's chronology
1300–1200 f.Kr., enligt dateringen av pe: 1300–1200 BC, according to the dating of period III
1339 gäller grundandet. Templets egen hi: 1339 refers to the foundation. The temple's own history distinguishes this from the dedication in 1345.
1397 refers to the start of construction of the residence. The conversion into Rokuon-ji takes place later.
1397 gäller citadellets byggande. Posten: 1397 refers to the construction of the citadel. The entry does not date the Ho dynasty's seizure of power or all later parts of the World Heritage site.
15 mars 1079 enligt källans omräkning: 15 March 1079 according to the source's conversion
1792 f.Kr. enligt mellankronologin; äldr: 1792 BC according to the Middle Chronology; older alternatives: 1848, 1728 or 1696 BC
1800–1550 f.Kr. är den traditionella dat: 1800–1550 BC is the traditional dating of phases II–IV; the later dating in the study is 1700–1530 BC. Only the traditional model anchors the episode in 1800–1701 BC. The outer bounds combine alternatives and do not date an uninterrupted building period. The central area is laid out in phase II; the most impressive buildings are erected in phase III.
2016 års studie anger ungefär 1650–1600: The 2016 study gives approximately 1650–1600 BC for construction; BYU's 1998 institutional report on the excavation gives about 1600 BC. The complete approximate window is retained across the century boundary. It does not imply fifty years of continuous building or date the invention of the ballgame.
2200–2100 kal. f.Kr.; bredare preliminär: 2200–2100 cal BC; broader preliminary phase c. 2200–2025 BC
25 november 407 f.Kr., enligt utgåvornas: 25 November 407 BC, in the editions' conversion
26 augusti 1071 enligt källornas daterin: 26 August 1071 according to the sources' dating
32 f.Kr.: olika kalenderkorrelationer ge: 32 BC: different calendar correlations give different days
472 gäller verkets tillkomst i arkivets: 472 dates the work's composition in the archive's editorial chronology. The action takes place after Salamis in 480 BC; these years are kept distinct.
50 används som ungefärlig mittpunkt. Pal: 50 is used as an approximate midpoint. The palace image caption gives the middle of the century; the temple restoration is described separately as earlier.
547 anges uttryckligen i löptexten under: The body text explicitly gives 547 under a timeline heading marked circa 535.
57 f.Kr. är krönikans traditionella årta: 57 BC is the chronicle's traditional year. The museum guide that was read places the consolidation of royal power in the first half of the fourth century AD; that later development is not moved back in time.
580 avser återkomsten till Nobatia. Käll: 580 refers to the return to Nobatia. The source dates the onward journey to Alwa only as shortly afterwards and gives no exact year for the conversion of the entire kingdom to Christianity.
593 är den citerade institutionens dater: 593 is the cited institution's date for the accession to the regency. Later reforms are not dated to this year.
747 gäller upprorets inledning. Framryck: 747 refers to the beginning of the revolt. The advance into Iraq and the victories of 749–750 are later stages.
861; 247 AH i ministeriets redogörelse,: 861; 247 AH in the ministry account, 246–247 AH in Archnet
ANA daterar statens övertagande till 102: The ANA dates government takeover to 1023, and Lin Feng dates the Yizhou office to 1023. In a later published interview, Luo Tianyun instead gives 12 January 1024 for court approval and 1 April 1024 for official issuance. These source dates are preserved without an independent calendar conversion or a claim that every step occurred in both years.
Abbasiderna störtar umayyadernas kalifat: The Abbasids overthrow the Umayyad caliphate
Abbasidernas anhängare inleder ett uppro: Abbasid supporters begin a revolt in Merv in Khorasan in 747, using black banners as their symbol. They revolt against the Umayyads.
Abbasidernas anhängare inleder uppror i: Abbasid supporters begin a revolt in Merv
Abbasidernas styrkor besegrar umayyadern: Abbasid forces defeat the Umayyads and break their hold on the caliphate in 750. Al-Saffah had been proclaimed caliph in 749.
Abbot Suger och tillresta biskopar invig: Abbot Suger and visiting bishops consecrate the new choir of Saint-Denis on 11 June 1144 in the presence of Louis VII and Eleanor of Aquitaine. The builders have joined seven chapels around the choir and lit them through stained-glass windows.
Abd al-Rahman I blir emir i Córdoba: Abd al-Rahman I becomes emir in Córdoba
Abd al-Rahman I låter bygga Córdobas sto: Abd al-Rahman I commissions the Great Mosque of Córdoba
Abd al-Rahman III grundar Madinat al-Zah: Abd al-Rahman III founds Madinat al-Zahra
Abd al-Rahman III låter bygga Madinat al: Abd al-Rahman III has Madinat al-Zahra built as a new capital for the caliphate. He chooses a site west of Córdoba, by the Sierra Morena. Archaeologists give 936 or 940 for the foundation.
Abd al-Rahman III utropar sig till kalif: Abd al-Rahman III proclaims himself caliph
Abd al-Rahman III proclaims himself caliph in 929. He thereby lays claim to the title of caliph in the western part of the Muslim world.
Abd al-Rahman al-Sufi skriver en arabisk: Abd al-Rahman al-Sufi writes an Arabic catalogue of constellations in 964. He bases parts of the work on Greek models and serves as court astronomer to the Buyid ruler Adud al-Dawla.
Abstractet anger cirka 2750 kalibrerade: The abstract gives circa 2750 calibrated BC. The introduction gives the construction range 2632–2884 BC. The section on the dates describes a combined calibrated distribution for the three charcoal samples. Table 1 reports the samples' separate ranges; differences from the combined range do not in themselves demonstrate a contradiction. The source entry preserves all published sample ranges in the source's order, including the BP figures. No independent calendar conversion, harmonisation of table values or new outer limit has been made.
Abu Sa’id dör och rivaler strider om ilk: Abu Sa’id dies and rivals fight for the Ilkhanid crown
Abu Tahirs karmater angriper Mecka under: Abu Tahir's Qarmatians attack Mecca during the pilgrimage in 930. They kill pilgrims and inhabitants and take the Kaaba's Black Stone to their capital, al-Ahsa.
Acamapichtli övertar styret i Tenochtitl: Acamapichtli takes over rule in Tenochtitlan. The chronicle traditions give different years for his accession to power.
Aditya I efterträder Vijayalaya som Chol: Aditya I succeeds Vijayalaya as Chola ruler. He continues to rule until 907.
Adosadaplattformen täcker fasaden på Teo: The Adosada platform covers Teotihuacan's Feathered Serpent Pyramid façade
Aejang hör till ett kungahus med buddhis: Aejang belongs to a royal house with Buddhist temples in the capital; Hwangnyongsa was founded on an earlier king’s orders.
Aelius Gallus leder ett fälttåg mot Saba: Aelius Gallus leads a campaign against Saba
Aemilius Paulus romerska armé besegrar d: Aemilius Paulus's Roman army defeats the forces of the Macedonian king Perseus at Pydna.
Afonso av Portugal och korsfarare från n: Afonso of Portugal and crusaders from northern Europe capture Lisbon after a siege in 1147. They have agreed on booty and possessions. The chronicler describes how parts of the army loot the city and attack inhabitants after the surrender.
Agnes av Meranien ingår inte som en andr: Agnes of Merania is not included as a second wife in the list of people. The sources attest the relationship and the papal objection, but her position after the reconciliation in September 1200 remains uncertain. No later legitimations are carried back to the bookmark.
Ahmad ibn Buya går in i Bagdad utan stri: Ahmad ibn Buya enters Baghdad without a fight on 19 December 945. The caliph gives him the office of amir al-umara and the honorific title Muizz al-Dawla.
Ahmad ibn Tuluns byggare färdigställer h: Ahmad ibn Tulun's builders complete his mosque in al-Qatai in 879. Ibn Tulun pays for the building for the Muslim congregation, according to the foundation inscription.
Ahmad ibn Tuluns byggare färdigställer m: Ahmad ibn Tulun's builders complete the mosque
Ahmose I återförenar Egypten och grundar: Ahmose I reunites Egypt and founds Dynasty 18
Ahuitzotl styr från Tenochtitlan inom tr: Ahuitzotl rules from Tenochtitlan within the Triple Alliance. During his reign, the Mexica have expanded their tributary empire, in which many city-states retain their own rulers. Tlaxcala remains independent despite the contiguous area on the map. At the Templo Mayor, the Mexica venerate Tláloc and Huitzilopochtli. The sources provide no secure location for Ahuitzotl on 31 December 1500.
Airlangga dokumenterar stöd till översvä: Airlangga records support for flood-control works at Kamalagyan
Aischylos Orestien framförs för första g: Aeschylus' Oresteia is performed for the first time according to the dating Hall cites from the ancient introduction to Agamemnon.
Aischylos skildrar nederlaget vid Salami: Aeschylus portrays the defeat at Salamis through the Persian royal household and a chorus of Persian elders. The tragedy presents a recent war from the perspective of the defeated.
Aksum har blivit en makt som ingriper i: Aksum has become a power that intervenes in South Arabian wars. Inscriptions there mention the Aksumite king GDRT.
Aksum ingriper i Sydarabiens krig: Aksum intervenes in South Arabian wars
Aksum och Adulis vid Röda havet: Aksum and Adulis on the Red Sea
Aksumriket, i nuvarande norra Etiopien o: Kingdom of Aksum, in present-day northern Ethiopia and Eritrea
Aktion och Ambrakiska viken, Grekland: Actium and the Ambracian Gulf, Greece
Al-Hakim låter förstöra Gravkyrkan: Al-Hakim has the Church of the Holy Sepulchre destroyed
Al-Idrisi framställer sin världskarta vi: Al-Idrisi produces his world map at the Palermo court
Al-Idrisi framställer världskartan Tabul: Al-Idrisi produces the world map Tabula Rogeriana at the Norman court in Palermo in 1154. He combines ancient geographical knowledge with information from the Islamic world's trade routes.
Al-Mamun utser Tahir till guvernör i Kho: Al-Mamun appoints Tahir governor of Khorasan
Al-Mansur flyttar hovet till Bagdad: Al-Mansur moves the court to Baghdad
Al-Mutasim flyttar sin huvudstad till Sa: Al-Mutasim moves his capital to Samarra
Al-Mutawakkil låter bygga nilometern på: Al-Mutawakkil orders the Rawda nilometer built
Al-Walid beställer en moské i Damaskus: Al-Walid commissions a mosque in Damascus
Alauddin Khalji belägrar Chittor i Rajpu: Alauddin Khalji besieges Chittor in Rajputana. The city subsequently receives the name Khizrabad after the sultan's son.
Alauddin Khalji låter döda sin farbror J: Alauddin Khalji has his uncle Jalaluddin killed and takes power in Delhi. The preceding sultan is thereby replaced within the Khalji dynasty.
Alauddin Khalji sänder Ulugh Khan och Nu: Alauddin Khalji sends Ulugh Khan and Nusrat Khan against Gujarat. The army plunders the capital Anhilwara among other places but leaves no permanent garrison behind in this campaign.
Alberto Bueno Mendoza anger 2400 f.Kr. f: Alberto Bueno Mendoza gives 2400 BC for the rounded room at the floor level he designates 24. He describes the dating as radiocarbon with dendrochronological calibration, but reports no sample number or uncertainty range for this particular estimate. He places the construction of the southern temple complex around 2500 BC. The room's estimated dating establishes no foundation year for the entire site.
Alexander besegrar Dareios III vid Gauga: Alexander defeats Darius III at Gaugamela
Alexander besegrar Dareios III vid Issos: Alexander defeats Darius III at Issus
Alexander besegrar Poros vid Hydaspes: Alexander defeats Porus at the Hydaspes
Alexander besegrar Poros vid floden Hyda: Alexander defeats Porus at the river Hydaspes, today's Jhelum, in Punjab.
Alexander besegrar persiska satrapers ar: Alexander defeats an army of Persian satraps at the river Granicus.
Alexander besegrar persiska styrkor vid: Alexander defeats Persian forces at the Granicus
Alexander dör i Babylon. Hans erövringar: Alexander dies in Babylon. His conquests become the basis for his successors' kingdoms.
Alexander intar Tyros efter att ha byggt: Alexander takes Tyre after building a link to the island
Alexander segrar över Dareios III vid Is: Alexander defeats Darius III at Issus. The Persian king flees, and his family falls into Alexander's hands.
Alexanders död lämnar riket utan honom: Alexander's death leaves the empire without him
Alexandria grundas på platsen för den äl: Alexandria is founded on the site of the earlier settlement of Rakothis.
Alfonso II the Chaste rules in Asturias. He supports the churches and develops the royal seat of Oviedo.
Alfonso II stödjer kyrkorna i Oviedo; kr: Alfonso II supports the churches in Oviedo; the chroniclers describe his Christian anointing.
Alfonso IX av León inrättar högre skolor: Alfonso IX of León establishes schools of higher learning in Salamanca. The schools become the foundation of the later university.
Alfonso IX inrättar skolor i Salamanca: Alfonso IX establishes schools in Salamanca
Alfred besegrar den danska hären vid Edi: Alfred defeats the Danish army at Edington
Alfreds här besegrar danskarna vid Eding: Alfred's army defeats the Danes at Edington in May 878. He pursues them to Chippenham and besieges their fortification. After fourteen days they ask for peace.
Ali ibn Fadl och Ibn Hawshab inleder en: Ali ibn Fadl and Ibn Hawshab begin an Ismaili mission in Yemen in 881. They maintain contact with the movement's central leadership.
Ali ibn Fadl och Ibn Hawshab inleder mis: Ali ibn Fadl and Ibn Hawshab begin a mission in Yemen
Ali ibn Yusuf bekostar en utbyggnad av f: Ali ibn Yusuf sponsors an expansion of the congregational mosque in Fez. Builders extend the prayer hall after demolishing its earlier qibla wall and adjoining houses.
Ali ibn Yusuf bygger ut al-Qarawiyyin-mo: Ali ibn Yusuf expands the al-Qarawiyyin mosque
Almohaderna erövrar Marrakech år 1147. D: The Almohads conquer Marrakech in 1147. Their leader Abd al-Mumin assumes the title Commander of the Faithful and makes the city the centre of Almohad rule.
Almoraviderna grundar Marrakech under år: The Almoravids found Marrakech during the years 1070–1072 according to UNESCO's dating. They build a political, economic and cultural centre with connections in North Africa and al-Andalus.
Alp Arslan besegrar kejsaren vid Manzike: Alp Arslan defeats the emperor at Manzikert
Alp Arslans seldjukiska här besegrar kej: Alp Arslan's Seljuk army defeats Emperor Romanos IV's Byzantine army at Manzikert on 26 August 1071 according to the specialist sources' dating. The Seljuks take the emperor prisoner.
Ambraseys återger Diodoros 469–468, Plut: Ambraseys gives Diodorus' 469–468, Plutarch's 466–464, Thucydides' 464 and Pausanias' 464–463 BC. OASP uses 464. It is uncertain whether the accounts concern one earthquake or several.
Amenemhat I flyttar huvudstaden från The: Amenemhat I moves the capital from Thebes to Itjtawy
Amenemhat I flyttar rikets administrativ: Amenemhat I moves the kingdom’s administrative centre from Thebes to Itjtawy in the north. UCL places Itjtawy probably at modern Lisht.
Amenemhat II för krig i området för dage: Amenemhat II wages war in the area of present-day Syria
Amenemhat II genomför ett fälttåg i områ: Amenemhat II conducts a campaign in the area of present-day Syria. According to the Metropolitan Museum, he takes prisoners of war who are subsequently put to work on the king’s building projects.
Amoghavarsha efterträder sin far Govinda: Amoghavarsha succeeds his father Govinda III as Rashtrakuta ruler. He is young when he takes the throne and is also called Nrupatunga.
Amyrtaios bryter persernas styre i delar: Amyrtaeus ends Persian rule in parts of Egypt
Amyrtaios kommer till makten efter ett f: Amyrtaeus comes to power after a successful revolt and inaugurates Dynasty 28. Renewed Egyptian independence takes hold gradually and does not immediately extend throughout the country.
An Lushan leder ett uppror mot Tangdynas: An Lushan leads a rebellion against the Tang dynasty
An Son i nuvarande södra Vietnam: An Son in present-day southern Vietnam
An med flera anger 1850–1750 kalibrerade: An and colleagues give 1850–1750 calibrated BC for the phase. Liu and colleagues model the start boundary as 1850–1780 and the end boundary as 1730–1675 BC; in the prose, they estimate the transition at 1840–1820 and the end at c. 1720. The combined interval preserves the models’ outer bounds and dates no individual construction years.
Anawrahta börjar regera i Bagan. Under s: Anawrahta begins to rule in Bagan. During his reign he unites central Burma's dry zone under a common administration and develops irrigation for rice cultivation.
Anawrahta inleder sitt styre i Bagan: Anawrahta begins his rule in Bagan
Angkor och Koh Ker, nuvarande Kambodja: Angkor and Koh Ker, present-day Cambodia
Angripare anfaller mayastaden Aguateca o: Attackers assault the Maya city of Aguateca and burn its centre. The inhabitants flee or are taken captive.
Angripare bränner Aguatecas centrum: Attackers burn the centre of Aguateca
Anienedalen och Rom, Italien: The Aniene valley and Rome, Italy
Anitta berättar att han förde tillbaka N: Anitta reports returning Nesha's cult image
Anittas redogörelse säger att han förde: Anitta's account says that he brought Nesha's deity back from Zalpuwa, where an earlier king had taken it. The passage records a royal claim to recover a city's sacred image; it does not establish an independently verified recovery of an excavated statue.
Annalerna nämner honom inte år 800. Akvi: The annals do not mention him in 800. Aquitaine is his kingdom, but his location on Christmas Day is not attested.
Annalerna sänder honom från Ravenna mot: The annals send him from Ravenna against Benevento between the beginning of August and 23 November 800. Only the revised text mentions Ancona. His whereabouts on Christmas Day are not attested.
Anspråk på tronen kunde gå genom både fa: Claims to the throne could pass through both paternal and maternal kin and lead to competing dynastic claims; both of the game’s succession laws simplify this.
Anthemios från Tralles och Isidoros från: Anthemius of Tralles and Isidore of Miletus design Hagia Sophia in Constantinople.
Anthemios och Isidoros utformar Hagia So: Anthemius and Isidore design Hagia Sophia
Anthony anger cirka 2100–1800 f.Kr. Lind: Anthony gives circa 2100–1800 BC. Lindner reports circa 2040–1730 calibrated BC for the Sintashta stage at 95.4 per cent confidence and describes its emergence around 2000 BC. The combined interval represents different frameworks and gives no continuous construction period.
Antigonos dör vid Ipsos. Hans rike delas: Antigonus dies at Ipsus. His kingdom is divided after the battle.
Antigonos och Demetrios besegrar Ptolema: Antigonus and Demetrius defeat Ptolemy at Salamis on Cyprus and assume royal titles.
Antiochos III besegras vid Magnesia: Antiochus III is defeated at Magnesia
Antiochos III och Ptolemaios IV för krig: Antiochus III and Ptolemy IV wage war against each other.
Antiochos III:s seleukidiska armé möter: Antiochus III's Seleucid army encounters Roman forces at Magnesia and is defeated.
Antipatros slår ned motståndet i det lam: Antipater puts down resistance in the Lamian War.
Antonius och Octavianus styrkor besegrar: Antony's and Octavian's forces defeat the senatorial armies under Brutus and Cassius. Philippi becomes a decisive defeat for Caesar's assassins.
Anuj Misra daterar verket till omkring 1: Anuj Misra dates the work to around 1150. The entry therefore gives an approximate year and does not attribute a certain completion day to the author.
Apameafreden begränsar Antiochos flotta: The Treaty of Apamea restricts Antiochus's fleet
Aqua Appia byggs under Appius Claudius C: The Aqua Appia is built during the censorship of Appius Claudius Caecus and supplies Rome with water through an aqueduct.
Aquincum, Carnuntum och Salla får stadsr: Aquincum, Carnuntum and Salla receive town rights. Hadrian also founds the colony of Mursa.
Arabiska arméer besegrar sasaniderna vid: Arab armies defeat the Sasanians at Nahavand
Arabiska muslimska arméer besegrar sasan: Arab Muslim armies defeat Sasanian forces at the battle of Nahavand, the de facto end of the Sasanian empire. The last Sasanian ruler, Yazdgard III, flees to Merv, where he dies in 651.
Arabiska muslimska arméer erövrar Egypte: Arab Muslim armies conquer Egypt during the caliphate of 'Umar ibn al-Khattab. They found al-Fustat, the garrison town that later becomes part of Cairo, and build Egypt's first congregational mosque for the army.
Arabiska och berbiska trupper erövrar st: Arab and Berber troops conquer most of Iberia
Arabiska och berbiska trupper går i land: Arab and Berber troops land on the Iberian Peninsula under Umayyad command. Through war and negotiations, they take control of most of the peninsula and displace the Visigothic leadership.
Arabiska trupper erövrar Samarkand år 71: Arab troops conquer Samarkand in 712. They bring one of Sogdia's cities under the caliphate's control.
Arameiska småkungariken under tidig järn: Aramaean petty kingdoms of the early Iron Age
Arbetet påbörjas under Caligula och full: Work begun under Caligula and completed under Claudius adds an aqueduct carrying spring water from the Aniene valley toward Rome. High arches support sections of its route.
Arbroath och Skottland; brevet riktas ti: Arbroath and Scotland; the letter is addressed to the pope
Arcadius och Honorius övertar var sin de: Arcadius and Honorius each take over part of the empire
Archaeological Survey of India härleder: The Archaeological Survey of India derives circa 740 from the inscription about the king's three victories. It gives no exact year of completion.
Archnet anger byggkampanjen till ungefär: Archnet gives the campaign as approximately 1134–1143. Serrat and colleagues give completion in 1143–44, while separately citing an inscription date of 1136 for the structures. The full campaign span preserves these different completion labels; 1136 does not date all the work.
Ardashir besegrar partherna och upprätta: Ardashir defeats the Parthians and establishes Sasanian dynastic rule in Iran.
Arias anger kungasäte från 791; Getty an: Arias gives a royal seat from 791; Getty gives a capital from 810. The game uses Oviedo as an uncertain court seat for 800.
Arias daterar tillträdet till 791; Solan: Arias dates the accession to 791; Solano gives the death year as 842. The sources provide no continuous account of whereabouts.
Arikamedu i Indien och Oc Eo i nuvarande: Arikamedu in India and Oc Eo in present-day Vietnam
Aristoteles inrättar sin skola vid Lykei: Aristotle establishes his school at the Lyceum
Aristoteles återvänder till Aten och inr: Aristotle returns to Athens and establishes a school at the Lyceum, a place for teaching and research.
Arkeologen Marc N. Levine anger 1083. Ko: The archaeologist Marc N. Levine gives 1083. The codex scholar Manuel A. Hermann Lejarazu gives the year 7 Flint, which he renders as 1084.
Arkeologer har funnit tidiga järnföremål: Archaeologists have found early iron objects at Pirak on the Kachi Plain in Baluchistan. They date the earliest finds to approximately 1000–800 BC and find more iron in later settlement layers.
Arkeologer har undersökt koppargruvor oc: Archaeologists have investigated copper mines and smelting sites in the Vilabouly area, formerly known as Sepon, in central Laos. They have found ore, slag and crucibles there. The researchers place the site's archaeological sequence within a long interval from approximately 1000 BC to AD 700.
Arkeologerna anger omkring 1050 för omva: Archaeologists give around 1050 for the transformation. The inhabitants had lived at the site before this expansion.
Arkeologerna anger omkring år 810. Året: The archaeologists give around 810. The year of the attack is uncertain.
Arkivet anger den 15 juni 1215 och ett p: The archive gives 15 June 1215 and a papal annulment ten weeks later. The entry does not describe the charter as an immediately lasting peace.
Armén börjar bygga Hadrianus mur: The army begins building Hadrian’s Wall
Arnald vigs till biskop för Grönlands no: Arnald is consecrated bishop for Greenland's Norse people
Arqueología Mexicana daterar Adosadaöver: Arqueología Mexicana dates the Adosada covering to around AD 350. The Met describes it in relative terms and reports no major changes to the complex after about 350. Its purpose is disputed: a political change and respectful ritual caching are alternative interpretations. Damage to the other façades has no established date.
Artikelförfattarna daterar risodlingens: The article's authors date the introduction of rice cultivation at Genkai Bay to around 1000 BC. In the abstract, they give approximately 900 BC–AD 250 for the broader Yayoi period. This entry follows the dating in the specific discussion of Genkai Bay; the transition takes place at different times in different parts of Japan.
Artikeln från 2014 daterar befästningen: The 2014 article dates the fortification to 2200–2100 cal BC. A 2018 report provisionally associates its original construction with the wider earliest settlement phase, c. 2200–2025 BC. Neither gives an exact construction year.
Artikelns titel och sammanfattning anger: The article’s title and abstract give an approximate lifespan from circa 1120. The year is uncertain, and 1 January is a simulated day without a historical claim.
Arumolivarman bestiger Cholatronen år 98: Arumolivarman ascends the Chola throne in 985 and takes the regnal name Rajaraja I. He is the son of Parantaka II.
Arumolivarman blir Cholahärskare som Raj: Arumolivarman becomes Chola ruler as Rajaraja I
Asaak, i området kring nordöstra Iran oc: Asaak, in the area of northeastern Iran and southern Turkmenistan
Asarhaddon binder edsavläggare vid sin u: Esarhaddon binds oath-takers to his chosen successor
Asarhaddon organiserar trohetseder till: Esarhaddon organizes loyalty oaths supporting Ashurbanipal as his successor. The arrangements extend to Assyrian participants and eastern city-lords; a surviving provincial version names a governor and administrative and military groups.
Ashikaga Takauji driver Go-Daigo från Ky: Ashikaga Takauji drives Go-Daigo from Kyoto
Ashikaga Takauji drives Go-Daigo from Kyoto and places another emperor on the throne. Go-Daigo establishes a rival court at Yoshino.
Ashikaga Takauji grundar zentemplet Tenr: Ashikaga Takauji founds the Zen temple Tenryu-ji in memory of Go-Daigo. Muso Soseki is appointed the temple's first abbot.
Ashikaga Yoshimasa börjar bygga sin Higa: Ashikaga Yoshimasa begins building his Higashiyama villa in 1482. It is established on the former grounds of Jōdoji Temple.
Ashikaga Yoshimitsu inleder bygget av Ki: Ashikaga Yoshimitsu begins construction of the Kitayama Palace. The Golden Pavilion receives a prominent position in the planned residential complex.
Ashikaga Yoshimitsu löser konflikten mel: Ashikaga Yoshimitsu resolves the conflict between the northern and southern imperial courts. The long period of rival courts thereby draws to a close.
Ashmolean Museum daterar omfattande förs: The Ashmolean Museum dates widespread destruction on Crete to around 1450 BC. The museum leaves the question of a Mycenaean invasion open. The entry concerns the destruction phase, rather than the date of the museum’s jar.
Ashokas edikt i Sopara uppmanar till eti: Ashoka's edict at Sopara calls for ethical conduct
Ashur, norra Mesopotamien, och handeln m: Ashur, northern Mesopotamia, and trade with Anatolia
Askia Muhammad låter bygga den pyramidfo: Askia Muhammad has the pyramid-shaped tomb building in Gao built in 1495. The complex includes mosques, a burial ground and a gathering area.
Askia Muhammad låter bygga ett monument: Askia Muhammad has a monument built in Gao
Assar anger juni–juli utifrån kilskrifts: Assar gives June–July on the basis of cuneiform texts and rejects 140 BC. The evidence does not show that Mithridates personally leads the campaign.
Assurnasirpal II flyttar Assyriens huvud: Ashurnasirpal II moves the Assyrian capital from Ashur to Nimrud (ancient Kalhu). Colossal lamassu guard his palace entrances, and carved alabaster reliefs show the king hunting, performing rituals and defeating enemies. When the palace is complete, he holds a week-long feast for nearly 70,000 guests.
Ashurnasirpal II moves the Assyrian capital to Nimrud
Assyrien och dess provinsiella sfär, där: Assyria and its provincial sphere, including Kalḫu and Kullania
Assyriska observatörer i Nineve registre: According to NASA, Assyrian observers at Nineveh record a solar eclipse on 15 June 763 BC. The record is among the surviving ancient observations showing how celestial phenomena were followed and written down.
Assyriska observatörer noterar en solför: Assyrian observers record a solar eclipse
Aten får en större befästningsmur som sv: Athens gains a major fortification wall in response to Gothic raids.
Aten för krig mot Samos. Konflikten visa: Athens wages war against Samos. The conflict reveals tensions within the Athenian sphere of power in the Aegean.
Aten och Sparta med sina bundsförvanter: Athens and Sparta, together with their allies, fight a prolonged war. It ends with Sparta's victory and a severe defeat for Athens.
Aten och andra grekiska städer plundras: Athens and other Greek cities are sacked
Aten sänder en stor expedition för att e: Athens sends a large expedition to conquer Sicily. The undertaking fails catastrophically, and only a small proportion of the participants return.
Aten återgår till demokratiskt styre eft: Athens returns to democratic government after the oligarchy of the Thirty.
Aten, Korinth, Sparta och Argos, Greklan: Athens, Corinth, Sparta and Argos, Greece
Aten, Sparta, andra grekiska stater och: Athens, Sparta, other Greek states and the Persian king are bound by oaths to the so-called King's Peace.
Atenare och plataier segrar vid Marathon: Athenians and Plataeans win at Marathon
Atens expedition till Sicilien slutar i: Athens' Sicilian expedition ends in disaster
Atensk tradition förlägger Drakons lagst: Athenian tradition places Draco's legislation in this archon year. His homicide law survives through a later republication and regulates matters including legal procedures and exile for unintentional killing.
Atenska och plataiska styrkor besegrar d: Athenian and Plataean forces defeat the Persian expedition at Marathon. Miltiades directs the Greek military effort, after which the Athenians hurry back toward their city.
Athelstan besegrar en allians vid Brunan: Athelstan defeats an alliance at Brunanburh
Athelstan besegrar en invasionshär vid B: Athelstan defeats an invading army at Brunanburh in 937. He faces the Scottish king and his allies from Dublin.
Attalos III lämnar sitt kungarike till R: Attalus III leaves his kingdom to Rome in his will.
Attalos III testamenterar sitt kungarike: Attalus III bequeaths his kingdom to Rome
Augustine lands on Thanet in Kent. Pope Gregory has sent him to evangelise among the Anglo-Saxons.
Augustus dör och styvsonen Tiberius över: Augustus dies and his stepson Tiberius takes power.
Aulus Plautius leder kejsar Claudius inv: Aulus Plautius leads Emperor Claudius’s invasion army across to Britain.
Aurelia Charis begär att en kommission s: Aurelia Charis asks a commission to confirm her public sacrifice in accordance with the emperor’s order. Two members sign the document.
Avaris och norra Egypten, med Thebe i sö: Avaris and northern Egypt, with Thebes to the south
Ayutthaya etableras som en ny siamesisk: Ayutthaya is established as a new Siamese capital after Sukhothai. The city stands on a river island with access to the sea.
Ayutthaya upprättas som siamesisk huvuds: Ayutthaya is established as a Siamese capital
Ayyubiderna tar kontroll i Jemen: The Ayyubids take control in Yemen
Ayyubidernas muslimska styrkor intar Jer: The Ayyubids' Muslim forces capture Jerusalem in 1187. They take the city from its Christian rulers during Saladin's war against the crusaders.
Aztec, nuvarande New Mexico, Nordamerika: Aztec, present-day New Mexico, North America
Aztekernas nye härskare är Motecuhzoma X: The Aztecs' new ruler is Motecuhzoma Xocoyotzin, also called Montezuma II. The coronation takes place in Tenochtitlan.
Babur besegrar 1527 ett förbund av rajpu: In 1527, Babur defeats a confederacy of Rajput kings under Rana Sanga. The latter is ruler of Mewar.
Babur besegrar Ibrahim Lodi vid Panipat: Babur defeats Ibrahim Lodi at Panipat
Baburs armé besegrar sultan Ibrahim Lodi: Babur's army defeats Sultan Ibrahim Lodi at Panipat in 1526. This victory and the subsequent victory over Rana Sanga's confederacy together give Babur a foundation for consolidating his rule in northern India.
Babylon, Mari and Aleppo defeat Elam. Eshnunna helps Hammurabi in the war.
Baekjes kung sänder buddhabilder och skr: Baekje's king sends images of the Buddha and scriptures to Emperor Kinmei. The royal gift is regarded as the official transmission of Buddhism to Japan, where immigrants may have practised the religion earlier.
Baekjes kung sänder buddhistiska gåvor t: Baekje's king sends Buddhist gifts to Japan
Bagan och centrala Burma, nuvarande Myan: Bagan and central Burma, present-day Myanmar
Bahmanidernas dynasti bildas i Deccan: The Bahmanid dynasty is formed in the Deccan
Baktrien och Sogdiana i Centralasien: Bactria and Sogdiana in Central Asia
Balbus leder ett romerskt fälttåg i Saha: Balbus leads a Roman campaign in the Sahara
Bambatakeramik sprids till sydöstra Afri: Bambata pottery spreads into southeastern Africa
Ban Non Wat går in i en järnåldersfas: Ban Non Wat enters an Iron Age phase
Ban Non Wat i nordöstra Thailand: Ban Non Wat in northeastern Thailand
Ban Non Wat, övre Mundalen i nuvarande T: Ban Non Wat, upper Mun Valley in present-day Thailand
Bar Kokhba leder ett uppror mot Rom: Bar Kokhba leads a revolt against Rome
Bar-Kochva dates the battle to 190 BC and Dueck to 189 BC. The interval represents alternatives for a single battle.
Barnets existens på startdagen bygger på: The child’s existence on the start date rests on an approximate birth dating. No passage places him in Cusco on this particular day or appoints him heir at this time.
Bartolomeu Dias seglar runt Afrikas syds: Bartolomeu Dias sails around Africa's southern tip in 1488. He lands at Mossel Bay during the voyage.
Bates och Choi använder cirka 1900–1700: Bates and Choi use c. 1900–1700 BC for the phase studied. Their broader Localisation Era covers c. 1900–1300 BC. The date establishes no single abandonment year or sole cause.
Bayliss med kolleger anger detta fullstä: Bayliss and colleagues give this complete interval for a regional development in settlement form. It does not date the first occupation of every site, imply continuous occupation throughout, or assign Skara Brae's later nucleated settlement to 3200 BC.
Bedömning av två belagda maktövertagande: An assessment of two attested seizures of power, with no claim of a uniform Byzantine succession law.
Begravningsskicket i Korea blir mer utar: Burial practices in Korea grow more elaborate as society becomes more stratified. Dolmen tombs, upright stones under a horizontal slab, are more numerous in Korea than elsewhere in East Asia, beside new stone cists and earthenware jar coffins.
Ben-Yosef placerar produktionstoppen ino: Ben-Yosef places the production peak within this half-century. The integer bounds represent that calendar period, not measured opening and closing years or uninterrupted peak output. Greener and Ben-Yosef give a wider eleventh–ninth-century context for Timna; it does not date this particular peak.
Benedictus av Nursia grundar klostret Mo: Benedict of Nursia founds the monastery of Monte Cassino on the site of an older temple of Apollo.
Benen hör till Ban Non Wats neolitiska f: The bones belong to Ban Non Wat’s Neolithic phase. The 2022 study interprets them as the earliest secure domestic chickens in its comparative material, but also reports that their domestic status has been questioned. The dating does not establish a specific year of domestication.
Bengalen, nuvarande Bangladesh och östra: Bengal, present-day Bangladesh and eastern India
Bharhuts port och räcken får reliefer oc: Bharhut's gateway and railings receive reliefs and inscriptions
Bi Sheng utvecklar en metod för att tryc: Bi Sheng develops a method of printing text with movable clay type during the Qingli period. Printers can assemble the characters into new texts instead of carving each page into a single woodblock.
Bi Sheng utvecklar tryckning med lösa ty: Bi Sheng develops printing with movable clay type
Bibliotekets avbildade exemplar är en se: The copy pictured by the library is a later transcription from the Jiajing period.
Bildhuggare i Caracol förser stela 10 me: Sculptors at Caracol inscribe Stela 10 with a date of 859. Researchers list this as the city's last monument date in their compilation.
Bildhuggare i Tikal färdigställer stela: Sculptors at Tikal complete Stela 11 with the date 869. Researchers know of no later sculpted monument from the city.
Bildhuggare i Uaxactun daterar stela 12: Sculptors at Uaxactun date Stela 12 to 889. On the monument they recount wars with the city's neighbours.
Bildhuggare skapar en berättande relief: Sculptors create a narrative relief at La Venta
Bilge Kagan låter uppföra ett minnesmärk: Bilge Kagan commissions an inscribed memorial honouring Kül Tigin. The monument carries Turkic and Chinese texts. Its Turkic narrative recounts Köktürk history in Bilge Kagan's voice, while the inscription discusses military and political affairs, including relations with China.
Bilge Kagan reser ett minnesmärke över K: Bilge Kagan raises a memorial to Kül Tigin
Biskoparna i Hieria förkastar bruket av: The bishops at Hieria reject the use of icons
Biskoparna i Nicaea antar en trosbekänne: The bishops at Nicaea adopt a creed
Biskoparna vid det andra kyrkomötet i Ni: The bishops at the Second Council of Nicaea reject the decisions of Hieria. They distinguish the veneration of icons from the worship due to God.
Biskoparna vid kyrkomötet i Nicaea antar: The bishops at the Council of Nicaea adopt a creed. In it they profess that the Son is of one substance with the Father.
Bland dem som dödas finns Pothinus och B: Those killed include Pothinus and Blandina.
Blåvitt porslin får större spridning i K: Blue-and-white porcelain becomes more widespread in China
Boiotierna besegrar Sparta vid Leuktra: The Boeotians defeat Sparta at Leuctra
Boken Hunminjeongeum publiceras 1446. De: The book Hunminjeongeum is published in 1446. It explains the writing system's creation and principles.
Boskapsskötare vid Dali tycks ge djuren: Herders at Dali appear to feed their animals millet in winter
Bosworth anger två alternativa år i den: Bosworth gives two alternative years in the Islamic calendar, 533 and 534, with the equivalents 1138–1139 and 1139–1140 respectively. Both alternatives are retained here. No death toll or exact day is given.
Bosättningarna på Orkney växer till stor: Orkney's settlements develop into large mounds
Bosättningarna vid höjderna AB och E i H: The settlements at Mounds AB and E at Harappa appear to have been enclosed by substantial mud-brick walls during the Kot Diji phase. Jonathan Mark Kenoyer dates the phase to around 2800–2600 BC. He also describes streets and houses aligned north–south and east–west.
Boudicas styrkor angriper Camulodunum, L: Boudica’s forces attack Camulodunum, Londinium and Verulamium before the Romans defeat the uprising.
Brand och förstörelse ödelägger Ugarit,: Fire and destruction devastate Ugarit, a trading centre on the Syrian coast, ending its Late Bronze Age political existence. The identity of the attackers and the sequence of destruction remain uncertain. Traces of later reoccupation mean that the site was not permanently deserted in every part.
Branden förstör omfattande delar av stad: The fire destroys extensive parts of the city.
Brandlager i flera delar av palatskomple: Burn layers in several parts of the palace complex on the Kadmeia hill show its destruction. This event belongs to the end of the Mycenaean palace period in the area.
Bray härleder ett ungefärligt födelsespa: Bray derives an approximate birth span from 1447–1448 to 1457–1458 from colonial statements of age. The game’s separate birth date is generated; it provides no exact historical dating.
Bresciani daterar upprorets början ungef: Bresciani dates the beginning of the revolt approximately. The later reconquest and Inarus' execution must not receive the same date.
Brevet är belagt. Om Luther själv spikad: The letter is documented. Whether Luther himself nailed the theses to the Castle Church door is disputed.
Brian Borus här besegrar motståndare frå: Brian Boru's army defeats opponents from Dublin and Leinster who have joined forces with a Viking fleet. Irish and Norse warriors take part in the fighting near Dublin. Researchers date the battle to 1014.
Brians här segrar i slaget vid Clontarf: Brian's army wins the Battle of Clontarf
Briant dates the battle to 1 October.
Briant places the fire in spring.
Britannien, östra Kent och området kring: Britain, eastern Kent and the area around the Thames
British Library anger den 11 maj 868. Kä: The British Library gives 11 May 868. The source suggests Chengdu as a possible place of printing but establishes no location.
British Library daterar brevet till 313–: The British Library dates the letter to 313–314. Its findspot at the Dunhuang frontier fortifications does not establish where the sender wrote it.
Brunanburh, Brittiska öarna; platsen är: Brunanburh, British Isles; the location is uncertain
Brutus och Cassius besegras vid Filippi: Brutus and Cassius are defeated at Philippi
Bryggare producerar öl i stor skala i Ab: Brewers produce beer on a large scale at Abydos
Bryggare vid Abydos arbetar med minst åt: Brewers at Abydos work with at least eight parallel installations containing large ceramic vats. Archaeologists date the brewery to around 3000 BC and estimate its capacity at around 22,000 litres of beer per batch.
Bränder förstör palatskomplexet i Thebe: Fires destroy the palace complex at Thebes
Brú na Bóinne, Boynedalen, Irland: Brú na Bóinne, Boyne Valley, Ireland
Buddhismen vid Västra Xias hov: Buddhism at the Western Xia court
Bury daterar avtalet till 363. Ammianus: Bury dates the treaty to 363. Ammianus Marcellinus records the terms in Book XXV, 7.9–11.
Byar förenas i Teotihuacandalen: Villages merge in the Teotihuacan valley
Byggare anlägger den runda stenplatsen v: Builders construct the circular stone plaza at Callacpuma
Byggare anlägger en bollplan av jord i P: Builders construct an earthen ballcourt at Paso de la Amada
Byggare anlägger en formell spelgång mel: Builders create a formal playing alley between parallel earthen mounds at Paso de la Amada. Its scale and relationship to nearby residences have led researchers to connect games with emerging leadership and social competition, although that political explanation remains an interpretation.
Byggare anlägger en planerad bosättning: Builders establish a planned settlement for the workers at Senusret II’s pyramid. The town is called Hetep-Senusret and is also known as Kahun in archaeological literature.
Byggare anlägger en planerad stad vid La: Builders establish a planned town at Lahun
Byggare anlägger höga dammar vid Liangzh: Builders construct high dams at Liangzhu
Byggare anlägger låga dammar och en vall: Builders construct low dams and an embankment at Liangzhu
Byggare anlägger sammankopplade vattenre: Builders construct linked water reservoirs at Kairouan
Byggare anlägger stora hus och mindre ha: Builders lay out large houses and smaller craftspeople’s dwellings at Malia. The quarter includes workshops for metalworking, pottery and seal engraving, among other crafts.
Byggare förstorar högen Silbury Hill: Builders enlarge the mound of Silbury Hill
Byggare förstärker Dholaviras murar med: Builders reinforce Dholavira's walls with brick
Byggare gräver ett cirkelformat dike och: Builders dig a circular ditch and raise banks on both sides. They enclose an area measuring around 100 metres across and leave two entrances. English Heritage dates the work to around 3000 BC.
Byggare i Dholavira förstärker befästnin: Builders at Dholavira reinforce the fortification walls with a substantial brick wall on the inside. The inhabitants also establish a residential area north of the older settlement. ICOMOS dates this stage to around 2900–2800 BC.
Byggare i Dongola uppför en tvåvåningsby: Builders at Dongola erect a two-storey building on a sandstone hill in the early ninth century. Researchers interpret its original function as a throne hall or church. Dongola is the capital of Makuria.
Byggare i San José Mogote, Oaxacadalens: Builders at San José Mogote, the major regional centre of the Valley of Oaxaca, construct the valley's first public building. It is a stuccoed wattle-and-daub structure on a platform-like foundation.
Byggare inleder sultan Hasans religiösa: Builders begin Sultan Hasan's religious complex in Cairo
Byggare leder en vattenkanal över en rav: Builders carry a water channel across a ravine at Jerwan as part of Sennacherib's supply system for Nineveh. The aqueduct forms a major structure on the Khinis canal, which draws water from the Gomel River.
Byggare lägger en trappstegsformad platt: Builders place a stepped platform against the western façade of the Feathered Serpent Pyramid in Teotihuacan's Ciudadela. The new construction conceals its sculptural decoration. Scholars disagree over whether this marked a change in government or a respectful ritual covering.
Byggare lägger jord och krita i flera et: Builders add earth and chalk in several phases to the mound now called Silbury Hill. They continue enlarging the mound over several generations. Archaeologists do not know the purpose of the structure.
Byggare norr och väster om Liangzhu anlä: Builders north and west of Liangzhu construct four dams and a long embankment at the foot of the mountains. They create a water storage system. ICOMOS gives the construction period as around 3000–2600 BC.
Byggare omger Taosis växande stad med en: Builders enclose Taosi's growing city with a large wall
Byggare ordnar tre högar i U-form kring: Builders arrange three mounds in a U-shape around a large central plaza at Cerro Blanco. Researchers interpret this early complex and nearby Huaca Partida as important gathering places for the region’s communities.
Byggare påbörjar Chan Chan på Perus nord: Builders begin Chan Chan on Peru's north coast around 950. They build early palace compounds, including Chayhuac, with sun-dried bricks.
Byggare påbörjar Chetro Ketl i Chaco Can: Builders begin Chetro Ketl in Chaco Canyon around 990 according to the National Park Service's compilation of tree-ring dates. Archaeologists have collected around 380 such dates from the site according to an older compilation in the 1978 nomination document.
Byggare påbörjar Pueblo Bonito i Chaco C: Builders begin Pueblo Bonito in Chaco Canyon around 850. Later generations expand the complex into one of the great houses of the Chaco culture.
Byggare påbörjar sultan Hasans stora rel: Builders begin Sultan Hasan's large religious complex in Cairo. The sultan's commission forms part of the Mamluks' extensive support for religious architecture.
Byggare rekonstruerar Foguangtemplets ös: Builders reconstruct the East Hall of Foguang Temple in Shanxi. Its seven-bay timber structure, with girders and beams, becomes an important surviving example of Tang Buddhist architecture.
Byggare reser stora sarsenstenar i en yt: Builders raise large sarsen stones in an outer circle and an inner horseshoe. Between them they place smaller bluestones in a double arc.
Byggare transporterar stora basaltblock: Builders transport large basalt blocks across Pohnpei and erect the funerary monument on Nandauwas at Nan Madol. They use coral in the masonry and the burial vault's fill.
Byggare uppför Gudsmoderns avsomnandekat: Builders erect the Dormition Cathedral in Vladimir in 1158–1160. They design the church in the city's kremlin with three aisles.
Byggare uppför Husuni Kubwa på Kilwa: Builders erect Husuni Kubwa on Kilwa
Byggare uppför Mentuhotep II:s gravkompl: Builders construct Mentuhotep II's funerary complex at Deir el-Bahri
Byggare uppför Mukvarteret i Malia: Builders construct the Mu Quarter at Malia
Byggare uppför den grav som nu kallas An: Builders construct the tomb now called Anak III. UNESCO’s description refers to an inscribed construction date.
Byggare uppför det första palatset i Mal: Builders construct the first palace at Malia
Byggare uppför det minoiska palatset i F: Builders construct the Minoan palace at Phaistos on Crete around 1900 BC, according to the official archaeological-site account.
Byggare uppför en kyrka i Maryam Nazret: Builders erect a church at Maryam Nazret
Byggare uppför en monumental byggnad i D: Builders erect a monumental building at Dongola
Byggare uppför en monumental grav för Ma: Builders raise a monumental tomb for Maussollos at the centre of his capital. Its colonnade, stepped roof and sculptural decoration give the ruler's commemoration a prominent place in the city.
Byggare uppför en pyramid, ett tempel oc: Builders construct a pyramid, a temple and smaller pyramids for royal women. They later expand the complex and build a large southern temple. Senusret III’s burial at the site is not established.
Byggare uppför en stor stadsinhägnad i T: Builders construct a large city enclosure at Taosi. Craftspeople work with pottery and stone in a separate area in the southwestern part of the city.
Byggare uppför ett gravkomplex för Mentu: Builders construct a funerary complex for Mentuhotep II and female members of the royal family. People there also commemorate the king's reunification of Egypt and worship the god Montu.
Byggare uppför ett mindre, D-format hus: Builders erect a smaller, D-shaped building at the Ness of Brodgar. It contains a rectangular hearth beside a stone slab decorated on both sides. Archaeologists place its construction at possibly around 2800–2700 BC.
Byggare uppför ett palats i Malia på Kre: Builders construct a palace at Malia on Crete’s north coast. According to the Greek nomination’s description, the site lies near an important prehistoric harbour.
Byggare uppför ett rundat rum i La Galga: Builders erect a rounded room at La Galgada
Builders erect a rounded room in La Galgada's southern building complex. The archaeologist Alberto Bueno Mendoza dates the room at floor level 24 to around 2400 BC.
Byggare uppför gravmonument i Nan Madol: Builders erect a funerary monument at Nan Madol
Byggare uppför hus 26 vid Ness of Brodga: Builders erect Structure 26 at the Ness of Brodgar
Byggare uppför hus vid Zürichsjön: Builders erect houses at Lake Zurich
Byggare uppför katedralen i Vladimir: Builders erect the cathedral in Vladimir
Byggare uppför moskén i Tinmal under alm: Builders erect the mosque at Tinmal under Almohad rule in 1153–1154. Religious reform is an important part of the establishment of Almohad power, while their architecture develops.
Byggare uppför och utvidgar Senusret III: Builders construct and expand Senusret III’s funerary complex at Dahshur
Byggare uppför palatset Husuni Kubwa på: Builders erect the palace of Husuni Kubwa on Kilwa Island. Within the complex they construct a large octagonal bathing pool.
Byggare utvidgar huvudtemplet i Tenochti: Builders expand the main temple in Tenochtitlan during the year 1 Rabbit. They decorate the pyramid with large incense burners and serpent heads.
Byggare vid Callacpuma anlägger en rund: Builders at Callacpuma construct a circular plaza with two concentric walls of upright stones without mortar. Researchers give around 2750 BC as the central dating for the initial construction. They date charcoal from the structure's foundation.
Byggare vid Liangzhu i Yangtzedeltat anl: Builders at Liangzhu in the Yangtze Delta construct dams between hills at valley mouths. ICOMOS judges that the area with six high dam structures was built around 3100–2850 BC. Archaeologists date different high dams to partly differing times. Spatial groupings are interpreted as probable separate construction projects, and some dates suggest later rebuilding. The structures therefore have no shared certain construction year.
Byggare återställer hus 10 vid Ness of B: Builders restore Structure 10 at the Ness of Brodgar
Bygget av Via Appia inleds: Construction of the Via Appia begins
Bygget av ceremonikomplexet i Chiripá på: Construction begins on the ceremonial complex at Chiripá
Bygget började troligen 122, möjligen fö: Construction probably began in 122, possibly before Hadrian’s visit, and took at least six years. No exact completion year is given.
Bygget utnyttjar en redan grund sediment: The construction uses an existing shallow sediment ridge. Seven months is the stated length of the siege.
Byggnadskomplex DD förstörs i en brand s: Building Complex DD is destroyed in a fire that chars stored plant remains. Archaeologists associate the destruction with Hittite campaigns in the northern Levant and consider it likely to have occurred during Hattusili I’s reign. The connection rests on archaeological comparisons and is not a secure identification of the attacker.
Byggstarten anges som ungefärlig. Arbete: The start of construction is approximate. Work may have taken up to twelve years; no exact end year is calculated.
Båda födelseuppskattningarna ligger före: Both birth estimates precede 1500, and the sources give death in 1525. Being alive at the bookmark therefore rests on an uncertain birth estimate combined with later life, rather than a dated presence in 1500.
Båda föreslagna födelseåren ligger före: Both proposed birth years precede 800; the source gives death in 227/842.
Båda institutionernas framställningar da: Both institutional accounts date Gwangjong's introduction of the examination system to 958. This dates the reform, not every later examination practice. Silla had an earlier examination tradition; no day or month is assigned.
Båda kronologierna placerar Huayna Capac: Both chronologies place Huayna Capac alive after 1500. The discrepancy between 1527 and 1528 as the year of death remains an uncertainty; no exact date of death is used.
Båda källorna anger 861 för bygget under: Both sources supply 861 for construction under al-Mutawakkil. The ministry gives 247 AH and Archnet gives 246–247 AH; their original calendar labels are retained without an independent conversion. This dates the structure, not the invention of Nile-level measurement or all later alterations.
Båda källorna daterar huvudbyggnaden til: Both sources date the main building to AD 1154. Their paired Hijri labels differ: 549 AH in the museum record and 548 AH in Archnet. The date applies to the main building, not the later extension or every medical activity described.
Båda källorna placerar honom först i tro: Both sources place him first in the succession before 800, despite al-Maʾmun being older. They give 792 and 791–792 respectively.
Båtbilder dyker upp i skandinavisk konst: Boat images appear in Scandinavian art
CHamorus möter Magellans expedition på M: CHamorus encounter Magellan's expedition in the Mariana Islands in March 1521. The islanders trade food with the crew while violence breaks out.
Caesar korsar Rubicon och går in i konfl: Caesar crosses the Rubicon and enters into conflict with the Senate's forces. Pompey sides with the Senate and soon leaves Italy.
Caesar korsar Rubicon och inbördeskriget: Caesar crosses the Rubicon and civil war breaks out
Caesar landstiger i Britannien och återv: Caesar lands in Britain and returns the following year with a larger force. The second expedition crosses the Thames and forces Cassivellaunus to seek peace.
Caesar leder två expeditioner till Brita: Caesar leads two expeditions to Britain
Caesar surrounds Alesia with fortifications. An attempt to relieve the town fails, and Vercingetorix surrenders.
Caesars armé besegrar de senatstrogna st: Caesar's army defeats the senatorial forces under Pompey. The battle changes the balance of power in the Roman civil war.
Caesars kalenderreform inför ett solår m: Caesar's calendar reform introduces a solar year of 365 days with a leap-year adjustment. It replaces the earlier Roman calendar's irregular adjustment to the seasons.
Cahokia och Mississippidalen, Nordamerik: Cahokia and the Mississippi Valley, North America
Cahokia vid Mississippi, nuvarande Illin: Cahokia on the Mississippi, present-day Illinois, USA
Cahokias invånare anlägger stora jordhög: Cahokia's inhabitants construct large earthen mounds and plan new residential neighbourhoods around 1050. They change the city's buildings, tools and pottery during a period of rapid growth.
Cai Lun utvecklar och standardiserar mat: Cai Lun develops and standardises materials and methods for making paper.
Canggalinskriften dokumenterar kung Sanj: The Canggal inscription records King Sanjaya's dedication of a linga on Sthirangga hill for the safety and welfare of his people. Klokke identifies it as Central Java's first dated inscription, making it an important early record of royal religious patronage in the region.
Cao Cao för Hanhovet till Xu: Cao Cao brings the Han court to Xu
Cao Pi inför ett system med nio ranggrad: Cao Pi establishes a system of nine ranks
Cao Pi tar Östra Hans tron: Cao Pi takes the Eastern Han throne
Capetingerna ger kungens son företräde g: The Capetians give the king’s son precedence through dynastic succession; the game’s primogeniture simplifies designation, coronation and the historical male line.
Caracalla låter bygga ett stort badkompl: Caracalla commissions a large bath complex
Caracallas edikt Constitutio Antoniniana: Caracalla’s edict, the Constitutio Antoniniana, grants Roman citizenship to the empire’s free inhabitants. It does not end slavery.

Datumet gäller det kungliga grundläggnin: The date refers to the royal foundation charter and claims no first day of teaching or imperial coronation.

Dekor med koboltblå färg under glasyren: Decoration in cobalt blue beneath the glaze becomes popular on Chinese porcelain. Objects are made both for the Yuan court and for trade.

Demetrios belägrar Rhodos utan att inta: Demetrius besieges Rhodes without capturing the city.
Den almohadiske kalifen Yaqub al-Mansur: The Almohad caliph Yaqub al-Mansur defeats Alfonso VIII of Castile at Alarcos in 1195. Alfonso confronts him at one of Castile's fortified positions against the Almohads.

Den assyriske kungen Sanherib intar och: The Assyrian king Sennacherib captures and destroys Babylon. The event becomes highly significant in later Assyrian and Babylonian narratives. The source traditions differ concerning the destruction of the city's sanctuaries.

Den exakta landstigningsplatsen är osäke: The exact landing site is uncertain; the account consulted mentions Guam or Rota.

Den jurchenske ledaren Aguda antar kejsa: The Jurchen leader Aguda assumes the imperial title and establishes a new dynastic state. Historians of the Jin Empire and modern researchers give different years for the imperial proclamation.
Den kinesiske resenären Zhou Daguan vist: The Chinese traveller Zhou Daguan stays in Cambodia and describes life around Angkor. His account covers, among other things, court hierarchy, trade and everyday customs.

Den persiske kungen Kyros II, den store,: The Persian king Cyrus II, the Great, lays the foundation of the Achaemenid empire by overthrowing Media, Lydia and the Babylonian empire in turn.
Den persiske kungen Xerxes mördas tillsa: The Persian king Xerxes is murdered together with his son Darius. Artaxerxes I succeeds him as ruler.

Den romerska senaten reglerar deltagande: The Roman Senate regulates participation, offices and gatherings within the cult of Bacchus. The decree is distributed to towns in Italy.
Den saitiske härskaren Psamtik I återupp: The Saite ruler Psamtik I reasserts control over southern Egypt, where Thebes is the dominant centre. The event unites the country under Dynasty 26 after the preceding division.
Den senare historieskrivningen anger att: Later historiography states that Silla is founded with Gyeongju as its centre. The museum's account distinguishes this tradition from the much later development into a centralised kingdom.
Den thebanske kungen Ahmose I återförena: The Theban king Ahmose I reunites Egypt and founds Dynasty 18, the first dynasty of the New Kingdom. His successors, Thutmose III in particular, extend Egyptian influence through the Levant to the borders of the Hittite empire.

Den umayyadiske prinsen Abd al-Rahman I: The Umayyad prince Abd al-Rahman I establishes his rule in al-Andalus. He makes Córdoba his capital.

Den vetenskapliga översikten använder sp: The scholarly survey uses the range 1315–1322 for the most severe period. The entry establishes no shared mortality rate or identical local development every year.

Det bevarade senatsbeslutet skiljs från: The surviving senatorial decree is distinguished from Livy's later account. Allegations of an actual conspiracy are not established.
Det boiotiska förbundets styrkor besegra: Forces of the Boeotian Confederation defeat the Spartan army led by King Cleombrotus at Leuctra.
Det buddhistiska templet Hōryūji grundas: The Buddhist temple Hōryūji is established in the Asuka region. The Met describes the compound as Japan's earliest extant Buddhist temple, containing the world's oldest surviving wooden structure.
Det citerade offentliga utdraget och sam: The cited public extract and abstract give 137 for the revision and publication of the municipal tariff. Older regulations included in the inscription belong to earlier years. No month or day is supplied by these passages.

Det fullständiga datumet återges från mu: The full date is reproduced from the museum's historical overview. No separate calendar conversion is made.
Det första kriget hålls isär från fälttå: The first war is kept separate from the campaign of 105–106.
Det första palatset och flera delar av M: The first palace and several parts of Malia are destroyed. Remains in the Mu Quarter indicate a fierce fire that causes the brick walls to collapse. Whether the palace is rebuilt immediately after the destruction is uncertain.
