Det mykenska palatset i Pylos, det bäst: The Mycenaean palace at Pylos, the best preserved of its kind, thrives. Its clay Linear B tablets suggest a king at the head of a highly organised feudal system.
Det offentliga abstractet anger året för: The public abstract gives the year of the revolt's suppression.
Det persiska sändebudet Abd al-Razzaq nå: The Persian envoy Abd al-Razzaq reaches Hampi in April 1443. He describes Vijayanagara's court and urban life in his travel account.
Det polska historiska museet anger att d: The Polish History Museum states that the written sources lack an exact day. The range preserves the alternative years 966 and 968.
Det spanska skyddsbeslutet anger 936. De: The Spanish protection decree gives 936. The archaeological report preserves the alternatives 936 and 940, which the range reflects.
Det spanska sändebudet Ruy González de C: The Spanish envoy Ruy González de Clavijo visits Samarkand in 1404. He describes the city's trade and crafts and goods from several parts of Asia.
Det tidiga Zhouriket i norra Kina: The early Zhou realm in northern China
Det tidigare Liaorikets nordvästra områd: The former Liao Empire's northwestern regions, the Mongolian steppe
Det tidigare självständiga riket blir en: The formerly independent kingdom becomes part of the Roman province of Arabia under Trajan.
Det ungefärliga födelseåret före startda: The approximate birth year before the start date and the evidence for later life provide the placement. Uncertainty in the early dating remains; the death years 1532 and 1533 fall after the start date.
Detta daterar trohetsederna om tronföljd: This dates the succession oaths, not Ashurbanipal's accession. Barcina distinguishes the oath-takers named in tablets from citizens mentioned in correspondence. The article's interpretation of the king's hidden motives is not treated as established fact.
Detta daterar utfärdandet av reformen, v: This dates promulgation of the reform, whose principles and methods had earlier antecedents. It does not date a sudden universal change in payment practice or establish that the reform reduced taxpayers' burdens.
Detta följer museets ungefärliga daterin: This follows the museum's approximate date for the Sopara fragment of edict IX. It does not date all Ashokan inscriptions, a missionary's arrival or a conversion. The surviving text records prescribed conduct, not how widely the instructions were followed.
Detta är Carsons hela arkeologiska fas,: This is Carson's complete archaeological phase, not a precisely dated foundation or a claim that every activity began in 1100 BC. Earlier occupation in 1500–1100 BC and the later shift toward inland areas remain separate. Rock-art production is not assigned an exact year.
Detta är de publicerade spannen för skat: These are published spans of the Treasury records, not a reform's start and end. Hallock gives Darius I's year 30 through Artaxerxes I's year 7 as 492–458 BC; Garrison's publisher gives 492–457. The full envelope preserves both endpoints without assuming uninterrupted payments.
Detta är forskarnas sammanfattade uppska: This is the researchers' summary estimate of the beginning of settlement. The oldest sample's calibrated two-sigma range is 3360–3028 BC; the entire early layer has a broader estimate of 3400–2700 BC.
Dezong har tagit bodhisattvalöftena unde: Dezong has taken the bodhisattva vows under Daocheng at the royal Zhangjing Temple in Chang’an.
Dhammazedi sänder en beskickning till Sr: Dhammazedi sends a mission to Sri Lanka, leading Pegu's monastic community to adopt Sinhalese-style ordination. A new ordination ground named Kalyani is established in Pegu the following year.
Dias seglar runt Afrikas sydspets: Dias sails around Africa's southern tip
Diktsamlingar samt verk om grammatik och: Poetry collections and works on grammar and rhetoric are compiled in Tamil Nadu.
Diocletianus inleder sin regering som ro: Diocletian begins his reign as Roman emperor.
Diocletianus lämnar kejsarämbetet. Kroat: Diocletian relinquishes the imperial office. Croatia’s nomination proposal dates his abdication to 305.
Djingis khan för krig mot Khwarazm: Genghis Khan wages war against Khwarazm
Djingis khan inleder ett långvarigt fält: Genghis Khan begins a prolonged campaign against the Khwarazmian realm after the killing of his envoys. The Mongols conquer and plunder cities in Central Asia and Iran.
Djingis khan leder ett fälttåg mot tangu: Genghis Khan leads a campaign against the Tanguts' Xia state in northwestern China. He obtains concessions on trade and returns to Mongolia.
Djingis khans trupper intar området krin: Genghis Khan's troops capture the area around present-day Beijing in a campaign against the Jin dynasty. The Jin rulers continue to rule farther south.
Djurben från undersökta stäppbosättninga: Animal bones from excavated steppe settlements north of the Black Sea suggest that around 3100 BC the inhabitants began focusing livestock husbandry chiefly on cattle. Sheep and goats were present as supplementary livestock, and the proportion of bones from wild animals became small. This is an interpreted regional change in subsistence; the source gives no common year for such a shift.
Djurben tyder på ökad inriktning på nötk: Animal bones suggest an increased focus on cattle north of the Black Sea
Djurstilen utvecklas i den skytiska kons: The Animal Style develops in Scythian art. The Scythians, who migrate from the Altai Mountains to the Black Sea region, depict the leopards, deer and eagles of their homeland as animals leaping, running and blending into each other; some of the best-known works are gold hammered over a carved matrix.
Dokumenterad person; spelvärden är gener: Documented person; game values are generated
The document is dated to 16 June 250. This dates a signed request for confirmation; the original edict’s date of issue is not established here.
Domitianus dödas efter sammansvärjningar: Domitian is killed after conspiracies and executions during his reign.
Dong Zhuo griper makten i Luoyang: Dong Zhuo seizes power in Luoyang
Dossiern anger 22 juni för slaget. Maked: The dossier gives 22 June for the battle. Macedonia's later political division is a separate event.
Drakons lag om dödande får sin tradition: Draco's homicide law receives its traditional date
Drottning och part i kungens äktenskapst: Queen and party to the king’s marriage dispute
Drowers äldre framställning anger omkrin: Drower's older account gives about 1200 BC; Callot and Yon give around 1190/1180 BC. Callot later calls 1180 indicative and discusses estimates around 1190–1185. These bounds collect differing approximations, not a twenty-year duration. The exact date and whether destruction occurred in one episode or several remain uncertain.
Dunhuang, Kina; en sogdisk familjs brevv: Dunhuang, China; correspondence within a Sogdian family
Dvornik anger uttryckligen 863 för missi: Dvornik explicitly gives 863 for the mission's arrival, and Vlasto dates the emperor's dispatch of the mission to the same year. No source here gives an exact day of arrival.
Dynastin utser arvingar och har också by: The dynasty appoints heirs and has also replaced a designated son and elected a caliph; neither the game’s automatic primogeniture nor the council’s purely merit-based selection represents this.
EFA placerar byggandet vid början av mel: The EFA places construction at the beginning of Middle Minoan II, around 1800 BC. This is an approximate archaeological date.
Eaton anger regeringsstart 1493, medan B: Eaton gives the start of the reign as 1493, while Banglapedia dates his election as sultan to 1494.
Eblas palatsstat under tredje årtusendet: Ebla’s palace state in the third millennium BC
Edward III placerar sin armé på en höjd: Edward III positions his army on a hill near Crécy and waits for Philip VI's forces. English archers help repel the attacks and win the battle.
Edward III:s armé besegrar fransmännen v: Edward III's army defeats the French at Crécy
Edward, den svarte prinsen, besegrar Joh: Edward, the Black Prince, defeats John II's French army at Poitiers. John surrenders and is taken into English captivity.
Edwards redovisar 238 i den bevarade Wei: Edwards gives 238 in the surviving Wei zhi text and 239 in the quotation in Nihon shoki. Kyushu National Museum uses 239. Yamatai’s location is disputed.
Efialtes begränsar Areopagens makt: Ephialtes curtails the power of the Areopagus
Efialtes överför ytterligare befogenhete: Ephialtes transfers additional powers from the Areopagus to the council, assembly and courts. The change strengthens the democratic institutions of Athens.
Efter Akkadrikets sammanbrott styr lokal: After the Akkadian Empire's collapse, local rulers govern several independent and rival city-states in Mesopotamia. The museums' overviews give different chronological frameworks for the collapse.
Efter Amenemhat IV härskar Sobekneferu ö: After Amenemhat IV, Sobekneferu rules Egypt in her own right. She uses full royal titulary and royal attributes in representations of her power.
Efter Han Wudis erövring organiseras Nan: Following Han Wudi's conquest, Nanyue is organized into nine prefectures.
Efter Kristian II:s kröning avrättas bis: After Christian II's coronation, bishops, nobles and members of Stockholm's municipal leadership are executed. The executions take place in Stortorget.
Efter Theodosius död år 395 ligger styre: After Theodosius’s death in 395, Arcadius governs in the east and Honorius in the west.
Efter att befälet i öster överförts till: After command in the east is transferred to Marius, Sulla leads his soldiers against Rome. He enters by force and overturns his opponents' political decisions.
Efter att ha efterträtt Cao Cao tar Cao: After succeeding Cao Cao, Cao Pi takes the throne from the Eastern Han emperor and establishes Wei's imperial claim.
Efter en konflikt möts Chandragupta Maur: After a conflict, Chandragupta Maurya and Seleucus meet to make peace by the Indus.
Efter erövringen av Shang ställs Zhou in: Following its conquest of Shang, Zhou faces and suppresses the Wu Geng rebellion. Christopher links the revolt to a change in how Zhou rulers control their eastern conquests.
Efter ett ras bygger människor vid Ness: After a collapse, people at the Ness of Brodgar rebuild Structure 10. The project's archaeologists date the collapse and rebuilding to around 2800 BC. They describe the rebuilt structure as more oriented towards domestic use.
Efter mordet på Filip II blir Alexander: After the assassination of Philip II, Alexander becomes king of Macedonia.
Efter nederlaget mot Sparta införs de tr: After defeat by Sparta, the oligarchic rule of the Thirty is imposed in Athens under Spartan pressure.
Efter nya förlustbringande fälttåg beord: After further costly campaigns, the emperor orders a retreat.
Efter sultan Nasiruddin Mahmuds död över: After Sultan Nasiruddin Mahmud's death, Balban takes the throne in Delhi. He has previously played a leading role in the government of the realm.
Efter utebliven betalning vägrar arbetar: After payment fails to arrive, the workers of Deir el-Medina refuse to continue working in the necropolis. The surviving Strike Papyrus describes grain rations that were not delivered and the workers’ demands for payment.
Efter år av fälttåg når hettiterriket, s: After years of campaigning, the Hittite empire, ruled from Hattusha (Boğazköy), reaches its greatest extent in central and southeastern Anatolia and in lands to the south bordering Egyptian territory. Its ruler Shuppiluliuma I is both a general and a builder of large stone structures with reliefs.
Egypten och Meroës rike i Nubien: Egypt and the kingdom of Meroë in Nubia
Egypten och Punt vid södra Röda havet; P: Egypt and Punt near the southern Red Sea; Punt’s exact location is uncertain
Egypten, med ojämn kontroll mellan olika: Egypt, with uneven control across different areas
Egypten; inskriftens fälttågsberättelse: Egypt; the inscription's campaign narrative concerns the southern Levant
Egypten; möjliga tekniska förbindelser m: Egypt; possible technological connections with western Asia
Egypten; ursprunglig placering i Abusir: Egypt; the original location at Abusir or Coptos is uncertain
Egyptens antikvitetsmyndighet daterar Un: Egypt's antiquities authority dates Unas to around 2375–2345 BC; the Metropolitan Museum gives around 2353–2323 BC in its 1999 chronology. The years refer to the king's reign. The sources establish no individual year when the craftspeople carved the texts, and the range does not indicate the duration of the work.
Egyptens härskare för samman Övre och Ne: Egypt's rulers bring Upper and Lower Egypt together through a gradual process. Egypt's Ministry of Antiquities associates one of the final phases with King Narmer, who wears the crowns of both regions on his palette. The ministry dates political unification to around 3100 BC, while the Oxford project's survey gives around 3000 BC. Researchers therefore cannot link the entire process to a certain year.
Egyptens härskare samlar Övre och Nedre: Egypt's rulers unite Upper and Lower Egypt
Egyptiska och hettitiska arméer möts vid: Egyptian and Hittite armies meet at Kadesh
Einhard ger inget år. Hon nämns före Liu: Einhard gives no year. She is mentioned before Liutgard, but that does not show that she was born by 800.
Einhard säger allmänt att döttrarna rest: Einhard says generally that the daughters travelled with Charles. No source places her in Rome or Aachen on the bookmark date.
Einhards kapitel 19 anger att Karl förlo: Einhard’s chapter 19 states that Charles lost three children and does not name her among them. Chapter 20 shows that the list of children is incomplete. The sources name no surviving daughter. Her location is not attested.
Eirene styr ensam sedan hon avsatte Kons: Irene has ruled alone since deposing Constantine VI in 797. She supports the veneration of images, restored by the Council of Nicaea in 787. The adviser Aetios belongs to her inner circle.
Eirene stödde patriarken Tarasios och åt: Irene supported Patriarch Tarasios and the restoration of the veneration of images; Tarasios held the patriarchal office during 784–806.
Eirene tog ensam makten från sin son och: Irene took sole power from her son and later fell to a palace coup; neither primogeniture nor a council’s merit-based choice describes this sequence.
Elam angriper Eshnunna i förbund med Bab: Elam attacks Eshnunna in alliance with Babylon and Mari. The source also considers Larsa’s involvement possible.
Elamiter och deras allierade från Susian: Elamites and their allies from Susiana capture Ur under Kindattu's leadership. They take King Ibbi-Sin to Elam as a prisoner and bring Ur's realm to an end.
Elamitiska angrepp leder till kassitdyna: Elamite attacks bring down the Kassite dynasty
Elcanos expedition fullbordar resan runt: Elcano's expedition completes the voyage around the world
Elefantine, Egypten; petitionen ställd t: Elephantine, Egypt; petition addressed to the governor of Judah
Eliten bor på Mapungubweberget: The elite live on Mapungubwe Hill
Elitens släktallianser, kandidaternas fö: Elite kinship alliances, candidates’ abilities and ritual approval form part of historians’ interpretations of the succession. Neither primogeniture nor the game’s merit rule represents the disputed arrangements.
Eloaua, Mussauöarna i nuvarande Papua Ny: Eloaua, Mussau Islands, in present-day Papua New Guinea
Emir och abbasidisk guvernör i Ifriqiya: Emir and Abbasid governor in Ifriqiya
Emiren Abd al-Rahman I bekostar byggande: Emir Abd al-Rahman I funds the construction of the Great Mosque of Córdoba. He has it built in his capital in al-Andalus.
En akademi vid huvudstaden undervisar i: An academy at the capital teaches Confucian classics and prepares students for official posts.
En andra invasionsflotta angriper Japan: A second invasion fleet attacks Japan
En arameisk inskrift daterar den senare: An Aramaic inscription dates the later building phase to 244/45. The earlier conversion from a house is not counted as a new event here.
En arameisk petition från Yedaniah och h: An Aramaic petition by Yedaniah and fellow priests asks Bagohi, governor of Judah, to support rebuilding the temple of Yahu at Elephantine. They seek the resumption of offerings and describe the earlier attack on their sanctuary.
En assyrisk armé under Assurbanipal plun: An Assyrian army under Ashurbanipal sacks Thebes in southern Egypt. The attack strikes one of the country's major religious cities. The sources used differ by one year in their dating.
En avskrift av Sang Hyang Siksa Kandang: A copy of Sang Hyang Siksa Kandang Karesian is made on gebang palm leaves in West Java. Its Old Sundanese text preserves social and moral guidance alongside knowledge of daily life and religious ideas.
En beskickning från Bagdad, med Ibn Fadl: An embassy from Baghdad, with Ibn Fadlan among its members, travels across the steppe to the land of the Volga Bulgars in 922. The ruler Jafar ibn Abdallah receives them in the area around the confluence of the Volga and Kama.
En betydande person begravs i Kuntur Was: An important individual is buried at Kuntur Wasi in a shaft tomb with a crown of hammered sheet gold about seven inches high, hung with fourteen human-head dangles. Ceramics from the site resemble contemporary Cupisnique wares of the north coast.
En betydande person begravs med en guldk: An important individual is buried with a gold crown at Kuntur Wasi
En bevarad mynningsskärva från Harappa b: A surviving rim sherd from Harappa bears three incised signs. The object text on Harappa.com dates the sherd to around 2800 BC and assigns it to the Early Harappan Kot Diji phase.
En bosättning växer fram vid Jenné-jeno: A settlement develops at Jenné-jeno in the Inland Niger Delta. Sources differ on its beginning; the dating does not mean that a fully developed city already exists.
En brand förstör byggnadskomplex DD i Zi: A fire destroys Building Complex DD at Zincirli
En buddhastaty i förgylld brons tillverk: A gilded bronze Buddha statue is made under Later Zhao
En egyptisk segerinskrift från Merneptah: An Egyptian victory inscription from Merneptah's reign mentions Israel among the defeated groups. It is the earliest known extrabiblical written attestation of the name. The writing designates a people rather than a city; the text presents royal victory propaganda.
En fartygsbesättning för bort elva män f: A ship's crew takes eleven men away from Guam
En fornsundanesisk vägledning skrivs av: An Old Sundanese guide is copied in West Java
En gemensam styrka från Yuan och Goryeo: A combined force from Yuan and Goryeo attacks islands and coastal settlements in northern Kyushu. The expedition withdraws without conquering Japan.
En grav med fyra kammare i Zeng tar emot: A four-chamber tomb at Zeng receives Marquis Yi's burial, bronze bells, stone chimes and other instruments. The central chamber's instruments and ritual vessels are interpreted as recreating part of the court's ceremonial setting.
En gravinskrift i Mleiha nämner en ämbet: A funerary inscription at Mleiha names an official serving the king of Oman. The text in South Arabian and Aramaic provides evidence of a kingdom in southeastern Arabia.
En grupp kardinaler i Fondi väljer Rober: A group of cardinals in Fondi elects Robert of Geneva as pope under the name Clement VII. They oppose the election of Urban VI, and the Church's territories of obedience divide between rival popes.
En grupp mexika grundar Tlatelolco: A group of Mexica found Tlatelolco
En grupp mexika lämnar tenochkerna och g: A group of Mexica leaves the Tenochca and founds Tlatelolco farther north. The inhabitants build their own community beside Tenochtitlan.
En grönstensplatta med datumet 8 Vass ma: A greenstone slab bearing the date 8 Reed marks an expansion of the main shrine in Tenochtitlan. The Met renders this year as 1487.
En hantverkare formar ett ansikte i nefr: A craftsperson shapes a face in nephrite
En hantverkare gör ett klubbhuvud med tj: A craftsperson makes a mace head with bull heads
En hantverkare gör ett marmorkärl med fy: A craftsperson makes a marble vessel with four lugs
En hantverkare i Mesopotamien tillverkar: A craftsperson in Mesopotamia makes a marble mace head with two bull heads. The Metropolitan Museum attributes object 49.23.3 to Sumerian culture and dates it to around 2900–2700 BC.
En hantverkare inom Valdiviakulturen til: A craftsperson of the Valdivia culture makes a small human figure in stone in present-day Ecuador. The Metropolitan Museum dates the seven-centimetre-high example, object 1980.83.16, to around 3000 BC. The figures' exact function is unknown.
En hantverkare skapar en stenfigur i Ecu: A craftsperson creates a stone figure in Ecuador
En hantverkare snidar ett människoansikt: A craftsperson carves a human face in a nephrite ornament. Small drilled holes may have allowed the user to attach the object to fabric.
En hantverkare tillverkar den kniv som a: A craftsperson makes the knife that archaeologists later find at Linjia in Dongxiang. Jianjun Mei dates the knife to around 2800 BC and reports the laboratory analysis identifying the material as tin bronze.
En hantverkare tillverkar en kniv av ten: A craftsperson makes a tin-bronze knife
En hantverkare tillverkar ett marmorkärl: A craftsperson makes a marble vessel with a high foot and four lugs. The Metropolitan Museum attributes object 1995.604 to Cycladic culture and dates it to around 2800–2700 BC.
En hantverkare tillverkar ett metallarmb: A craftsperson makes a metal bracelet that archaeologists later find in a child's grave at Yarim Tepe. The Metropolitan Museum dates the bracelet to around 2800 BC. The museum's prose calls the material bronze, while the object details give copper.
En inskrift belägger en kung av Oman: An inscription attests a king of Oman
En inskrift från Lobu Tua dokumenterar e: An inscription from Lobu Tua records a meeting of the Tamil merchant association known as the Five Hundred at Barus. It documents organized overseas commerce at a Sumatran port associated with the camphor and benzoin trade.
En inskrift på malajiska, skriven med ja: An inscription in Malay, written in Jawi script, sets out Islamic legal rules in Terengganu. Its provisions address debt, religious dues and sexual conduct, while its precise date remains disputed.
En inskrift utfärdad av Panangkaran ange: An inscription issued by Panangkaran states that land in the village of Kalaśa receives sīma status for the upkeep of a sanctuary to Tārā. The Sanskrit text is dated in the article to 700 Śaka, rendered as 778.
En inskrift vid Sewu vittnar om dyrkan a: An inscription at Sewu attests to the worship of Mañjuśrī
En inskrift vid Vidisha nämner Heliodoro: An inscription at Vidisha names Heliodorus, envoy of the Indo-Greek king Antialkidas, and his dedication to Vasudeva at Bhagabhadra's court.
En jordbävning och en tsunami drabbar de: An earthquake and tsunami strike parts of the Mediterranean. Thommen’s summary names Mothone and Alexandria among the affected places.
En jordbävning och tsunami drabbar Nanka: An earthquake and tsunami strike the Nankai region
En jordbävning och tsunami drabbar nordö: An earthquake and tsunami strike northeastern Japan
En kanal för spannmålstransporter förbin: A canal for grain transport connects the Xiang and Li rivers. It links the river systems of central and southern China.
En keramiker tillverkar en vit fotbägare: A potter makes a white stemmed cup
En keramiker tillverkar ett målat lerkär: A potter makes a painted earthenware vessel
A potter makes a painted earthenware vessel that the museum attributes to the Indus civilisation. The museum places the object in the area that is now Pakistan.
En konstnär avbildar Enheduanna på en st: An artist depicts Enheduanna on a stone disc
En konstnär hugger en offerscen på en sk: An artist carves an offering scene on a disc of white calcite. On the other side, someone engraves an inscription naming Enheduanna, Sargon's daughter.
En kopparapparat signalerar jordbävninga: A copper device signals earthquakes by dropping balls from dragons’ heads.
En kraftig jordbävning eller en följd av: A powerful earthquake or a sequence of shocks damages Sparta and its surroundings. Ancient accounts differ in their dating, and no secure death toll can be given.
En kraftig jordbävning får borgbyggnader: A powerful earthquake causes castle buildings, storehouses and walls at Taga to collapse in 869. A tsunami reaches the town below the castle. Researchers have found deposits from Miyagi to northern Fukushima that they judge to be from this tsunami.
En kraftig jordbävning och tsunami drabb: A powerful earthquake and tsunami strike the Nankai region. The Taiheiki recounts destruction at Yuki's harbour in Awa.
En kunglig guru bekostar Banteay Srei: A royal guru funds Banteay Srei
En kunglig guru bekostar templet Banteay: A royal guru funds the temple of Banteay Srei around 967. The builders use pink sandstone and laterite and erect the central shrine for Shiva.
En kunglig inskrift dokumenterar arbete: A royal inscription records work on the Waringin Sapta embankment and assigns local revenue and maintenance responsibilities to sustain it. The measure addresses flooding along the Brantas, linking water management with farming and river transport.
En kupp för Jungjong till tronen: A coup brings Jungjong to the throne
En kvinna får kopparredskap med sig i gr: A woman is given copper tools in her grave at Kerma
En lag omfördelar offentlig jord till sm: A law redistributes public land to smallholders. A commission implements the reform, but opponents kill Tiberius in the political conflict.
En lyraformad megalit från Wanar dateras: A lyre-shaped megalith from Wanar dates to the eighth century
En mynningsskärva från Harappa bär tre i: A rim sherd from Harappa bears three incised signs
En nilometer byggs på ön Rawda på order: A nilometer is built on Rawda Island on the orders of Abbasid caliph al-Mutawakkil. Measuring the Nile's flood level helps officials prepare canals and dykes and assess agricultural productivity and taxes.
En ny dynasti tar makten i Etiopien: A new dynasty takes power in Ethiopia
En ny dynasti tar makten i Etiopien. Här: A new dynasty takes power in Ethiopia. The rulers claim descent from the biblical King Solomon.
En ny era knyts till Kanishkas första re: A new era is linked to Kanishka’s first regnal year. The date follows the interpretation of the authors whose works were read.
En ny gränslinje anläggs mellan Forth oc: A new frontier line is established between the Forth and the Clyde, north of Hadrian’s Wall.
En omfattande strid utkämpas i Tollensed: A major battle is fought in the Tollense Valley
En person begravd vid Aigyrzhal-3 tycks: A person buried at Aigyrzhal-3 appears to have eaten millet
En person som begravs vid Aigyrzhal-3 ha: A person buried at Aigyrzhal-3 has eaten large quantities of C4 plants, according to isotope analysis of the bones. Researchers interpret the food as probably broomcorn millet. The other individuals examined from the site have different dietary patterns.
En portugisisk beskickning sänds till Ay: A Portuguese embassy is sent to Ayutthaya around 1511. It requests trading rights in exchange for firearms and ammunition.
En rik silveråder upptäcks i Laurion. Th: A rich silver vein is discovered at Laurion. Themistocles persuades the assembly to use the revenue for triremes instead of distributing the entire windfall to the citizens.
En romersk expedition under Aelius Gallu: A Roman expedition under Aelius Gallus travels from Egypt to southern Arabia. The campaign is directed against the kingdom of Saba.
En romersk gränsbarriär byggs tvärs över: A Roman frontier barrier is built across northern Britain.
En romersk koloni grundas vid dagens Nar: A Roman colony is founded at present-day Narbonne.
En romersk militärkoloni anläggs vid Aur: A Roman military colony is established near the Aurès Mountains with a regular street grid.
En sammanhållen stadskultur blomstrar i: An integrated urban culture flourishes in the northwest of South Asia. Large cities such as Mohenjo Daro and Harappa follow grid plans and prosper through trade with cultures to the west, while smaller settlements spread across the plains of present-day Pakistan and northern India. Seals from these sites carry a writing system that remains undeciphered.
En sanskritinskrift vid Junagadh minns r: A Sanskrit inscription at Junagadh commemorates repairs at Lake Sudarshana.
En senare dynastisk berättelse anger far: A later dynastic account names father, son and grandson without reign dates. It provides no secure succession sequence for 1200. Neither primogeniture nor election on ability therefore receives historical source support here.
En senare text anger Jingyuan-år 4, vilk: A later text gives Jingyuan year 4, which MacTutor converts to 263. Liu Hui did not date the commentary himself; the year is unconfirmed.
En sjöfararhandbok beskriver Aksums hand: A seafarers’ handbook describes Aksum’s trade
En skeppsgrav anläggs i Sutton Hoo: A ship burial is laid at Sutton Hoo
En skeppsgrav anläggs under en hög i Sut: A ship burial is laid under a mound at Sutton Hoo, with grave goods inside a wooden ship: an iron helmet with tinned bronze foil, gold buckles inlaid with niello and a purse cover with cloisonné enamel. No body has been found, perhaps because of the acid soil, and coins among the goods help date the burial.
En skulptör avbildar Sahure med en provi: A sculptor depicts Sahure with a provincial god
En skulptör hugger Sahure och Koptosprov: A sculptor carves Sahure and the god of the province of Coptos in gneiss. The god extends an ankh, the sign of life, towards the seated king.
En stamförsamling utropar Temudjin till: A tribal assembly proclaims Temujin ruler of the Mongols. He assumes the title Genghis Khan.
En stenhuggare skildrar Eannatums seger: A stonecarver depicts Eannatum's victory on a stela
En stenhuggare återger kung Eannatum av: A stonecarver depicts King Eannatum of Lagash and his soldiers on the so-called Stele of the Vultures. A scribe describes the king's victory over the neighbouring city of Umma in a Sumerian inscription.
En stor brand förstör palatset i Pylos o: A major fire destroys the palace at Pylos, and the hill of Ano Englianos is abandoned. The destruction marks the end of an important Mycenaean administrative centre in Messenia.
En svår epidemi sprids från Pireus in i: A severe epidemic spreads from Piraeus into Athens during the war. Thucydides describes many deaths and how overcrowding worsens people's vulnerability.
En tamilsk inskrift dokumenterar Samband: A Tamil inscription records Sambandapperumal's installation of Shiva with written permission attributed to the Mongol ruler Chekachai Khan. The record documents Shaiva worship in the Chinese port and its connection with people using Tamil.
En tidigare general från Goguryeo grunda: A former Goguryeo general founds Barhae

A former Goguryeo general founds the kingdom of Barhae (Chinese: Bohai), which holds most of Goguryeo's former lands in Manchuria. Barhae and Unified Silla avoid war until the Khitan destroy Barhae in 926.
En väg börjar byggas mellan Rom och Capu: Construction begins on a road between Rome and Capua under Appius Claudius Caecus.
En vägbank gör det möjligt att angripa ö: A causeway makes it possible to attack the island city of Tyre from the mainland. Alexander captures the city after a seven-month siege.
Encyklopedin Yongle dadian sammanställs: The encyclopedia Yongle dadian is compiled on the Yongle Emperor's orders. The work is dated to 1404–1407.
Englands makthavare försöker pressa till: England's rulers try to push wages back down
Englands makthavare inför en lag för att: England's rulers introduce a law to push wages back down after the plague. Workers have been able to demand more pay after so many people have died.
Englands regering erkänner Skottlands sj: England's government recognises Scotland's independence. Recognition comes after years of military and diplomatic struggle.
English Heritage anger omkring 2500 f.Kr: English Heritage gives around 2500 BC as the construction date. The source also reports a radiocarbon date linked to the outer stone circle, 2620–2470 BC, and one linked to the inner horseshoe, 2620–2340 BC. The year 2500 is the source's estimate; the ranges indicate neither an exact construction day nor the length of the work.
English Heritage daterar dödsfallet till: English Heritage dates the death to 4 February 211.
English Heritage placerar arbetet inom d: English Heritage places the work within this range and describes expansions over several generations. The range establishes neither an exact starting year nor uninterrupted work throughout the period.
Enligt Archaeological Survey of India be: According to the Archaeological Survey of India, Queen Lokamahadevi funds a temple to Shiva in Pattadakal. The agency derives a completion date around 740 from the inscription about Vikramaditya II's three victories over Kanchi.
Enligt Cohens kronologi upphör seleukide: According to Cohen's chronology, Seleucid rule over Judea ends.
Enligt ICOMOS tillkommer det stora flert: According to ICOMOS, the great majority of the geoglyphs are created during the Nasca phase. The lines and figures form part of a landscape with earlier predecessors.
Enligt Lorschannalerna upphöjs Pippin ti: According to the Annals of Lorsch, Pippin becomes king of the Franks in Soissons with papal support. The annals also recount that Childeric has his hair cut and is sent to a monastery.
Enligt Plinius bedriver indonesiska utri: According to Pliny, Indonesian outrigger boats trade along Africa’s east coast.
Enligt Rients de Boer grundar Sumu-la-El: According to Rients de Boer, Sumu-la-El founds Babylon’s First Dynasty. After Sumu-abum’s death, he subjugates several neighbouring kings and builds a chain of fortresses around his territory.
Enligt Rients de Boer leder Sumu-abum am: According to Rients de Boer, Sumu-abum leads Amorite warriors who conquer large parts of northern Babylonia and the lower Diyala. His subordinates establish several smaller kingdoms in the wake of the conquests.
Enligt Sazonov återupptar Shulgi kulten: According to Sazonov, Shulgi restores the cult of divine kings, probably during the first half of his reign. Hymns and other texts portray him as divine and as a hero.
Enligt Turkiets förslag till UNESCO:s te: According to Türkiye’s submission to UNESCO’s Tentative List, Erishum I ends the state’s trade monopoly and allows private family businesses to conduct long-distance trade. The museum’s overview describes flourishing trade during his reign.
Enligt den kronologi som UNESCO återger: According to the chronology presented by UNESCO, King Pan Geng moves the Shang capital from Yan to Yin, near present-day Anyang. The site becomes an important royal centre during the later Shang period.
Enligt forskarnas kronologi inför migran: According to the researchers' chronology, migrants from the Mumun culture of southern Korea introduce wet-rice cultivation at Genkai Bay in northern Kyushu around 1000 BC. They encounter local communities with Jomon traditions. Change takes place at different rates in different parts of Japan.
Enligt krönikan får härskaren i Na i Wa: According to the chronicle, the ruler of Na in Wa receives a seal and ribbon from the Chinese emperor after an embassy.
Enligt mixtekiska kodexberättelser upprä: According to Mixtec codex narratives, the ruler Eight Deer Jaguar Claw establishes a new centre of power at Tututepec. In the Codex Colombino, his retinue brings sacred objects to the Temple of Heaven as part of his accession to power.
Enligt puraniska källor störtar generale: According to Puranic sources, the general Pushyamitra overthrows Brihadratha and founds the Shunga dynasty.
Enligt traditionen grundar feniciska kol: Tradition dates to 814 BC the founding of Carthage by Phoenician colonists from the Levant on the coast of present-day Tunisia. The local peoples are hostile and demand tribute from the colonists, including rent for their land, until the fifth century BC.
Ensam regering enligt Dumbarton Oaks; in: Sole reign according to Dumbarton Oaks; no exact days have been converted.
Epameinondas grundar Messene som huvudst: Epaminondas founds Messene as the capital of a free Messenian state after Spartan rule.
Erik av Pommern kröns i Kalmar till kung: Eric of Pomerania is crowned king of the Nordic kingdoms in Kalmar. The magnates remain after the ceremony to negotiate the form of the union.
Erik av Pommern kröns till gemensam kung: Eric of Pomerania is crowned common king in Kalmar
Erishum I tillåter familjeföretag att be: Erishum I allows family businesses to conduct long-distance trade
Erlitou växer till omkring 300 hektar un: Erlitou grows to around 300 hectares during phases II–IV. Builders construct large earthen platforms and courtyard complexes in the central part of the settlement.
Eshnunna i Diyaladalen, nuvarande Irak: Eshnunna in the Diyala Valley, present-day Iraq
Ett besökande fartyg handlar med öbor vi: A visiting ship trades with islanders at Guam in 1526. The captain takes eleven men away to work the ship's pumps and sails towards Mindanao.
Ett egyptiskt prästråd utfärdar det dekr: An Egyptian priestly council issues the decree preserved on the Rosetta Stone. The text affirms the king's cult and is recorded in three scripts.
Ett fartyg lastat med konstverk, lyxvaro: A ship carrying works of art, luxury goods and the Antikythera mechanism sinks off the island. Its varied cargo provides evidence of Mediterranean trade.
Ett försök till statskupp mot kejsar Wu: An attempted coup against Emperor Wu is followed by persecution of suspected participants. The events become known as the witchcraft scandal.
Ett handelsfartyg sjunker utanför Antiky: A merchant ship sinks off Antikythera
Ett judiskt uppror under Bar Kokhba utma: A Jewish revolt under Bar Kokhba challenges Roman rule.
Ett kejserligt edikt låter nyodlade risf: An imperial edict allows newly reclaimed rice fields to be held permanently, replacing the earlier time limit on possession. The area permitted depends on rank, and reclamation generally requires prior provincial authorization.
Ett kraftigt utbrott i Samalas släpper u: A powerful eruption at Samalas releases large quantities of volcanic gases into the stratosphere. Geochemical research concludes that these emissions were sufficient to produce the global cooling reported after the eruption.
Ett kungligt edikt belagt i Sopara beton: A royal edict attested at Sopara emphasizes moral duties. In the museum's translation, these include considerate treatment of slaves and servants, respect for elders, gentleness toward animals and generosity to Brahmanas and Shramanas.
Ett metallarmband hör till en barngrav v: A metal bracelet belongs to a child's grave at Yarim Tepe
Ett motstånd under Sillas ledning tvinga: Silla-led resistance forces Tang troops to withdraw into Manchuria. For the first time almost the whole Korean peninsula, all but a narrow band in the north, comes under one Korean government, Unified Silla.
Ett namnregister för vanliga personer un: A name register for ordinary people during the period has not been compiled. The names of documented rulers may not be used to create an invented household.
Ett nytt Parthenon börjar byggas på Aten: Construction of a new Parthenon begins on the Athenian Acropolis as part of Pericles' building programme. Iktinos and Kallikrates are the architects, while Pheidias directs the artistic decoration.
Ett nytt citadell byggs mellan floderna: A new citadel is built between the Ma and Buoi rivers. The large limestone blocks and the complex's location show a new direction in urban construction in the region.
Ett nytt uppror bryter ut bland förslava: Another revolt breaks out among enslaved people in Sicily
Ett palats byggs i Faistos: A palace is built at Phaistos
Ett portugisiskt fartyg når Pärlflodens: A Portuguese ship reaches the Pearl River estuary
A Portuguese ship reaches the Pearl River estuary in 1517. The voyage brings Portuguese mariners to China's coast.
Ett portugisiskt kungligt dekret kräver: A Portuguese royal decree demands the Christianisation of the Mbundu peoples in Ndongo. The museum's account also describes how the kingdom's leaders oppose the missionaries' activities.
Ett prästerligt dekret föreskriver att e: A priestly decree orders a festival day for Ptolemy and Berenice to be added every four years beyond the five extra days of the Egyptian year. The provision aims to keep festivals aligned with the seasons.
Ett prästråd bekräftar Ptolemaios V:s ku: A priestly council affirms Ptolemy V's royal cult
Ett råd godkände en efterträdare inom en: A council approved a successor from a limited circle of princes; merit is an uncertain game equivalent, and the kinship requirement needs to be preserved.
Ett stort kompendium om människans natur: A major compendium on human nature is published in 1417. It becomes a standard work for the civil service examinations.
Ett sändebud från Goryeo för med sig Kub: An envoy from Goryeo brings Kublai Khan's letter to Japan. The letter requests closer relations and hints that refusal may lead to violence.
Ett uppror skapar lokalt kungavälde i Öv: A revolt establishes local kingship in Upper Egypt
Ett utbrott vid Taranaki dateras till om: An eruption at Taranaki is dated to around 1500. Māori earth ovens lie on the volcano's slopes between ash layers from several eruptions.
Exakt datum är omstritt. Bond förordar i: The exact date is disputed. Bond argues for the interval 29–34; 30 and 33 are common proposals.
Exakt vistelseort på startdagen är okänd: Exact whereabouts on the start date are unknown.
Ezana antar kristendomen i Aksum. De två: Ezana adopts Christianity in Aksum. The two institutions date the king’s conversion differently; this event concerns the king and does not establish when the entire population became Christian.
Failaka, norra Persiska viken, nuvarande: Failaka, northern Persian Gulf, present-day Kuwait
Familjens senare maktinnehav räcker inte: The family’s later hold on power is insufficient to establish primogeniture as a historical law. Wives and several sons lack dated support in the consulted passages.
Fanshans gravfält, Liangzhu, Zhejiang, n: Fanshan cemetery, Liangzhu, Zhejiang, lower Yangzi region, China
Fatimiderna anlägger huvudstaden Sabra a: The Fatimids establish the capital Sabra al-Mansuriyya near Kairouan. They give the city a circular plan.
Fatimiderna erövrar Egypten och grundar: The Fatimids conquer Egypt and found Cairo
Fatimiderna erövrar Egypten år 969. De g: The Fatimids conquer Egypt in 969. They found Cairo, al-Qahira, as a new city for their rule.
Fatimiderna grundar al-Azhar som sin för: The Fatimids found al-Azhar as their first congregational mosque in Cairo. They build it in connection with the foundation of the new city.
Fatimiderna grundar ett eget kalifat i I: The Fatimids found their own caliphate in Ifriqiya in 909. They belong to the Ismaili branch of Shia Islam and compete with the Abbasids for leadership of the Muslim world.
Fatimiderna grundar ett kalifat i Nordaf: The Fatimids found a caliphate in North Africa
Felföldis engelska sammanfattning redovi: Felföldi's English summary lists five main dates proposed earlier, ranging from 554 to 567. His reconstruction begins in late 557 or early 558: the Persians finish their campaign in 561 and the Turks before the end of 568 or the beginning of 569. The interval 554–569 brings together these dates and limits; it indicates no continuous period of warfare and does not cover every divergent date mentioned in the study.
Feng Tao framställer en fullständig trät: Feng Tao produces a complete woodblock-printed edition of the Confucian classics during the years 932–953. The printers use woodblocks to reproduce the texts.
Feng Tao framställer en trätryckt utgåva: Feng Tao produces a woodblock-printed edition of the Confucian classics
Feng, Hao och Weiflodens dal i nuvarande: Feng, Hao and the Wei River valley in present-day China
Feniciska kolonister grundar Karthago, e: Phoenician colonists found Carthage, by tradition
Feodalt rike; skilda vasalljurisdiktione: A feudal kingdom; separate vassal jurisdictions are simplified. The boundaries are approximate.
Ferdinand Magellans flotta lämnar Sanlúc: Ferdinand Magellan's fleet leaves Sanlúcar de Barrameda. The aim is to reach the Spice Islands in the present-day Indonesian archipelago.
Ferdowsi anger att han har fullbordat Sh: Ferdowsi states that he has completed the Shahnameh, the Book of Kings, on the day that Iranica gives as 8 March 1010. In the poem he tells of Iran's kings and heroes.
Ferdowsi anger dagen Ard i månaden Esfan: Ferdowsi gives the day Ard in the month of Esfand. Iranica reproduces the calendar information and gives the equivalent 8 March 1010; no independent conversion has been made.
Ferdowsi daterar fullbordandet av Shahna: Ferdowsi dates the completion of the Shahnameh
Filip II regerar sedan 1180 och har sitt: Philip II has reigned since 1180 and has his court in Paris. His son Louis has married Blanche of Castile during the year. Philip seeks a divorce from Ingeborg, but Pope Innocent III opposes it. Following a reconciliation in September, the pope has lifted the year’s interdict. The marriage dispute continues.
Filip II:s styrkor förstör Olynthos, en: Philip II's forces destroy Olynthus, a central city of the Chalcidian League.
Filip VI angriper Edward III:s franska b: Philip VI attacks Edward III's French possessions
Filip VI av Frankrike angriper Edward II: Philip VI of France attacks Edward III's possessions in France. The kings thereby begin the territorial conflict later called the Hundred Years' War.
Filips vigsel med Agnes 1196 och hans be: Philip’s wedding to Agnes in 1196 and his continuing marriage dispute with Ingeborg require more legal relationship statuses than a single spouse record. The code indicates this limitation, not a canonically approved system of polygamy.
Flamininus romerska styrkor besegrar Fil: Flamininus's Roman forces defeat Philip V's Macedonian army in Thessaly.
Foguangtemplets östra hall byggs upp på: Foguang Temple's East Hall is rebuilt
Folk i Skandinavien och Östersjöområdet: Peoples of Scandinavia and the Baltic region begin to acquire bronze technology. With no local tin or copper, they expand long-distance trade with central and southern Europe, and amber becomes their most valuable export.
Folket i Chalcatzingo i centrala Mexikos: The people of Chalcatzingo in the central Mexican highlands reshape the natural landscape into broad terraces and carve ritual scenes in low relief on the living rock. Olmec-style ceramics appear at other highland centres such as Tlatilco and Las Bocas.
Fordham’s introduction gives 7 March 203. The religious account of martyrdom is treated as a narrative source.
Forskare har daterat trädhuggningen till: Researchers have dated the tree cutting to 1021. The year indicates an attested stay at the site; the Norse people's first arrival has no established year.
Forskarna anger detta intervall för Vila: The researchers give this interval for the radiocarbon-dated archaeological sequence in the Vilabouly area. They have investigated copper mines and smelting sites there. The interval provides neither an exact starting year for mining nor evidence of uninterrupted production throughout the period.
Forskarna anger detta som Uaxactuns sist: Researchers list this as Uaxactun's last monument date in their compilation.
Forskarna anger hela intervallet för de: The researchers give the full interval for the earliest iron finds at Pirak. The dating does not establish a single year when the inhabitants first used iron.
Forskarna använder 1000 f.Kr. som tidsan: The researchers use 1000 BC to date their Teouma example in the article's public abstract. The year gives an approximate context for the funerary practices. The source establishes neither the cemetery's first year nor its entire period of use.
Forskarna behåller både Barrafasen 1900–: The researchers retain both the Barra phase of 1900–1700 and the Locona phase of 1700–1500 BC because the vessel fragment lay in redeposited construction fill. The interval establishes no exact year of introduction.
Forskarna daterar den korta nedläggnings: Researchers date the brief deposition horizon to around 2900 BC. The pottery in the layer belongs to circa 2900–2800 BC. They interpret a connection with a climate crisis as a possibility.
Forskarna daterar expeditionen till omkr: Researchers date the expedition to around 1025. They distinguish it from a later inscription dated 1030–1031.
Forskarna daterar spåren efter den neoli: Researchers date the traces of Neolithic settlement to this approximate range. They establish neither a foundation year nor that people lived here without interruption throughout the period.
Forskarna förknippar Chimús dynastiska t: The scholars associate Chimú dynastic tradition with the moon and describe how the king’s kin tended his remains after death.
Forskarna placerar den slutliga avfolkni: Researchers place the final depopulation within a few years around 1280 and describe the social transformation as completed by 1285. Circa 1280 marks the process's final phase, not the beginning of all migration or the disappearance of the peoples.
Forskarna placerar grav M118 i fas A, da: Researchers place grave M118 in Phase A, dated to 2880–2700 calibrated BC. They give no individual year for the grave.
Forskarna placerar utvecklingen inom den: Researchers place the development within the full Late Bronze Age interval of 1500–1000 BC. The entry gives neither an exact foundation date for Kent nor a common building year.
Forskarna sammanfattar byggnadsförloppet: Researchers summarise the construction sequence as circa 1180–1200. The wall sample gives a range of 1172–1186 and the burial vault's coral fill 1197–1209; the interpretation assumes that the builders used coral harvested alive. The years date the monument and establish neither the first settlement nor an exact year for the island's political unification.
Forskarna skiljer arvet av kungens ämbet: The scholars distinguish inheritance of the king’s office from inheritance of his property and funerary cult but attest no rule for who was to succeed him in 1200.
Forskarna tolkar förändrade kolisotopvär: Researchers interpret changed carbon isotope values as increased millet consumption around 2900 BC. The dating is based on their model. The evidence establishes neither a first year of sowing nor the place where the millet is grown.
Forskarna tolkar större boplatshögar som: Researchers interpret larger settlement mounds as evidence of a transition to a more settled way of life around 1500 BC. Pearl millet cultivation belongs to a later stage, around 1200 BC.
Forskarna tolkar växtfynden vid Baodun s: Researchers interpret the plant finds at Baodun as traces of rice cultivation in watered fields and cultivation of foxtail millet on adjacent higher ground. The dating of the activity spans several centuries, and mixed layers make it difficult to link the plant remains to individual phases.
Forskningsförslag för spelreglerna; inge: Research proposal for the game rules; no historical legal text.
Forskningssammanfattningen anger cirka 3: The research abstract gives around 300 BC; Peru's tentative World Heritage submission gives around 250–200 BC. The outer bounds combine the dates and do not establish a hundred-year construction period.
Fotudeng anländer till Kinas centralslät: Fotudeng arrives on China’s Central Plain
Francis Geus daterar platsen till omkrin: Francis Geus dates the site to around 2700 BC based on radiocarbon. The section gives no calibrated range and no individual construction year for the pits.
Franciskanmunken Vilhelm av Rubruck rese: The Franciscan friar William of Rubruck travels through the Mongol Empire to Möngke's court. He describes the journey and encounters in an account for Louis IX.
Franke anger ett brett intervall för kol: Franke gives a broad radiocarbon dating interval. A beginning around 800 BC is possible but uncertain. The bounds express dating uncertainty and establish no continuous activity over 400 years.
Frankernas och langobardernas kung; krön: King of the Franks and Lombards; crowned emperor in Rome on the bookmark date
Frankrikes kulturministerium anger omkri: France’s Ministry of Culture gives around 330, while the Ashmolean Museum gives around 360. The interval’s endpoints represent these approximate alternatives, not a thirty-year conversion process.
Fransmännen häver belägringen av Orléans: The French lift the siege of Orléans
Fredens sjövillkor minskar Antiochos sjö: The treaty's naval terms reduce Antiochus's naval forces and limit where the permitted vessels may sail.
Från tredje århundradet f.Kr. och framåt: From the third century BC onward, most royal burials take place at Meroe.
Fujiwara no Yorimichi låter bygga Fenixh: Fujiwara no Yorimichi has the Phoenix Hall built
Fujiwara no Yorimichi låter uppföra en A: Fujiwara no Yorimichi has an Amida shrine built at Byōdōin in Uji. The builders place the hall on an island in the pond and furnish it with an image of Amida Buddha.
Fynd från Lahuradevas period III omfatta: Finds from Lahuradeva's period III include iron. The phase dates to 1300–1200 BC and forms part of the evidence discussed in studies of early iron use on the northern Indian plain.
Fyndens hela dateringsspann behålls; han: The finds’ full date range is retained; the trade route’s starting year is unknown.
Fyra härskare delar kejsarmakten: Diocle: Four rulers share imperial power: Diocletian and Maximian as senior emperors, and Galerius and Constantius as junior emperors.
Fyra riddare mördar Thomas Becket i Cant: Four knights murder Thomas Becket in Canterbury
Fyra riddare ur Henrik II:s hushåll döda: Four knights from Henry II's household kill Archbishop Thomas Becket in Canterbury Cathedral on 29 December 1170. Pilgrims begin to visit his tomb and venerate him as a martyr.
Födelsedatum och vistelseort den 31 dece: Her birth date and whereabouts on 31 December 1200 are unknown. Her role as the emperor’s mother is attested; her presence in Xingqing on the exact day remains uncertain.
The consulted sources provide no birth date. The year 1150 and 1 January are generated game values without a historical claim.
Födelsedatumet är ett genererat simuleri: The birth date is a generated simulation value without a historical claim. The source states that the birth year is unknown. The year 760 gives an adult regent at the bookmark.
Födelsedatumet är ett spelvärde. De kolo: The birth date is a game value. The colonial accounts give conflicting chronologies. No location or wife is associated with him with secure dating on the start date.
Födelseåret är inte fastslaget i de cite: The birth year is not established in the cited sources. Einhard and the annals differ on the age.
Födelseåret är ungefärligt. Den 1 januar: The birth year is approximate. The first of January is a game-specific day and lacks historical evidence.
Födelseåret är ungefärligt. Hennes exakt: The birth year is approximate. Her exact whereabouts on the bookmark date are unknown. No succession law is selected by altering historical family relationships.
Förbundsbrevet är daterat till början av: The Federal Charter is dated to early August 1291. Its status as a national founding document is a later interpretation, and no exact date of 1 August is inserted. The entry follows the charter's own dating; its origins have unresolved questions according to the source consulted.
Föremålstexten på Harappa.com anger omkr: The object text on Harappa.com gives around 2800 BC and the Kot Diji phase. The reading of the signs is not established in the text. The place where the signs were incised is not given.
Författare sammanställer tidiga puranate: Authors compile early Puranas about gods, seers, heroes and kings. The museum places this work in the fourth century AD; compilation continues in later centuries.
Författaren anger ett ungefärligt årtion: The author gives an approximate decade. The game uses 765 and 1 January as uncertain placeholders.
Författarna anger f.Kr.-dateringarna sjä: The authors supply the BC dates themselves. They discuss uncertainty about timing, geographical extent and coherence. The interval dates neither a state's collapse nor a single drought.
Författarna för pärlorna till tidiga för: The authors assign the beads to early objects around 3200 BC in late Namazga II; the abstract's broader framework is circa 3300–3000 BC. No individual radiocarbon dating is given. The material identification is based on comparisons with analysed finds from Altyn-depe; the beads from Kara-depe were not analysed in the study.
Förlagsbeskrivningen anger 101 f.Kr. för: The publisher's description gives 101 BC for the battle.
Förlagsbeskrivningen daterar detta slag: The publisher's description dates this battle separately from Vercellae the following year.
Förslavade människor gör på nytt uppror: Enslaved people again revolt against Rome in Sicily, with Salvius as their leader.
Förslavade människor intar Enna och gör: Enslaved people capture Enna and revolt under Eunus. Fighting against Rome continues for several years.
Förstörelsen innebär inget påstående om: The destruction does not imply that all later settlement ceased.
Försvararna vid Cheoin dödar den mongoli: The defenders at Cheoin kill the Mongol commander Saritai. Kim Yun-hu helps lead the resistance, but it is uncertain whether he himself shoots the fatal arrow.
Gaius Gracchus inför regelbunden spannmå: Gaius Gracchus introduces regular grain sales
Galambos identifierar Chunyou som Renxia: Galambos identifies Chunyou as Renxiao’s son and successor. Huanzong is his later temple name.
Galerius tillåter kristna att åter samla: Galerius permits Christians to assemble again for religious worship. In the reproduced text, he requires them to respect public order.
Gammalassyriska Assur och handelskolonie: Old Assyrian Assur and trading colonies
Gammalbabyloniska riket under första dyn: Old Babylonian Empire under the First Dynasty
Garnseys bok anger införandet 123 f.Kr.;: Garnsey's book dates the introduction to 123 BC; the earlier article places the law in the first tribunate, 123–122 BC.
Geigers abstract daterar hela upproret t: Geiger’s abstract dates the whole revolt to 132–136. Dates of individual objects are not used as the revolt’s end year.
Generalen An Lushan gör uppror mot kejsa: General An Lushan rebels against Emperor Xuanzong and tries to become emperor himself. The Tang dynasty survives the war but loses strength.

Germanska styrkor tillfogar den romerska: Germanic forces inflict a severe defeat on the Roman army.

Schrakamp and Zólyomi place archives from the times of Enentarzi, Lugalanda and Urukagina collectively in 2335–2315 BC. This later chronology does not date this particular cone. Getty gör TGN:s data tillgängliga enligt: Getty makes the TGN data available under ODC-By 1.0.
Getty gör alla data i sina vokabulärer,: Getty makes all data in its vocabularies, including TGN, available under ODC-By 1.0.
Getty och UNESCO identifierar Chan Chan: Getty and UNESCO identify Chan Chan as the capital. Urban dates the city’s foundation to between 900 and 1000. The information dates neither a particular ruler’s court nor a specific palace to 1200.
Getty tillhandahåller TGN:s data enligt: Getty provides the TGN data under ODC-By 1.0.
Getty tillhandahåller sina vokabulärdata: Getty provides its vocabulary data under ODC-By 1.0.
Getty provides its vocabulary data, including TGN, under ODC-By 1.0.
Gettypunkten markerar Raqqa, inte en ens: The Getty point marks Raqqa, rather than an individual palace building. Harun used the court base at Rafiqa during 796–808. The point lies within the approved game polygon.
Gettys ortsmarkör ligger i B1:s ungefärl: Getty’s place marker lies in B1’s approximate polygon 83. The check concerns the point’s placement; it does not substantiate a boundary or control over the polygon’s southern and northern extremities.
Gettys punkt anger en ungefärlig ortsmar: Getty’s point indicates an approximate place marker for the remains of Chan Chan. The sources name no palace for the bookmark date.
Gettys punkt är en ungefärlig ortsmarkör: Getty’s point is an approximate place marker for the former city. The point does not attest a particular palace.
Ghazi Malik blir sultan under namnet Ghi: Ghazi Malik becomes sultan under the name Ghiyasuddin Tughlaq. This begins the Tughlaq dynasty's rule in Delhi.
Ghiyasuddin Tughlaq tar tronen i Delhi: Ghiyasuddin Tughlaq takes the throne in Delhi
Ghuriderna besegrar Prithviraj vid Tarai: The Ghurids defeat Prithviraj at Tarain
Ghuriderna erövrar Ghazna under det år s: The Ghurids conquer Ghazna during the year that Iranica gives as 1150–1151. They thereby drive the Ghaznavids from their remaining possessions in Khorasan.
Giessens universitetsbibliotek anger 212: Giessen’s university library gives 212/213; the Met’s timeline gives 212. The alternative year is retained.
Gift med Ludvig, kungens son: Married to Louis, the king’s son
Giotto målar Scrovegnikapellets väggar p: Giotto paints the walls of the Scrovegni Chapel on Enrico Scrovegni's commission. He depicts the lives of Mary and Christ and concludes the narrative with the Last Judgement.
Girsu, dagens Tello i Irak, där fragment: Girsu, present-day Tello in Iraq, where the fragments were found
Glas blir ett uppskattat hantverksmateri: Glass becomes a prized craft material in Egypt, alongside the older tradition of faience. The Walters Museum links the new technology to a possible transfer from western Asia, with early imports of raw glass and finished vessels. The timing of the first local raw-glass manufacture remains less certain than the approximate introduction of the material.
Glasarbetare i östra Medelhavsområdet ut: Glassworkers in the eastern Mediterranean develop hollow-tube inflation of glass. The technique makes production faster and more adaptable, helping bring glass vessels to more people.
Glasmakare framställer råglas i Qantir: Glassmakers produce raw glass at Qantir
Go-Daigo och hans anhängare störtar Kama: Go-Daigo and his followers overthrow Kamakura rule
Godkännandet dateras till den 29 novembe: The approval is dated to 29 November 1223. The content of the Rule is supported by Chapter I of the published primary text.
Godsbefolkning kring Paris i Frankerrike: Estate population around Paris in the Frankish realm
Goguryeo intar Hanseong, Baekjes huvudst: Goguryeo captures Hanseong, the Baekje capital
Goguryeo intar Lelang i norra delen av K: Goguryeo takes Lelang in the northern Korean Peninsula. The museum’s timeline dates the conquest to 313.
Goguryeos arméer sveper in i Baekjes kär: Goguryeo's armies sweep into Baekje's Han River heartland, capture its capital Hanseong (modern Seoul) and execute King Gaero. Silla's relief troops arrive too late, and the surviving Baekje court moves its capital south to Ungjin (modern Gongju).
Gojoseon faller enligt kinesiska källor: Gojoseon falls according to Chinese sources
Goodman med flera placerar angreppet omk: Goodman and colleagues place the attack around 2350 BC in the Introduction. In section 5.1 they give alternative dates for Lugalzagesi's reign: c. 2358–2334 BC under the Middle Chronology and 2294–2270 BC under the Low Chronology. These are chronological frameworks for the reign and do not establish an individual year for the attack. Their separate sediment date, 2390 ± 220 BC, does not establish an exact year of warfare. Deliberate flooding by the attackers is a hypothesis.
Goryeos hov påbörjar den första Tripitak: Goryeo's court begins the first Tripitaka Koreana
Goryeos hov sätter i gång arbetet med tr: Goryeo's court starts work on woodblocks for a collection of Buddhist texts. The court seeks the Buddha's help against the Khitan invasion and has sutras, monastic rules and scholarly commentaries collected.
Goryeos siste monark avsätts. Yi Seonggy: Goryeo's last monarch is deposed. Yi Seonggye is proclaimed king of the new Joseon dynasty.
Goter besegrar kejsar Valens armé vid Ad: Goths defeat Emperor Valens’s army at Adrianople. Valens dies in the defeat.
Goter gör räder i Grekland och Mindre As: Goths raid Greece and Asia Minor
Gotiska angripare plundrar Aten, Korinth: Gothic attackers sack Athens, Corinth, Sparta and Argos, according to the Met’s historical overview.
Gotiska grupper angriper områden i Grekl: Gothic groups attack areas in Greece and Asia Minor.
Grav 3 i Mawangdui försluts med en samli: Mawangdui Tomb 3 is sealed with a collection of writings, including two silk versions of the Laozi and texts on philosophy, astronomy, warfare and medicine. The manuscripts preserve evidence of early Chinese textual traditions and their place in burial practices.
Gravar med klockbägarkeramik och andra g: Burials with Beaker pottery and other grave goods appear in Britain, introducing practices with continental connections. They form part of a major funerary change, while cremation and other older customs continue alongside them.
Gravarbetare i Deir el-Medina lägger ned: Tomb workers at Deir el-Medina stop work
Gravläggare ger en kvinna cinnober vid L: Those conducting a burial give a woman cinnabar at Liangwangcheng
Gravläggare lägger en vuxen kvinna i hop: Those conducting the burial lay an adult woman in a contracted position at Kerma and give her, among other things, a copper needle, an awl and a quartz palette. The archaeologist Matthieu Honegger dates the grave to around 3000 BC using the grave goods. He leaves its relationship with the nearby settlement open.
Gravläggare vid Liangwangcheng lägger en: Those conducting a burial at Liangwangcheng lay a woman in grave M118 with earthen ledges and many grave goods. Researchers identify cinnabar in red pigment on her bones. They assign the grave to Phase A, around 2880–2700 BC.
Gravplatsens sena bronsåldersfas övergår: The cemetery's late Bronze Age phase gives way to the first Iron Age phase at Ban Non Wat. The archaeological chronology draws on dates from materials including freshwater shellfish.
Gregorius VII ger Henrik IV avlösning i: Gregory VII grants Henry IV absolution at Canossa
Gregorius den store väljs till påve: Gregory the Great is elected pope
Gregorius den store väljs till påve i Ro: Gregory the Great is elected pope in Rome. He has previously served as a diplomat and founded monasteries.
Greker från Miletos koloniserar Svarta h: Milesian Greeks colonise the northern Black Sea coast
Greker från Miletos på den joniska kuste: Greeks from Miletos on the Ionian coast colonise the northern Black Sea coast. They found long-lived, cosmopolitan cities such as Panticapaeum, Olbia and Pontic Chersonesus.
Grekiska stater och perserkungen svär fr: Greek states and the Persian king swear peace oaths
Grekiska styrkor besegrar perserna vid P: Greek forces defeat the Persians at Plataea. The victory is among the decisive successes in the defence against the Persian invasion.
Grekiska styrkor under Leonidas försvara: Greek forces under Leonidas defend the narrow pass. The Persians are led around their position along another path, and the remaining defenders are overwhelmed.
Grekland och den vidare egeiska världen: Greece and the wider Aegean world
Grekland, särskilt den attiska keramiktr: Greece, particularly the Attic pottery tradition
Grimoald III regerar som furste av Benev: Grimoald III rules as prince of Benevento. He defends his autonomy against Frankish interventions.
Grimoald began his rule in Benevento. The source gives no location for the start date.
Grimoald tackade Gud i domkyrkan när han: Grimoald thanked God in the cathedral when he acceded.
Grimoald ärvde makten efter förhandlinga: Grimoald inherited power after negotiations; after his death without direct heirs, a court official took over.
Grisbenens mått och djurens åldersfördel: Pig-bone measurements and the animals’ age profiles suggest that An Son’s inhabitants manage or raise pigs.
Grisfynd tyder på djurhållning i An Son: Pig remains suggest animal husbandry at An Son
Grundläggningen dateras ungefärligt. Sta: The foundation is approximately dated. The city's later development spans several settlement periods.
Grundläggningen och den utlovade fakulte: The foundation and the promised faculty structure are distinguished from later teaching activity and the university's refoundation.
Grundläggningsinskriften anger ramadan 2: The foundation inscription gives Ramadan 265 in the Muslim calendar. The inscription catalogue gives the equivalent as 879; no exact day is converted here.
Gruppen anländer sjövägen till norra Vie: The group arrives by sea in northern Vietnam on its way to the Han court.
Gruvarbetare och metallhantverkare frams: Miners and metalworkers produce copper at Vilabouly
Gruvdrift och metallhantverk på Ross Isl: Mining and metalworking at Ross Island support an important early copper supply. The associated camp preserves ore-processing deposits, treatment pits and huts with Beaker pottery. Arsenic-bearing copper from the mine circulates in Ireland and reaches Britain, linking local production with wider metalworking networks.
Guge och de västtibetanska rikena: Guge and the western Tibetan kingdoms
Gungunum tycks få kontroll över Nippur: Gungunum appears to gain control of Nippur
Guo Xi målar landskapet Tidig vår och da: Guo Xi paints the landscape Early Spring and dates it to the year renzi. He depicts mountains, pines and mist in a painting that belongs to Song monumental landscape art.
Guru Nanak föds i Talwandi: Guru Nanak is born in Talwandi
Gutenberg och Fust trycker bibeln i Main: Gutenberg and Fust print the Bible in Mainz
Gwangjong beordrar en prövning av försla: Gwangjong orders a review of enslaved people's status
Gwangjong inför en politik för att pröva: Gwangjong introduces a policy to examine the status of people who had been free before being enslaved during unification wars or by powerful local families. It provides for their restoration to commoner status and challenges the local magnates' control over them.
Gwangjong inför examina för att rekryter: Gwangjong introduces examinations to recruit government officials. The reform aims to strengthen royal authority and build a more centralized civil administration; it does not establish equal access to office.
Gwangjong inför ämbetsmannaexamina i Gor: Gwangjong introduces civil service examinations in Goryeo
Gyeongbokgungpalatset, Jongmyohelgedomen: Gyeongbokgung Palace, Jongmyo Shrine and the Sajikdan Altar are completed in Hanyang. They form part of the new capital's court and ritual setting.
Habu daterar bosättningsförloppet till o: Habu dates the occupation sequence to around 3900–2300 cal BC; the official heritage summary gives 3900–2200 BC. This record concerns their alternative endpoints, not the whole occupation or a century-long departure. Earlier changes in subsistence and settlement size have their own chronology.
Hadrianus ger pannoniska orter stadsrätt: Hadrian grants town rights to Pannonian settlements
Hall anger Konons arkontår. Reformen ski: Hall gives Konon's archon year. The reform is distinguished from later constitutional changes; only the public extract and footnote have been read.
Hall återger Philokles arkontår för den: Hall gives Philokles' archon year for the first performance. No independent conversion to a single modern calendar year is made.
Hallur vid övre Tungabhadra i nuvarande: Hallur on the upper Tungabhadra in present-day Karnataka, India
Hamdan Qarmat grundar en befäst fristad: Hamdan Qarmat founds a fortified refuge near Kufa
Hamdan Qarmat founds a fortified refuge near Kufa for his followers. The Qarmatians can seek shelter and gather there.
Hammad grundar den befästa staden Qal'a: Hammad founds the fortified city of Qal'a Bani Hammad in 1007. The Hammadid emirs use it as their first capital.
Hammurabi angriper och plundrar Eshnunna: Hammurabi attacks and sacks Eshnunna, which had previously helped him against Elam.
Hammurabi besegrar Rim-Sin och införliva: Hammurabi defeats Rim-Sin and incorporates Larsa into his growing Babylonian kingdom.
Hammurabi efterträder sin far Sin-muball: Hammurabi succeeds his father Sin-muballit as king of Babylon. His later conquests make the kingdom a dominant power in Mesopotamia.
Hammurabi låter rista rättsbeslut på en: Hammurabi has judicial decisions carved on a stele
Hammurabi och hans allierade besegrar El: Hammurabi and his allies defeat Elam
Hammurabi vänder sig mot sin tidigare al: Hammurabi turns against his former ally Zimri-Lim and captures Mari.
Hamnorterna i sydöstra Indien och Mekong: The ports in southeastern India and the Mekong Delta have substantial contacts along the sea routes.
Han avsätter Liu Bian och sätter Liu Xie: He deposes Liu Bian and places Liu Xie, Emperor Xian, on the throne.
He was born in 792 and died in 852.
Han föds 1187 och dör 1226 enligt källan: He is born in 1187 and dies in 1226 according to the source.
Han heter först Kim Cheongmyeong och sen: He is first named Kim Cheongmyeong and later Kim Jung-hui. The source gives no date for the name change. Aejang is the established historical royal name.
Han ingår som dokumenterad religionsleda: He is included as a documented religious leader. No place in the empress’s private household or kinship with her is claimed.
Han innehade patriarkämbetet från 784 ti: He held the patriarchal office from 784 to 806.
Han lever till 806 och regerar som Shunz: He lives until 806 and reigns as Shunzong during 805 according to the source.
Han regerade 786–809 och dog den 24 mars: He reigned during 786–809 and died on 24 March 809 according to the source’s dating.
Han regerar 1199–1213 enligt dessa källo: He reigns during 1199–1213 according to these sources; the interval encompasses the bookmark.
Han regerar till 1206 och dör då, efter: He reigns until 1206 and dies then, after the bookmark.
Han tillträdde i juni 800 och dog den 5: He acceded in June 800 and died on 5 July 812 according to the sources’ datings.
Han tillträder under 800 och lever till: He accedes during 800 and lives until 809 according to the source.
Han tjänstgör som regent från Aejangs ti: He serves as regent from Aejang’s accession and lives until 826 according to the sources.
Han, Wei och Zhao erkänns formellt: Han, Wei and Zhao are formally recognized
Handeln förbinder Arikamedu och Oc Eo: Trade connects Arikamedu and Oc Eo
Handelsmän bygger ett fäste i Elmina: Merchants build a stronghold in Elmina
Handelsmän uppför Sankt Georgs slott i E: Merchants erect St George's Castle in Elmina on Ghana's coast in 1482. African and European merchants develop the exchange of goods along the coast.
Handelsnäten i Persiska viken, särskilt: Persian Gulf trade networks, especially Bahrain in Dilmun
Handynastin återtar makten och styr från: The Han dynasty regains power and rules from the rebuilt capital of Luoyang.
Hannibal besegrar romarna vid Cannae: Hannibal defeats the Romans at Cannae
Hannibal besegrar romarna vid Trasimenus: Hannibal defeats the Romans at Lake Trasimene
Hannibals armé besegrar romarna vid Tras: Hannibal's army defeats the Romans at Lake Trasimene.
Hannibals styrkor besegrar den romerska: Hannibal's forces defeat the Roman army at Cannae. Polybius describes cavalry attacking the Romans from behind.
Hanriket grundar en kejserlig akademi: The Han found an Imperial Academy
Hanriket kuvar de sju kungarikenas uppro: The Han suppress the Revolt of the Seven Kingdoms
Hanriket återupprättas med hov i Luoyang: Han rule is restored with the court at Luoyang
Hanrikets armé besegrar Trungsystrarnas: The Han army defeats the Trung sisters’ forces. Ma Yuan establishes garrisons, introduces regulations and returns north in 44.
Hanrikets hov drabbas av trolldomsskanda: The Han court is shaken by the witchcraft scandal
Hanrikets lärda debatterar salt och järn: Han scholars debate salt and iron
Hans födelseår är okänt. Han blir själv: His birth year is unknown. He becomes king himself under the name Heondeok in 809, after the bookmark. The sources give differing kinship lines for his wife; no wife has therefore been added.
Hans verksamhet bidrar till organiserad: His work contributes to organised Buddhism and early translations in the city.
Hanson och Posen anger detta datum för p: Hanson and Posen supply this date for the petition. Its original closing formula gives Marcheshwan day 20 in Darius's seventeenth year; no new calendar conversion is made. The date belongs to the request, not the earlier destruction or a completed rebuilding. Whether the temple was rebuilt remains uncertain in Posen's account.
Hanstyret delar in det erövrade Nanyue i: The Han government divides conquered Nanyue into prefectures
Hanstyret inför monopol på salt och järn: The Han government establishes monopolies over salt and iron
Hanstyret slår ned de sju kungarikenas u: The Han government suppresses the Revolt of the Seven Kingdoms. The conflict takes place in an empire containing both directly administered territories and regional kingdoms.
Hantverkare avbildar Naram-Sin med hornp: Craftspeople depict Naram-Sin, wearing horned headgear, and soldiers in a mountain landscape. Georg Neumann interprets the scene as a celebration of the king's victory over the Lullubians.
Hantverkare gjuter bronsföremål i Igbo-U: Craftspeople cast bronze objects at Igbo-Ukwu
Hantverkare hugger en segerstele för Nar: Craftspeople carve a victory stele for Naram-Sin
Hantverkare i Ban Non Wat använder lerkl: Craftspeople at Ban Non Wat use clay-lined furnaces, crucibles and moulds to cast tin bronze. A man is buried during phase BA4 with 29 moulds for socketed axes and bangles. Higham distinguishes local production from the preceding period's imported copper objects and rich grave offerings.
Hantverkare i Ban Non Wat gjuter brons l: Craftspeople at Ban Non Wat cast bronze locally
Hantverkare i Igbo-Ukwu gjuter rituella: Craftspeople at Igbo-Ukwu cast ritual vessels and regalia in bronze. The museum's texts give different dates for the works, from a disputed dating to the ninth century to approximately the tenth century.
Hantverkare i Nubien utvecklar emaljerin: Craftspeople in Nubia develop metal enameling alongside a growing glass industry.
Hantverkare på Perus nordkust framställe: Craftspeople on Peru's north coast produce arsenical bronze
Hantverkare ristar pyramidtexter i Unas: Craftspeople carve Pyramid Texts in Unas's tomb
Hantverkare ristar pyramidtexter på vägg: Craftspeople carve Pyramid Texts on the walls of King Unas's burial chamber at Saqqara. In the texts, the dead king receives guidance for the afterlife.
Hantverkare tillverkar en buddhastaty i: Artisans make a gilded bronze Buddha statue under Later Zhao. The Asian Art Museum attributes the object to Hebei and dates it through its inscription.
Hantverkare tillverkar stenyxor i Hiregu: Craftspeople make stone axes at Hiregudda
Harald Blåtand reser den stora Jellingst: Harald Bluetooth erects the great Jelling Stone
Harald Blåtand reser den stora runstenen: Harald Bluetooth erects the great runestone at Jelling during the 960s. He has the carvers declare that he has made the Danes Christian. The carvers also depict Christ on the stone.
Harriet Crawford placerar övergivandet o: Harriet Crawford places the abandonment around 2000 BC. The date identifies no exact day of departure and establishes no particular cause.
