Harun ar-Rashid har utsett Ibrahim ibn a: Harun al-Rashid has appointed Ibrahim ibn al-Aghlab governor in Ifriqiya. The letter of appointment arrived in June 800. Ibrahim acknowledges the caliph’s suzerainty and establishes his family’s power around Kairouan. The sources do not establish which palace he used on the bookmark date.
Harun ar-Rashid styr från Raqqa och Rafi: Harun al-Rashid rules from Raqqa and Rafiqa on the Euphrates after the court’s move in 796. The Barmak family leads much of the administration. He has designated his younger son al-Amin as first successor. In Ifriqiya, Ibrahim ibn al-Aghlab has been granted rule as Abbasid governor during 800.
Harun ar-Rashid tillträder som abbasidis: Harun ar-Rashid becomes Abbasid caliph. He appoints Yahya of the Barmakid family as his vizier.
Harun gör som kalif anspråk på religiös: As caliph, Harun claims religious leadership; the statement does not make him the undisputed leader of all Islam.
Harun såg kalifämbetet som ett försvar f: Harun viewed the caliphal office as a defence of Sunni Islam and combined the religious role with his temporal power.
Hasan II förkunnar qiama, uppståndelsen,: Hasan II proclaims qiyama, the resurrection, before representatives of Nizari territories at Alamut on 8 August 1164. Nizari teachers will later interpret the resurrection as a spiritual state in which the imam reveals the inner truth of the faith.
Hasan II utropar uppståndelsen i Alamut: Hasan II proclaims the resurrection at Alamut
Hasan Sabbah tar kontroll över Alamut: Hasan Sabbah takes control of Alamut
Hasan Sabbah tar kontroll över bergsfäst: Hasan Sabbah takes control of the mountain fortress of Alamut through infiltration in 1090. He uses the fortress as headquarters for an Ismaili revolt against the Seljuks.
Hatschepsut låter bygga ett tempel i tre: Hatshepsut has a temple built on three levels at Deir el-Bahari. According to the Egyptian ministry, Senenmut designs the complex. Priests use the temple for Amun and the queen’s mortuary cult.
Hatschepsut låter uppföra sitt tempel i: Hatshepsut commissions her temple at Deir el-Bahari
Hatschepsut sänder en expedition till Pu: Hatshepsut sends an expedition to Punt

Hatshepsut sends an expedition to Punt. Reliefs in her temple show crews returning with goods including myrrh trees, ebony and ivory. Artists depict the journey as part of the queen’s royal commemorative programme.
Hattusa, nära nuvarande Boğazkale i cent: Hattusa, near modern Boğazkale in central Türkiye
Hattusili gör Hattusa till sitt kungasät: Hattusili establishes his royal seat at Hattusa
Hattusili gör den redan existerande stad: Hattusili makes the existing city of Hattusa the Hittite royal center. One interpretation of the Zalpa text places his accession at Nesa before the court moved. This political change should not be confused with the city's first settlement.
Hayam Wuruk bekräftar bestämmelser för J: Hayam Wuruk confirms regulations for Java's ferrymen
Hayam Wuruks privilegiebrev bekräftar pr: Hayam Wuruk's charter confirms privileges and obligations for ferrymen, including those at Canggu and Terung. It limits revenue collectors' claims, sets a festival payment and defines protections for ferrymen carrying people and goods.
Hazard beskriver tidigare skiften och ar: Hazard describes earlier successions and appointments of heirs but establishes no complete succession rule for 1200. The none-fits choice is an assessment of the game’s two alternatives.
Hazard, Bongianino och Spaniens kulturmi: Hazard, Bongianino and Spain’s ministry of culture give 1199–1213. Larousse gives a reign of 1199–1212 and death in 1214. Archnet gives 1199–1213 but pairs it with 599–609 AH. The differences do not change the ruler selection for 1200. No calendar days have been converted.
He Nu daterar den stora stadsinhägnaden: He Nu dates the large city enclosure and craft area to the Middle phase, 2100–2000 BC. No common start of construction for the whole city is given.
He Nu daterar det sena skedet till 2000–: He Nu dates the late phase to 2000–1900 BC. The interval applies to the archaeological remains and establishes no single year of destruction. His interpretation of political retaliation is a hypothesis.
Hebei, Kina; museets geografiska attribu: Hebei, China; the museum’s geographical attribution
Hela datumet återges från Shahbazi. Slag: The complete date follows Shahbazi. The battlefield's exact location is disputed; no independent calendar conversion is made.
Hela den andra beskickningens intervall: Yang gives the complete interval of the second mission.
Hela den arkeologiska fasen återges som: The entire archaeological phase is represented as 100 BC–AD 100, without a year zero. Grave goods do not in themselves establish the language or ethnic identity of those buried.
Hela den ungefärliga brukningsperioden b: The full approximate period of use is retained. Most investigated settlements were abandoned around AD 350; Tumben-Naranjal may have continued until around 450. This entry gives no exact first day of cultivation.
Hela det angivna krigsintervallet behåll: The full stated interval of the wars is retained.
Hela det ungefärliga spannet behålls; in: The full approximate span is retained; no single year of composition is known.
Hela expansionsperioden under Maodun och: The full expansion period under Maodun and Jiyu is preserved. The beginning of the interval is not given as a certain single foundation year.
Hela födelsedatumet är ett genererat spe: The full birth date is a generated game value for a documented person. It does not indicate a historical age; Vela states that no secure birth date is known.
Hela intervallet bevaras, även slutåret: The complete interval is retained, including the final year in the following century.
Hela kriget omfattas, inklusive tiden ef: The entire war is covered, including the period after the Battle of Zama. The battle's year does not replace the war's ending year.
Hela krigets intervall bevaras. Enskilda: The full interval of the war is preserved. Individual battles, pauses and political consequences do not imply fighting every year or in every place.
The full war period follows the chronology.
Hela källans period omfattar 400–101 f.K: The source's full period covers 400–101 BC. It dates the contacts broadly and establishes neither a foundation in 400 nor uninterrupted activity.
Hela spannet daterar traditionen med sig: The full range dates the Gulf-type seal tradition. Laursen distinguishes an earlier c. 2100–2050 BC phase from wider use in Dilmun around 2050 BC. The traders' identities and movements are reconstructed from archaeological evidence; no exact invention or migration year is known.
Hela upprorsperioden behålls. De bevarad: The entire revolt period is retained. Surviving ancient accounts differ in several details; uncertain army sizes and death tolls are omitted.
Helen Creese anger 6 september 1157 i vå: Helen Creese gives 6 September AD 1157 for the start of the work. The entry retains the year and does not turn it into a certain year for the completion of the entire poem.
Heliodoros tillägnar en pelare åt Vasude: Heliodorus dedicates a pillar to Vasudeva
Henderson placerar produktionsbeläggen f: Henderson places the Qantir production evidence in this century. Rehren and Pusch assign its glass-bearing layers provisionally to early Ramesside activity, pending final stratigraphic interpretation. The endpoints do not establish a workshop's opening or closure, continuous production throughout the century, or the first manufacture of glass in Egypt.
Hennes namn och moderskap har ett koloni: Her name and motherhood have colonial attestation. Being alive on the start date follows from weighing this together with her son’s uncertain birth year. The birth date is generated; the wedding date, physical location and status as coya on this day lack evidence.
Henrik IV söker påven Gregorius VII i Ca: Henry IV seeks out Pope Gregory VII at Canossa and asks forgiveness. Gregory describes how the king pleads with him for three days before he lifts the excommunication. In his letter to the German princes, the pope says that he needs to consult them about the continuing dispute.
Henrik V och Calixtus II sluter konkorda: Henry V and Calixtus II conclude the Concordat of Worms
Henrik V:s engelska armé besegrar fransm: Henry V's English army defeats the French at Agincourt on 25 October 1415. English archers behind wooden stakes break the French attack.
Henrique av Kongo blir biskop: Henrique of Kongo becomes a bishop
Henrique, son till kung Afonso I av Kong: Henrique, son of King Afonso I of Kongo, becomes a bishop. His appointment forms part of Afonso's effort to make the kingdom's church more independent and self-sufficient.
Herdar lever vid Tchadsjöns sydvästra st: Herders live along Lake Chad’s southwestern shore
Herdar samlas i större bosättningar krin: Herders gather in larger settlements around Kent
Herdar vid Tchadsjön börjar leva mer bof: Herders around Lake Chad begin living more sedentary lives
Herdegrupper i centrala Kazakstan samlas: Herding groups in central Kazakhstan gather in larger settlements. At Kent, inhabitants build around 130 pit houses. Together with smaller nearby settlements, the site forms a centre with a few thousand inhabitants, according to the researchers’ estimate.
Hernán Cortés landstiger nära Cempoala m: Hernán Cortés lands near Cempoala with around 500 soldiers. Montezuma II's envoys meet the expedition with gifts.
Hettiterriket når sin största utbredning: The Hittite empire reaches its greatest extent
Higham anger omkring 420 som den troliga: Higham gives around 420 as the most likely transition to Iron Age 1, whose full period is 420–150 BC. This is a site chronology, not an exact year for the invention of iron.
Higham, Higham och Douka anger uttryckli: Higham, Higham and Douka explicitly date the first settlement to around 2000 BC. They date the entire settlement period to 2000–1500 BC; the trading role applies to this longer phase and has no established starting year.
Highams studie från 2024 och tabell 2 i: Higham’s 2024 study and Table 2 in Higham and Higham’s 2009 study give the full burial phase as 1050–1000 BC. The older study’s modelled transition to the Early Bronze Age falls within 1053–996 BC; that interval represents uncertainty about the transition and does not give the phase’s duration. Local casting belongs to later phases.
Himiko sänder en beskickning till Wei: Himiko sends an embassy to Wei
Himiko, härskare i Wa, skickar sändebud: Himiko, ruler of Wa, sends envoys to Wei. The Chinese emperor gives bronze mirrors among other gifts.
Historic Environment Scotland anger den: Historic Environment Scotland gives 11 September 1297. Uncertain troop strengths and casualty figures are omitted.
Historikern beskriver legitim härstamnin: The historian describes legitimate descent in the sequence Wonseong, Soseong and Aejang. The game’s automatic and gender-neutral succession is an interpretation, and the source attests no council election on ability.
Historiska texter beskriver hur kung Wul: Historical texts describe King Wuling having Zhao adopt horseback archery in response to mounted neighboring peoples.
Ho-citadellet byggs i Thanh Hoa: The Ho Citadel is built in Thanh Hoa
Hon adresseras i ett brev 801 och avsätt: She is addressed in a letter in 801 and deposed in 802.
Hon föds 1188 och dör 1252 enligt källan: She is born in 1188 and dies in 1252 according to the source.
Hon gifte sig med Harun 165 (782) och do: She married Harun in 165 (782) and died in 216 (831).
Hon hävdar sina rättigheter som hustru o: She asserts her rights as wife and queen while Philip seeks a divorce. The source does not show a normal role as an active consort at court on the bookmark date.
Hon är mor till Chunyou, född 1177, och: She is the mother of Chunyou, born in 1177, and participates in the succession of 1206. She therefore lives across the bookmark date.
Honegger beskriver monumentala gravar i: Honegger describes monumental graves at Kerma around 1900 BC. Large burial pits and mounds are generally accompanied by mudbrick chapels and arrangements of cattle skulls.
Honegger singles out around 1900 BC within a broader Middle Kerma development. This dates a monumental burial episode, not an exact first grave or the beginning of social hierarchy. His later caption dates one grave to roughly the same time; it is not independent confirmation of the whole sequence.
Honegger placerar stadens tillkomst omkr: Honegger places the city's emergence around 2500 BC. He describes the appearance of the first houses as a reconstruction and distinguishes them from later brick buildings. No individual foundation year is established.
Honeggers syntes från 2018 placerar bruk: Honegger's 2018 synthesis places the use of wooden burial beds around 2000 BC. His 2014 catalogue describes it only as shortly after the 2300–2100 BC phase. Chaix places beds later in the Middle Kerma sequence, whose full framework is 2050–1750 BC, without a separate start year. These relative descriptions do not establish an exact first burial or a precisely bounded adoption period.
Hovet angrips under Heijikonflikten: The court is attacked during the Heiji conflict
Hovet godkänner statlig kontroll över sa: The court approves state control of salt and iron operations. Officials organize production and administration.
Hovet gör Nara till Japans huvudstad: The court makes Nara Japan's capital
Hovfolk läser Berättelsen om Genji: Courtiers read The Tale of Genji
Hovfraktioner strider i Hōgenupproret: Court factions fight in the Hōgen Rebellion
Hovpoeten Mpu Sĕḍah börjar skriva Bhārat: The court poet Mpu Sĕḍah begins writing the Bhāratayuddha at the court of King Jayabhaya in Kaḍiri. He reworks the Mahābhārata's war narrative in Old Javanese, and Mpu Panuluh writes the later part of the work.
Hovsätet belägger ingen vistelseort för: The court seat does not attest Muhammad al-Nasir’s whereabouts on the bookmark date.
Hoysalakungen Vishnuvardhana låter bygga: The Hoysala king Vishnuvardhana has the Channakeshava Temple built at Belur in honour of Vishnu. He has the shrine erected to commemorate a military victory.
Huang Chaos rebeller intar Tangrikets hu: Huang Chao's rebels capture the Tang capital Chang'an in early 881. They loot and kill inhabitants as they enter the city.
Huayna Capac regerar i Inkariket. Cusco: Huayna Capac reigns in the Inca Empire. Cusco is the empire’s political and religious centre, with the Qorikancha sun temple. The ruler is regarded as divine, and the Incas worship Inti, the sun.
Hubei Provincial Museum placerar begravn: Hubei Provincial Museum places the burial roughly at the time of a bell gift dated to 433 BC. The University of Washington dates the tomb around 430 BC while retaining 433 for that bell. The bounds preserve these approximate burial datings, not a three-year funeral or the manufacture dates of all the instruments.
Hubei, mellersta Yangzidalen, Kina enlig: Hubei, middle Yangtze Valley, China according to the museum's attribution
Hugo Capet tar emot kungakröningen år 98: Hugh Capet receives the royal coronation in 987. The surviving texts give different days, 1 June or 3 July, and researchers have debated whether he underwent two coronations.
Hunafurstar erövrar Punjab och Kashmir: Huna princes conquer Punjab and Kashmir
Hunafurstar erövrar tillfälligt Punjab o: Huna princes temporarily conquer Punjab and Kashmir. Their advances contribute to the breakup of the Gupta Empire.
Hunminjeongeum förklaras i bokform: Hunminjeongeum is explained in book form
Hunnerna tränger in i områden längs Dona: The Huns enter territories along the Danube. According to the museum’s survey, their advance drives other peoples, including Visigoths, into Roman provinces.
Hunnernas framryckning driver folk in i: The Huns’ advance drives peoples into Roman provinces
Husain Shah tar makten i Bengalen: Husain Shah takes power in Bengal
Husain Shah tar makten i Bengalen efter: Husain Shah takes power in Bengal after a palace coup. The sources consulted give different years for his accession.
Husayn Bayqara gör anspråk på tronen i H: Husayn Bayqara claims the throne in Herat
Husayn Bayqara claims the throne in Herat on 24 March 1469. He faces continued competition from Timurid princes and the Aq Qoyunlu.
Hushåll tar över tidigare officiella utr: Households take over former official spaces at Edfu
Hustrurnas identiteter och ordningsföljd: The wives’ identities and sequence are attested, but neither can be placed alive on the bookmark date using the material consulted. Their external kinship describes marriages during his life and makes no claim of simultaneous wives in 1200.
Hyksoskungar med anknytning till Främre: Hyksos kings with ties to the Near East rule from Avaris in the Nile Delta. They adopt Egyptian royal titles, while local kings continue to rule at Thebes. Migration into the delta predates the takeover, whose course is uncertain.
Hyksoskungar regerar över norra Egypten: Hyksos kings rule northern Egypt from Avaris
Händelsen gäller successionen efter Theo: The event concerns the succession after Theodosius’s death. It makes no claim that all later attempts to reunite imperial rule ceased.
Händelsen knyts till Ramesses III:s åtto: The event is associated with Ramesses III’s eighth regnal year. Research gives the alternative calendar years 1180, 1177 and 1176/1175 BC; the interval does not mean that the same battle lasts five years.
Händelsen återges på årsnivå. Källans ja: The event is presented at year level. The source's Japanese calendar date and its stated equivalent are not converted; no uncertain death tolls are included.
Härskare ur Kanteätten utvidgar Sosorike: Rulers of the Kante dynasty expand the Soso kingdom's dominion around 1180–1230. They incorporate large parts of the older Ghana Empire during this period.
Härskaren betraktas som gudomlig, och In: The ruler is regarded as divine, and Inti is worshipped within the empire’s cult. Qorikancha in Cusco is the principal temple of the sun cult.
Härskarlistan daterar regeringens början: The ruler list dates the beginning of the reign to 9.
Härskarna vid Mapungubwe bor på berget m: The rulers at Mapungubwe live on the hill while ordinary inhabitants live on the terrace below. Agriculture and long-distance trade sustain the hierarchical society.
Hülegüs mongolarmé intar Bagdad. Abbasid: Hülegü's Mongol army captures Baghdad. The Abbasid caliphate based in the city comes to an end.
Hülegüs mongolarmé intar nizari-ismailit: Hülegü's Mongol army captures Nizari Ismaili strongholds in the Alborz Mountains. The conquest forms part of the new offensive that Möngke has entrusted to his brother.
I Ban Non Wat finns en stor andel hönsbe: Ban Non Wat has a high proportion of chicken bones and many bones from young birds. Researchers interpret the finds as early evidence of a domestic population. The interpretation concerns people’s relationship with the birds over a long period, rather than a documented first instance of domestication.
I Fanshan innehåller elva gravar påkosta: At Fanshan, eleven tombs contain elaborate jade grave goods. Their regular arrangement and shared ritual objects point to standardized burial practices and concentrated wealth within Liangzhu society. These patterns support an interpretation of elite status, without identifying named rulers.
I Gajigannaområdets arkeologiska materia: Pearl millet occurs in the archaeological material from the Gajiganna area. At this time, herding is combined with cultivation in a more mixed subsistence economy.
I Huffmans rekonstruktion för grupper av: In Huffman's reconstruction, hunter-gatherer groups carry Bambata pottery into southeastern Africa around AD 200.
I Las Pinturas-komplexets rum Sub-1A mål: In room Sub-1A of the Las Pinturas complex, painters depict the maize god, sacrifices and coronation rituals. The paintings belong to a construction phase before the complex's final rebuilding.
I Manchay Bajo i Luríndalen i Peru uppfö: At Manchay Bajo in Peru's Lurín Valley, builders raise a wall 820 yards (about 750 metres) long to protect the U-shaped temple complex from the floods and mudslides of the central coast.
I San José Mogote ristas det tidigaste b: San José Mogote carves the earliest recorded Zapotec date
I centrala Vietnam används cylindriska g: Cylindrical burial jars are used in central Vietnam during Sa Huynh's second phase. Graves contain more iron and beads, fewer bronze objects and, in some cases, Western Han mirrors.
I delar av östra Medelhavsområdet och Le: A period of cooler and drier conditions occurs in parts of the eastern Mediterranean and the Levant. Researchers date it approximately from 2200 to 1900 BC.
I en grav för ett litet barn i Kara-depe: A necklace of eight flat, ring-shaped beads is included in a young child's grave at Kara-depe. Researchers judge that the beads are made of iron-rich talc.
I en rundbyggnad vid Hiregudda tillverka: People manufacture dolerite tools in a round building at Hiregudda. Production increases during the later part of its use. Differences in skill lead researchers to interpret the work as communal production in which participants work part-time at stone knapping and grinding.
I tretton böcker beskriver Ptolemaios ma: In thirteen books, Ptolemy describes mathematical models of the movements of the sun, moon and planets with the earth at the centre.
ICOMOS anger 1291. Den lästa passagen ge: ICOMOS gives 1291. The passage consulted gives no exact day; the entry dates no general end to all later crusades.
ICOMOS daterar den bevarade östra hallen: ICOMOS dates the surviving East Hall to 857, and Li, Gu and Zhang describe this as a rebuilding. The date concerns this hall, not the foundation of the earlier Foguang Temple. No month or day is specified.
ICOMOS daterar hela period V till cirka: ICOMOS dates the whole of Period V to circa 2100–2000 BC. Damage to the water installations belongs to the middle of the phase. The dating gives no individual year for the damage.
ICOMOS daterar palatslämningarna till 12: ICOMOS dates the palace remains to 1220–1290. The report's broader peak period for the kingdom is 1220–1300; the entry concerns the palace phase and establishes no individual foundation year.
ICOMOS placerar arbetet i etapp II, cirk: ICOMOS places the work in Stage II, circa 2900–2800 BC. The range gives the stage's dating and establishes no individual construction year.
ICOMOS skiljer denna Nascafas från äldre: ICOMOS distinguishes this Nasca phase from earlier Chavín and Paracas phases. The interval dates a phase, not the first creation of all the lines.
IGNOU daterar det andra slaget vid Tarai: IGNOU dates the Second Battle of Tarain to 1192. The entry concerns Prithviraj's defeat and describes Ghurid rule after the battle.
IME anger 950 f.Kr. för Lefkandis blomst: IME gives 950 BC for Lefkandi's heyday. Oxford dates the Toumba building to the middle of the tenth century BC. The year here concerns the settlement's heyday; the sources establish no exact year for construction or the burials.
INAH anger 14 augusti 32 f.Kr. i vår kal: INAH gives 14 August 32 BC in our calendar without specifying a correlation. Milbrath's table gives 3 September Julian or 1 September Gregorian with 584283, and 16 August Julian with 584265. The date concerns the inscribed date, not a securely established year of carving or erection.
INAH anger motsvarigheten 909 för mayaka: INAH gives 909 as the equivalent of the Maya Long Count date 10.4.0.0.0. The dating refers to the inscription's calendar information and establishes no abandonment of the city.
INAH anger omkring 1200 för denna byggna: INAH gives around 1200 for this architectural development. The site had been inhabited long before; the year indicates no first foundation.
INAH:s detaljerade monumentbeskrivning a: INAH's detailed monument description places at least eight expansions within 800–150 BC. The page's introduction dates the pyramid more narrowly to 800–600 BC. This entry retains the full stated construction sequence without assigning every expansion to the first century.
INAH:s guide anger en ungefärlig sammans: The INAH guide gives an approximate date for the coalescence of earlier villages. Later urban expansion and pyramid construction belong to other phases.
Ibn Battuta anländer till staden Mali: Ibn Battuta arrives in the city of Mali
Ibn Battuta anländer till staden som han: Ibn Battuta arrives in the city he calls Mali in the West African kingdom. He describes his stay and life in the realm in his travel account.
Ibn Battuta lämnar Tanger för pilgrimsfä: Ibn Battuta leaves Tangier for the pilgrimage
Ibn Battuta lämnar sin hemstad Tanger fö: Ibn Battuta leaves his hometown of Tangier to travel to Mecca and Medina. He begins the journey alone and recounts his farewell to his family.
Ibn Battuta stannar vid handelsstaden Ki: Ibn Battuta stops at the trading city of Kilwa on the East African coast. He describes the city as one of the most beautiful he knows.
Ibn Fadlan kommer till volgabulgarernas: Ibn Fadlan arrives in the land of the Volga Bulgars
Ibn Khaldun avslutar Muqaddima under sin: Ibn Khaldun completes the Muqaddima during his stay at Qal’at Ibn Salama. He writes the work as an introduction to his project on world history.
Ibn Khaldun avslutar Muqaddima vid Qal’a: Ibn Khaldun completes the Muqaddima at Qal’at Ibn Salama
Ibrahim styrde som muslimsk guvernör och: Ibrahim ruled as a Muslim governor and acknowledged the Abbasid caliph’s suzerainty; the consulted sources establish no exclusive school of law for him on the bookmark date.
Idealet ger kejsarinnans äldste son före: The ideal gives precedence to the empress’s eldest son, but the game’s primogeniture simplifies the court’s choices and conflicts over succession.
Ife, skogsområdet i nuvarande sydvästra: Ife, the forest region of present-day southwestern Nigeria
Ilig Nasr ibn Ali intar Bukhara utan mot: Ilig Nasr ibn Ali captures Bukhara without resistance in October 999. He deposes the Samanid ruler Abd al-Malik and incorporates Transoxiana into his realm. A relative of the deposed ruler continues resistance for another five years.
Iliyas Shah besegrar Ikhtiyaruddin Ghazi: Iliyas Shah defeats Ikhtiyaruddin Ghazi Shah and captures Sonargaon. The campaign brings Bengal's major centres of power together under his rule.
Iliyas Shah intar Sonargaon och samlar B: Iliyas Shah captures Sonargaon and unites Bengal
Ilkhanen Abu Sa’id dör vid sitt högkvart: The ilkhan Abu Sa’id dies at his headquarters in Qarabagh. Rivals from the Mongol imperial family subsequently fight over the succession in the absence of a close male heir.
Iltutmishs dotter Raziyya blir sultan i: Iltutmish's daughter Raziyya becomes sultan in Delhi. She tries to exercise power independently despite opposition among the realm's magnates.
Inaros leder ett omfattande uppror mot p: Inarus leads a major revolt against Persian rule in Egypt. Athens supports the rebels with naval forces.
Inaros leder ett uppror i Egypten: Inarus leads a revolt in Egypt
Indisk keramik används på Bali: Indian pottery is used on Bali
Indusdalens sigilltraditioner anpassas i: Indus sealing traditions are adapted in Gulf trade
Indusområdet i Sydasien: The Indus region in South Asia
Indusområdet i nuvarande Pakistan och no: Indus region in present-day Pakistan and northwestern India
Indusområdet, dagens Pakistan; närmare f: Indus region, present-day Pakistan; more precise findspot unavailable
Ingen användbar namnlista för personer o: No usable name list for people around 1200 has been compiled. Zevallos’s book draws on colonial manuscripts, but the open abstract provides no usable list of ordinary personal names for 1200. Modern building names and the names of famous rulers may not fill the gap.
Ingen granskad källa placerar en identif: No reviewed source places an identified ruler at a specific location on that day.
Ingen oberoende granskad passage faststä: No independently reviewed passage establishes the historical capital connection here or the emperor’s whereabouts on the bookmark date.
Ingen öppnad källa ger Ahuitzotls vistel: No consulted source gives Ahuitzotl’s whereabouts on that day.
Ingen öppnad passage anger Huayna Capacs: No consulted passage gives Huayna Capac’s whereabouts on 31 December 1500. Tomebamba’s role in northern campaigns is not dated to this day.
Ingen öppnad passage namnger en präst el: No consulted passage names a priest or attests who leads the institution on this day. Sarmiento describes Huayna taking over the guardianship of the sun early in his reign; the office’s duration up to the start date is uncertain.
Ingen. Karl hade ingen levande drottning: None. Charles had no living queen on the bookmark date according to the cited sources.
Inkastyrkor erövrar Chan Chan, Chimúrike: Inca forces conquer Chan Chan, the Chimú kingdom's capital, around 1470. They take metalworkers to Cuzco.
Inskriftens ordtal kan läsas som śaka 11: The inscription's word numerals can be read as Shaka 1113 or 1114. Maxwell gives the simplified equivalents 1191 or 1192 in the commentary and the range 1191–1193 in the summary; Vickery uses 1192/1193 and explains the uncertainty when the month is missing. The entry retains the full range and makes no independent calendar conversion.
Intervallet anger Lokaksemas verksamhets: The interval gives Lokaksema’s period of activity in Teiser’s account, not the date of every individual text.
Intervallet anger dateringsramen för de: The range gives the dating framework for the surviving layers. Researchers judge that the accumulation probably formed in less than 50 years within this framework.
Intervallet avser byggandet. Källpassage: The interval refers to construction. The cited passage gives no separate inauguration date.
Intervallet avser direktdaterade rester: The interval concerns directly dated wheat and barley remains from Piklihal. It establishes neither the first year of cultivation there nor the cereals’ first arrival in South India.
Intervallet avser hela kriget. Enskilda: The interval covers the entire war. This record does not date individual battles or peace terms.
Intervallet avser upproret i Thebaid. Ti: The interval concerns the revolt in the Thebaid. Earlier and later disturbances in the Nile Delta are not automatically included in the same dating.
Intervallet daterar den undersökta verks: The range dates the activity examined at Baodun according to the 2013 study. Mixed layers limit the plant finds' connection to individual phases. The 2011 study gives circa 2700 BC for mixed cultivation and 2700–2100 BC for the site. No exact introduction year or cultivation of both crops during every year is established.
Intervallet följer Briants skildring av: The interval follows Briant's account of the resistance. It does not establish uninterrupted fighting at every location.
Intervallet följer Posen Librarys översi: The interval follows the Posen Library’s overview. Hostile ancient accounts of atrocities are not presented as established facts.
Intervallet följer artikelns datering av: The interval follows the article's dating of the rebellion and its suppression. Early Zhou chronologies differ; this record does not reconcile their absolute dates or calculate new years from reign lengths. The later redistribution of authority and settlement foundations is not confined to these four calendar years.
The interval combines two separate eruptions. The cooling continues after 540; its duration and consequences for society remain disputed.
Intervallet gäller Gajigannakulturens fö: The interval concerns the first phase of the Gajiganna culture and is calibrated in Antiquity’s table. It dates a settlement phase, rather than a single arrival.
Intervallet gäller benkollagen från pers: The range refers to bone collagen from the person in the burial mound Kurgan 139 at Aigyrzhal-3, sample BTC-KY-H48. Researchers interpret the isotopes as probable millet consumption. The dating indicates no introduction year for the crop and does not establish local cultivation.
Intervallet gäller bygget av Aqua Claudi: The interval concerns Aqua Claudia's construction under Caligula and Claudius. The park leaflet gives inconsistent start years for the companion Anio Novus, which is not the subject of this entry. No uninterrupted work schedule or inauguration day is inferred.
Intervallet gäller den lokala Cerro Blan: The interval concerns the local Cerro Blanco phase and the complex’s early layout. The site remains in use later; the source’s longer dating of 1100–450 BC concerns the ceremonial centre’s entire history.
Intervallet gäller den tidigaste daterad: The interval applies to the earliest dated stilt-house phase. The source also describes earlier settlement and a later stilt-house phase in 1100–900/800 BC; these dates are kept separate.
Intervallet gäller det första fälttåget: The interval concerns the first campaign of 773–774. It excludes the later campaign of 776.
Intervallet gäller en lång byggnadsperio: The interval covers a long period of construction. No single foundation is dated to exactly 200 BC.
Intervallet gäller hela expeditionsserie: The range refers to the entire series of expeditions and gives no individual arrival years.
Intervallet kommer från en statistisk mo: The range comes from a statistical model. A later study stresses that no individual dates on the North Island fall precisely before circa 1280. It is not a certain arrival range for a particular boat or group.
Intervallet motsvarar forskningens place: The interval represents the scholarly placement of the reported events in the eighteenth century BC, not a century-long action. Anitta's account supplies no exact year for the return. The text's original language and transmission are debated; this interval does not date the surviving manuscripts. The second source supports that textual context, not independent confirmation of the return.
Intervallet omfattar den första och den: The interval covers the first and revised editions. It does not date every part of the Corpus iuris civilis.
Intervallet är den arkeologiska datering: The interval is the archaeological date range for the battle. It does not mean that fighting continued for fifty years; the participants' political affiliations are unknown.
Intervallet är den undersökta perioden i: The interval is the period studied in the conference contribution. The interpretation of the fortifications comes from a separate research abstract; a specific foundation year is unknown.
Invånare anlägger befästa bosättningar m: Residents establish fortified settlements between the upper Ural and upper Tobol rivers. Metalworkers process copper and arsenical bronze within the settlements, which archaeologists assign to the Sintashta complex.
Invånare anlägger den stad på Bahrain so: Inhabitants establish the city on Bahrain that archaeologists call City II. Crawford describes how trade links with Mesopotamia become concentrated on Bahrain at this time.
Invånare anlägger en ny stad på Bahrain: Inhabitants establish a new city on Bahrain
Invånare bygger befästa bosättningar öst: Residents build fortified settlements east of the Urals
Invånare bygger och använder Pampa de la: Inhabitants build and use Pampa de las Llamas–Moxeke
Invånare flyttar från stora städer till: People move from large cities to smaller villages. Mohenjo-daro is abandoned after a period of decline, while Harappa remains occupied by fewer people.
Invånare i Ban Non Wat lägger kopparyxor: Inhabitants of Ban Non Wat place copper axes in richer graves
Invånare i Casmadalen uppför stora platt: Inhabitants of the Casma Valley construct large platforms, plazas and the Huaca A and Moxeke building complexes. The site serves as a regional ceremonial centre.
Invånare i Cuicuilco bygger den stora ru: Inhabitants of Cuicuilco build the great rounded platform, which is later enlarged in several stages. According to INAH, its large surface allows religious ceremonies with many participants. The long construction sequence includes at least eight known expansions.
Invånare i Cuicuilco bygger och utvidgar: Inhabitants of Cuicuilco build and enlarge a great ceremonial platform
Invånare i Kyiv tar emot det kristna dop: Inhabitants of Kyiv receive Christian baptism in 988 after Prince Vladimir's conversion. The population of the rest of Rus converts to Christianity over a longer period.
Invånare i Nepeñadalen bygger ett ceremo: Inhabitants of the Nepeña Valley build a ceremonial centre at Cerro Blanco
Invånare i Paso de la Amada använder ett: People at Paso de la Amada use a ceramic vessel for a cacao drink, according to researchers’ analysis of residues on its interior. The find shows early local use of cacao.
Invånare i Pre-Kerma bebor en bosättning: Pre-Kerma residents occupy a settlement with possible defences
Invånare lämnar Indusområdets storstäder: People leave the Indus region’s large cities for smaller settlements
Invånare nära Kerma förenar jordbruk och: Residents near Kerma combine farming and herding in a settlement with concentrated storage pits, huts and cattle enclosures. Honegger interprets parallel rows of wooden fences and earthwork as substantial defences, while the earlier report also considers livestock-enclosure functions for parts of the palisade system.
Invånare nära Sunset Crater upplever ett: Inhabitants near Sunset Crater experience a volcanic eruption that spreads lava and ash over the surrounding area. Farmers near the volcano probably leave farmland covered in thick layers of ash, while thinner layers farther away help the soil retain moisture.
Invånare på Kreta drabbas av omfattande: Inhabitants of Crete suffer widespread destruction around 1450 BC. During the following phase, potters use both Minoan and Mycenaean forms and motifs as influence from the Greek mainland increases.
Invånarna anlägger staden Kerma: The inhabitants establish the city of Kerma
Invånarna använder först delar av område: Residents first use parts of the area as a dumping ground, then create smaller domestic courtyards. The change concerns the Zone 2 neighbourhood, where earlier builders had erected large official buildings.
Invånarna befäster Xinzhai som ett regio: The inhabitants fortify Xinzhai as a regional centre
Invånarna bygger större bostadskomplex i: The inhabitants build larger residential complexes at Paquimé around 1200. They also construct workshops, temples and waterworks in the growing city.
Invånarna bygger ut Liangzhus stadsområd: The inhabitants expand Liangzhu's urban area
Invånarna i Chap odlar bland annat vete,: The inhabitants of Chap grow crops including wheat, barley, millet and lentils at an elevation of around 2,000 metres. Plant remains, crop-processing waste and animal bones show local subsistence combining farming with herding.
Invånarna i Ganja drabbas av en jordbävn: The inhabitants of Ganja suffer an earthquake
Invånarna i Ganja förlorar många liv när: The inhabitants of Ganja lose many lives when an earthquake destroys parts of the city. The Seljuk governor Qara Sonqor rebuilds the city after the earthquake and Georgian attacks.
Invånarna i Kyiv tar emot det kristna do: The inhabitants of Kyiv receive Christian baptism
Invånarna i Lefkandi på Euboia har ett v: The inhabitants of Lefkandi on Euboea have a prosperous community in the middle of the tenth century BC. At Toumba, they erect a large building with burial shafts for a cremated man, an inhumed woman and four horses. They later cover the building with a burial mound.
Invånarna i Liangzhu bygger palatsområde: Liangzhu's inhabitants build a palace area, residential areas and burial grounds with differences in the status of the graves. ICOMOS places most of the work on the urban area around 3000–2850 BC. People had lived in the area before this construction period.
Invånarna i Mán Bạc gravlägger sina döda: The people of Mán Bạc bury their dead with pottery and ornaments
Invånarna i Narhan använder fler slags j: The inhabitants of Narhan use more kinds of iron objects
Invånarna i Nikomedia drabbas av en jord: An earthquake strikes the people of Nicomedia. Buildings collapse and fire breaks out in the city.
Invånarna i Nikomedia drabbas av jordbäv: An earthquake strikes the people of Nicomedia
Invånarna i Pirak använder järn: The inhabitants of Pirak use iron
Invånarna kring Cahokia drabbas av en st: The inhabitants around Cahokia suffer a major flood from the Mississippi around 1150. They also face reduced summer rainfall, and researchers link the combination to pressure on agriculture and a declining population.
Invånarna lägger de döda oftast utsträck: People usually lay the dead stretched out on their backs, sometimes flexed on their sides, and give them pottery and personal ornaments. Researchers interpret the shared burial practices as possible evidence of local groups and incoming farmers coming together.
Invånarna lämnar den äldre bosättningen: The inhabitants leave the older settlement at Kalibangan

The inhabitants leave the older settlement at Kalibangan around 2700 BC. The excavators explain the abandonment as caused by an earthquake and estimate that the site remains abandoned for around a century.
Invånarna lämnar skadade vattenanläggnin: Residents leave damaged water installations unrepaired at Dholavira
Invånarna omger Xinzhai med två yttre di: The inhabitants surround Xinzhai with two outer ditches and an inner rammed-earth wall and moats. A partly sunken building of around 1,400 square metres belongs to the same settlement phase. According to the researchers, the site functions as a regional centre.
Invånarna på Sai använder slutna förråds: The inhabitants of Sai use sealed storage pits
Invånarna underhåller Dholaviras byggnad: Residents maintain Dholavira's buildings increasingly poorly, and builders carry out lower-quality repairs. Water installations are damaged in the middle of the phase and then remain unrepaired.
Invånarna utvecklar San Lorenzo till ett: Inhabitants develop San Lorenzo into an Olmec centre

Inhabitants develop San Lorenzo into a major centre in the Olmec world. They organize stone transport and produce sculptures. The museum’s description associates the remains with a society divided into different social groups.
Invånarna utvidgar Erlitou och bygger mo: Inhabitants expand Erlitou and build monumental complexes
Invånarna vid K2 i Limpopodalen odlar gr: The inhabitants at K2 in the Limpopo Valley grow crops and keep livestock during an archaeological phase that researchers date to circa 1000–1220. They build houses with earthen walls and keep grain in storehouses. Through long-distance trade they obtain glass beads and other foreign materials.
Invånarna överger bosättningen på Umm-an: The inhabitants abandon the settlement on Umm-an-Nar around 2000 BC, according to Harriet Crawford’s account. The change ends an earlier prosperous phase on the island.
Iranica anger 1238–1239 för denna underk: Iranica gives 1238–1239 for this phase of subjugation. The entry does not date the first Mongol contacts with the Caucasus or every local conquest to the same year.
Iranica anger 482 enligt den muslimska k: Iranica gives 482 in the Muslim calendar and the equivalent 1089.
Iranica anger 483 enligt den muslimska k: Iranica gives 483 in the Muslim calendar and the equivalent 1090. The designation Nizari for a later state is not projected back onto the takeover before the split of 1094.
Iranica anger 545 efter hijra med motsva: Iranica gives 545 after the Hijra with the equivalent 1150–1151. The range preserves the source's conversion and indicates no two-year siege.
Iranica anger 654/1256. Posten gäller fä: Iranica gives 654/1256. The entry concerns the strongholds in the specified region and does not claim that all Ismaili communities cease to exist.
Iranica anger 656/1258. Posten gäller ka: Iranica gives 656/1258. The entry concerns the caliphate in Baghdad; no uncertain massacre figures or later Abbasid claims are included.
Iranica anger den 11 jumada I 334 och mo: Iranica gives 11 Jumada I 334 and the equivalent 19 December 945. The date is reproduced as the source gives it; no new calendar conversion is made.
Iranica anger hela västfälttåget som 615: Iranica gives the entire western campaign as 615–621/1218–1224. This broad campaign is distinguished from the first invasions of 1219–1220; no independent conversion is made.
Iranica anger månaden som rabi al-awwal: Iranica gives the month as Rabi al-Awwal 878 and August 1473. The source's conversion is retained.
Iranica anger år 462 enligt den muslimsk: Iranica gives the year 462 in the Muslim calendar and the equivalent 1069–1070. The range concerns the dating of the completion.
Iranica daterar kansliets antagande till: Iranica dates the chancery's adoption to 1204. The entry concerns administrative use, not the invention of the script.
Iranica daterar stadens grundande till 7: Iranica dates the city's foundation to 762. The Ashmolean gives 758 for the start of construction and 762 for the move; the event concerns the move.
Iranica ger 9 ramadan 471 som 15 mars 10: Iranica gives 9 Ramadan 471 as 15 March 1079, also 19 Farvardin 448 in the Yazdegerdi era. No independent conversion or relabelling as Gregorian has been made.
Iranica skriver omkring 1206, medan Roya: Iranica writes around 1206, while the Royal Armouries state that the proclamation had taken place by 1206. The entry retains an approximate dating.
Iranica återger datumet som 10 ramadan 8: Iranica gives the date as 10 Ramadan 873 and 24 March 1469. The same article describes an interruption in his control during 1470.
Iranica återger födelsedatum 763 och 766: Iranica reproduces birth dates of 763 and 766 and prefers the latter. The game value uses 1 January 766; the day is a game convention.
Iranicas personartikel anger 786, medan: Iranica’s biographical article gives 786, while its article on slavery prints 170/787. The game value follows the biographical article and places the day on 1 January; the sources’ years are left unchanged.
Ishme-Dagan återtar Nippur och ger invån: Ishme-Dagan recovers Nippur and exempts its inhabitants from tax
Ishme-Dagan återtar Nippur senare under: Ishme-Dagan recovers Nippur later in his reign. He exempts the inhabitants from taxation and military service.
Isin och Larsa i södra Mesopotamien, nuv: Isin and Larsa in southern Mesopotamia, present-day Iraq
Isin-Larsatidens rivaliserande kungarike: Rival kingdoms of the Isin-Larsa period
Island, med arkeologiska fynd från Reykj: Iceland, with archaeological finds from Reykjavík
Islänningarna grundar alltinget vid Thin: The Icelanders found the Althing at Thingvellir
The Icelanders found the Althing at Thingvellir around 930. The participants meet in the open air to make laws and settle disputes.
Ismail besegrar Muhammad Shaybani vid Ma: Ismail defeats Muhammad Shaybani at Marv
Ismail ibn Ahmad för sin här över Oxus o: Ismail ibn Ahmad leads his army across the Oxus and defeats Amr ibn Layth's army outside Balkh in 900. The Samanids take the Saffarid ruler prisoner.
Ismail kröns till shah i Tabriz: Ismail is crowned shah in Tabriz
Ismail kröns till shah i Tabriz. Den nye: Ismail is crowned shah in Tabriz. The new ruler makes Twelver Shiism the state religion.
Ismails styrkor besegrar Muhammad Shayba: Ismail's forces defeat Muhammad Shaybani at Marv. The victory drives the Uzbeks back from Khorasan.
Israel Museum anger 1457 f.Kr. Philip De: The Israel Museum gives 1457 BC. Philip Derstine argues for 1468 BC and describes the older date of 1482 BC as rejected at a scholarly colloquium in 1987. The numerical bounds 1468–1457 bring together the alternatives reported here for one battle and do not indicate its duration. The annals give regnal year 23, day 21 of the first month of shemu.
Jackson ger det parade datumet 13 rabi I: Jackson gives the paired date 13 Rabi II 736/30 November 1335. Later power struggles are not compressed into a new exact end year; the suspicion of poisoning is omitted.
Jalaluddin Firuz Khalji blir sultan och: Jalaluddin Firuz Khalji becomes sultan and begins the Khalji dynasty's rule. The earlier Mamluk dynasty loses power in the Delhi Sultanate.
Jamnajasamhällen breder ut sig över den: Yamnaya communities expand across the Eurasian steppe
Jang Bogo återvänder till Silla och bygg: Jang Bogo returns to Silla and builds Cheonghaejin on Wando together with King Heungdeok. From there he directs domestic and foreign trade and combats the slave trade.
Jansaris sammanfattning anger hela inter: Jansari's summary gives the full interval. The lack of reliable early accounts leaves the victor in the conflict uncertain; peace terms and accession dates are not established here.
Japan och Tangriket, Kina: Japan and the Tang Empire, China
Japan tillåter permanent innehav av nyod: Japan permits permanent possession of newly reclaimed rice fields
Japans hov erkänner Tendai som buddhisti: Japan's court recognises Tendai as a Buddhist school. Saichō had returned from his studies in China the previous year.
Japan's court establishes the capital in Nara. The city houses the imperial palace, Buddhist temples and Shinto shrines.
Japans kejsarhov etablerar huvudstaden i: Japan's imperial court establishes the capital in Kyoto
Japans kejsarhov etablerar sin huvudstad: Japan's imperial court establishes its capital in Kyoto. The city planners draw on China's older capitals as models.
Java, däribland Canggu och Terung, nuvar: Java, including Canggu and Terung, present-day Indonesia
Jayavarman IV grundar Koh Ker år 921. Ha: Jayavarman IV founds Koh Ker in 921. He makes the city a centre of power that competes with Angkor for the role of capital of the Khmer Empire.
Jayavarman VII inviger Ta Prohm med namn: Jayavarman VII dedicates Ta Prohm under the name Rajavihara, the royal monastery. He dedicates it to his mother, whom he has represented in the form of the Buddhist Prajñāpāramitā.
Jayavarman VII inviger bilden av Lokeśva: Jayavarman VII dedicates the image of Lokeśvara in Preah Khan's innermost shrine. He associates the divine image with his father and gives it the name Jayavarmeśvara.
Jayavarman VII rules the Khmer Empire. He supports Mahayana Buddhism and builds Angkor Thom with the Bayon as the royal temple. The court’s royal cult also includes Hindu gods.
Jayavarman VII stödjer mahayanabuddhisme: Jayavarman VII supports Mahayana Buddhism and gives the Buddha the highest place in a royal cult in which Hindu gods remain.
Jayavarman inviger Preah Khans huvudbild: Jayavarman dedicates Preah Khan's principal image
Jeanne d’Arc leder franska anfall mot en: Joan of Arc leads French attacks against English positions at Orléans in early May 1429. The English concede defeat and withdraw on 8 May.
Jerwan, norr om Nineve, norra Mesopotami: Jerwan, north of Nineveh, northern Mesopotamia
Jesus avrättas genom korsfästelse i Jeru: Jesus is executed by crucifixion in Jerusalem. The timing in relation to the days of Passover is disputed.
Jikji trycks med lösa metalltyper: Jikji is printed with movable metal type
Jin och dess bundsförvanter möter Chu vi: Jin and its allies face Chu at Chengpu. Jin wins through tactical manoeuvres, while Ziyu's central force withdraws undefeated. The victory is an important event in the struggle for power between the two states.
Jinhovet etablerar Östra Jin söder om Ya: The Jin court establishes Eastern Jin south of the Yangtze
The Jin court establishes Eastern Jin south of the Yangtze. Its capital is at present-day Nanjing.
Jinrikets trupper intar Songdynastins hu: Jin troops capture the Song dynasty's capital, Kaifeng. Many officials flee south, where they establish a new court and continue Song rule.
Jinshi förlägger grundandet till 1115. Q: The Jinshi places the foundation in 1115. Qiu Jingjia argues for Tianqing 7, which the article equates with 1117, and reports Liu Pujiang's earlier proposal of 1117 or 1118. The date of the name Great Jin is also part of the scholarly discussion; the entry therefore establishes no certain foundation day.
Jo Gwang-jo förföljs under lärdomspurgen: Jo Gwang-jo is persecuted during the literati purge of 1519. His followers are exiled or removed from office.
Johan utan land förseglar Magna Carta i: John Lackland seals Magna Carta at Runnymede after the barons' rebellion. The agreement limits the king's scope for action, but the pope annuls it ten weeks later.
Johannes Gutenberg och Johannes Fust fra: Johannes Gutenberg and Johannes Fust produce their printed Latin Bible in Mainz during 1454–1455. Craftspeople complete the copies' initials and other parts of the decoration by hand.
Johannes XII kröner Otto I till kejsare: John XII crowns Otto I emperor
Joner i Mindre Asien gör uppror under Da: Ionians in Asia Minor rebel during the reign of Darius I. Athens and Eretria support them, forming part of the background to the ensuing Persian Wars.
Jordbrukare och boskapsskötare lever vid: Farmers and herders live at K2
Jordbrukare som arkeologer förknippar me: Farmers whom archaeologists associate with Zhizo pottery settle at Schroda in the Limpopo Valley. During the tenth century, the inhabitants take part in trade with the Indian Ocean coast; archaeologists have found imported glass beads and ivory objects in the settlement's Zhizo layers.
Jordbrukare vid Baodun odlar ris och kol: Farmers at Baodun grow rice and foxtail millet
Jordens altare byggs i Peking: The Altar of Earth is built in Beijing
Jordens altare, Ditan, byggs i Peking 15: The Altar of Earth, Ditan, is built in Beijing in 1530. The complex is used for imperial sacrifices to the earth at the summer solstice.
Joseon utser Hanyang till huvudstad: Joseon designates Hanyang as its capital
Joseonannalerna antecknar att kung Sejon: The Joseon annals record that King Sejong has created a new writing system. The entry belongs to the twelfth lunar month of 1443.
Joseondynastin utser Hanyang till huvuds: The Joseon dynasty designates Hanyang as its capital. The already inhabited place thereby gains a new role as the kingdom's political centre.
Jovianus avstår områden och städer till: Jovian cedes territories and cities to Persia
Jovianus sluter år 363 ett avtal om terr: In 363, Jovian concludes a treaty ceding territory to Persia. Ammianus lists five provinces as well as Nisibis and Singara; Bury confirms the year and the cities but disputes the division into provinces and counts three provinces returned.
Juan Sebastián Elcano för expeditionen t: Juan Sebastián Elcano brings the expedition back to Spain. The voyage has by then circled the globe.
Juba II blir kung av Mauretanien: Juba II becomes king of Mauretania
Judarna i Alexandria förföljs och fördri: Alexandria's Jews face persecution and expulsion
Judiska uppror bryter ut i romerska prov: Jewish revolts break out in Roman provinces
Julius Caesar mördas i Rom. Mordet blir: Julius Caesar is assassinated in Rome. The murder decisively interrupts his exercise of power.
Justinianus ger ut och reviderar sin lag: Justinian issues and revises his law code
Justinianus sammanför romerska lagar i e: Justinian compiles Roman laws in a code in 529. He has later legislation added to a revised edition in 534.
Järn förekommer i Lahuradevas tredje bos: Iron occurs in Lahuradeva's third settlement phase
Järn utvinns ur dansk myrmalm: Iron is extracted from Danish bog ore
Järnfynd ingår i ett nytt bosättningsske: Iron finds appear in a new settlement phase at Hallur
Järnproduktion från lokal myrmalm etable: Iron production from local bog ore becomes established in Denmark. The researcher describes ironworking in ordinary farming villages, probably as a sideline where ore and fuel are available.
K2 nära Mapungubwe, nuvarande Sydafrika: K2 near Mapungubwe, present-day South Africa
Kairo, Egypten, med anknytning till Mali: Cairo, Egypt, with connections to the Mali Empire in West Africa
Kairouan är belagd som huvudort. Ingen ö: Kairouan is attested as the principal centre. No consulted source dates Ibrahim’s move to the new palace area within 800.
Kairouans område; exakt palats och viste: Kairouan area; exact palace and whereabouts unknown
Kalif återger källornas titel för den al: Caliph renders the sources’ title for the Almohad ruler.
Kalifen al-Mamun utser Tahir ibn Husayn: Caliph al-Mamun appoints Tahir ibn Husayn governor of Khorasan and the eastern provinces in spring 821. Tahir's family subsequently continues to hold the governorship of Khorasan.
Caliph al-Mansur has Abu Moslem killed. Abu Moslem had led the Abbasid revolt in Khorasan.
Kalifen al-Mansur tar sitt nya palats i: Caliph al-Mansur begins using his new palace in Baghdad. He moves the court, treasury and army there.
Kalifen al-Mutasim grundar Samarra år 83: Caliph al-Mutasim founds Samarra in 836. He moves his capital there from Baghdad.
Kalifen al-Walid låter uppföra en moské: Caliph al-Walid commissions a mosque in Damascus. The builders transform the site of the Church of John the Baptist into the capital's Friday mosque.
Kalifen utnämnde Ibrahim, vars familj se: The caliph appointed Ibrahim, whose family then retained power through succession by his sons; the sources attest no automatic precedence for the eldest son.
Kalifen utsåg tronföljare ur familjen; d: The caliph designated successors from the family; the younger al-Amin received precedence over his older half-brother, so neither birthright of the eldest nor a council’s merit-based choice describes the arrangement.
Kalifens hov lämnar Samarra år 892. Al-M: The caliph's court leaves Samarra in 892. Al-Mutasim had founded the city as his new capital in 836.
Kalifens son och utsedde tronföljare: The caliph’s son and designated successor
Kalifens son, senare känd som al-Muʿtasi: The caliph’s son, later known as al-Muʿtasim
Kaliff och Oestigaard placerar det utvec: Kaliff and Oestigaard place the developed Yamnaya complex's appearance around 3300 BC and its extent from Hungary to Kazakhstan by around 3000 BC. These are approximate bounds for an initial expansion, not one migration or an exact beginning. Their wider c. 3300–2500 BC culture span continues beyond this episode.
Kamalagyan och Waringin Sapta, nedre Bra: Kamalagyan and Waringin Sapta, lower Brantas River, East Java, Indonesia
Kampanjens fulla intervall behålls. Thuk: The full campaign interval is retained. Thucydides describes the decision in the preceding winter of 416/415, which does not shift the start of the campaign itself.
Kanishka I tillträder enligt kronologin: Kanishka I accedes under the 127/128 chronology
Kanopos i Nildeltat, Egypten: Canopus in the Nile Delta, Egypt
Kanō Motonobu målar omkring 1513 sex pan: Around 1513, Kanō Motonobu paints six panels depicting Zen patriarchs. They are intended for a subtemple of Daitokuji in Kyoto.
Kardinal Nicolaus Breakspeare kommer til: Cardinal Nicholas Breakspear comes to Nidaros in 1152–1153 to establish an archbishopric for Norway and the western islands. Church leaders use revenues from the new ecclesiastical province to expand Christ Church.
Kardinaler väljer Clemens VII mot Urban: Cardinals elect Clement VII in opposition to Urban VI
Karl IV grundar ett studium generale i P: Charles IV founds a studium generale in Prague. He promises teachers and students royal protection and privileges following the examples of Paris and Bologna.
Karl IV reglerar kungavalet genom Gyllen: Charles IV regulates royal elections through the Golden Bull
Karl IV utfärdar universitetets grundläg: Charles IV issues the university's foundation charter in Prague
Karl den store blir kung över en del av: Charlemagne becomes king of part of the Frankish realm. His brother Carloman rules the other part of their father's kingdom.
Karl den store för krig mot langobardern: Charlemagne wages war against the Lombards. He deposes Desiderius and takes the title of king of the Lombards.
Karl firade julen i Rom och stannade där: Charles celebrated Christmas in Rome and stayed there throughout the winter. He left the city on 25 April.
Karl och Karloman blir kungar över frank: Charles and Carloman become kings of the Franks
Karls dotter med en frilla vars namn Ein: Charles’s daughter with a concubine whose name Einhard does not remember
Karls hustru, död före bokmärket: Charles’s wife, deceased before the bookmark
Karls hustru, mor till Karl, Pippin och: Charles’s wife, mother of Charles, Pippin and Louis, died in 783
Karls son med en frilla, munk efter samm: Charles’s son with a concubine, a monk after the conspiracy of 792
Karmaterna angriper Mecka och för bort S: The Qarmatians attack Mecca and carry off the Black Stone
Karthagiska och etruskiska styrkor fören: Carthaginian and Etruscan forces combine at the Battle of Aleria on Corsica to gain control of the Mediterranean. Soon afterwards the kingdom of Tartessos collapses.
Karthago och etruskerna utkämpar slaget: Carthage and the Etruscans fight the Battle of Aleria
Kastiliens och Portugals företrädare slu: Representatives of Castile and Portugal conclude an agreement at Tordesillas on 7 June 1494. They draw a north–south dividing line west of the Cape Verde Islands for the crowns' claims in the Atlantic.
Kazimir III grundar ett studium generale: Casimir III founds a studium generale in Kraków
Keios föremålstext anger Jōan 5 och ger: Keio's object text gives Jōan 5 and the equivalent 1175. The year refers to the doctrinal development described by the text, not the first spread of Buddhism in Japan.
Kejsar Alexander Severus mördas. Med han: Emperor Alexander Severus is assassinated. His death ends the Severan imperial dynasty.
Kejsar Decius och hans äldre son Herenni: Emperor Decius and his elder son Herennius die in the battle of Abritus during the war against Gothic invaders. The troops then proclaim Trebonianus Gallus emperor.
Kejsar Dezong regerar över Tangriket sed: Emperor Dezong has ruled the Tang Empire since 779. In the capital Chang’an stands the Zhangjing Temple, whose monks have close ties to the court. Dezong has taken the bodhisattva vows under Daocheng. His eldest son is named Li Song.
Kejsar Dezong utfärdar den skattereform: Emperor Dezong promulgates the tax reform proposed by Yang Yan. It provides for twice-yearly collection and assessments based on property, with provincial officials involved in collection and allocation of quotas.
Kejsar Gaozong befaller ämbetsmännen att: Emperor Gaozong orders officials to carry out Li Chunnian's land surveys in the Song Empire. The new registers also include woodland and other land beyond the fields, giving the authorities better information for taxation and property disputes.
Kejsar Go-Daigo och hans anhängare stört: Emperor Go-Daigo and his followers overthrow the Kamakura shogunate. They try to return political power to the imperial throne through the Kenmu Restoration.
Kejsar Go-Toba ger Minamoto Yoritomo tit: Emperor Go-Toba gives Minamoto Yoritomo the title seii taishōgun. Yoritomo directs his military apparatus from Kamakura, while the imperial court remains in place.
Kejsar Henrik V avstår från att ge bisko: Emperor Henry V renounces investing bishops with their offices by ring and staff. Pope Calixtus II grants the emperor a presence at episcopal elections in the German realm and the right to confer temporal rights with a lance.
Kejsar Karl IV låter skriva ned regler f: Emperor Charles IV has rules for the election of the King of the Romans set down in writing. He establishes the prince-electors' rights and excludes the pope from a say in the election.
Kejsar Kōtoku utfärdar Taikareformen: Emperor Kōtoku issues the Taika Reform
Kejsar Kōtoku utfärdar Taikareformen för: Emperor Kōtoku issues the Taika Reform to strengthen imperial authority and weaken the aristocratic families. On the Chinese model, all farmland becomes the emperor's property and all inhabitants his subjects, governed by a merit-based bureaucracy.
Kejsar Saga ger Kūkai tillstånd att anlä: Emperor Saga gives Kūkai permission to establish a monastic centre on Mount Kōya. Kūkai begins construction in 819.
Kejsar Saga godkänner ett nytt system fö: Emperor Saga approves a new system for examining and recognising monks on Mount Hiei. Saichō had proposed new rules for Tendai monks in 815.
Kejsar Septimius Severus dör i York meda: Emperor Septimius Severus dies at York while ill. He therefore does not live to take part personally in the renewed campaign north of Hadrian’s Wall.
Kejsar Shōmu utfärdar en befallning om e: Emperor Shōmu orders a network of Buddhist monasteries in Japan. At the same time, he raises Kinshō-ji's status within the imperial temple organisation.
Kejsar Wuzong förbjuder buddhister att a: Emperor Wuzong forbids Buddhists to use gold, silver, copper, iron and precious stones in religious images. He requires them to use clay and wood during the persecution of Buddhism.
Kejsar Xian kommer under Cao Caos beskyd: Emperor Xian comes under Cao Cao’s protection at his headquarters.
Kejsar Xiaowen flyttar Norra Weis huvuds: Emperor Xiaowen moves the Northern Wei capital to Luoyang. He imposes a policy of sinicization, requiring the Xianbei and others to adopt Chinese surnames, language and dress. Resentment of these policies contributes to the dynasty's fall in the mid-sixth century.
Kejsaren anförtror templet Tōji åt Kūkai: The emperor entrusts the temple of Tōji to Kūkai. Kūkai uses the temple to teach esoteric Buddhism.
Kejsaren ger Kūkai ansvar för Tōji: The emperor places Kūkai in charge of Tōji
Kejsaren leder personligen krig mot germ: The emperor personally leads wars against Germanic and Sarmatian peoples.
Kenoyer skriver att murarna tycks ha avg: Kenoyer writes that the walls appear to have enclosed the settlements during the Kot Diji phase. The range dates the phase and gives no individual construction year.
Keramik från Khao Sam Kaeo vittnar enlig: According to Bouvet's analysis, pottery from Khao Sam Kaeo provides evidence of contacts with the Indian subcontinent. Materials and manufacturing techniques are used to investigate the exchange.
Keramik i Sembiran liknar fynd från den: Pottery at Sembiran resembles finds from the Indo-Roman trading site of Arikamedu.
Keramik visar kontakter mellan Khao Sam: Pottery reveals contacts between Khao Sam Kaeo and India
Keramiken i Vinelz tar upp snörkeramiska: Vinelz pottery incorporates Corded Ware elements
Kerma förlorar Nedre Nubien till Egypten: Kerma loses Lower Nubia to Egypt
Kerma förlorar kontrollen över Nedre Nub: Kerma loses control of Lower Nubia when the Egyptian kings of Dynasty 18 begin campaigns against Upper Nubia. By about 1450 BC Egypt rules Nubia as far south as the fourth cataract through a viceroy, the King's Son of Kush.
Kermaområdet, Övre Nubien, nuvarande Sud: Kerma area, Upper Nubia, present-day Sudan
Kermas östra gravfält, Nubien, nuvarande: Kerma's eastern cemetery, Nubia, present-day Sudan
Khaljidynastin tar makten i Delhi: The Khalji dynasty takes power in Delhi
Khao Sam Kaeo på Malackahalvön, nuvarand: Khao Sam Kaeo on the Malay Peninsula, in present-day Thailand
Khasekhemwy bygger en kunglig kultinhägn: Khasekhemwy builds a royal cult enclosure at Abydos
Khasekhemwys monumentala inhägnad av sol: Khasekhemwy's monumental mud-brick enclosure at Abydos forms part of his funerary complex. The open-air cultic structure is associated with rituals expressing divine kingship.
Khmerrikets härskare återför maktcentrum: The Khmer rulers return the centre of power to Angkor
Khmerrikets härskare återför rikets poli: The rulers of the Khmer Empire return the empire's political centre to Angkor in 944. Before this, they had maintained Koh Ker as the sole capital since 928.
Khok Phanom Di, Bang Pakongs mynning, ce: Khok Phanom Di, mouth of the Bang Pakong, central Thailand
Khorasan, östra iranska området och Cent: Khorasan, the eastern Iranian region and Central Asia
Khotan och Tarimbäckenet, Centralasien: Khotan and the Tarim Basin, Central Asia
Khwarazmshahen Tekish besegrar och dödar: The Khwarazmshah Tekish defeats and kills the last Great Seljuk sultan, Tughril III, in 1194. Two years earlier he had reached Rayy and demanded overlordship over western Iran.
Kim Busik får befälet över Goryeos här f: Kim Busik receives command of Goryeo's army to suppress Myocheong's rebellion. Before the campaign, he has the rebels' supporters Jeong Jisang, Kim An and Baek Suhan executed in the capital, Gaegyeong.
Kim Busik leder hären mot Myocheongs upp: Kim Busik leads the army against Myocheong's rebellion
Kim Busik och andra lärda sammanställer: Kim Busik and other scholars compile the Samguk sagi on King Injong's orders. They describe Goguryeo, Baekje and Silla through annals, biographies and sections on the kingdoms' institutions.
Kim Busik sammanställer Samguk sagi: Kim Busik compiles the Samguk sagi
Kina (museets kulturtillhörighet; tillve: China (the museum's cultural affiliation; place of manufacture not given)
Kina och Samarkand; fyndplats nära Dunhu: China and Samarkand; findspot near Dunhuang
Kina tar kontroll över Vietnam under per: China takes control of Vietnam during the period 1406–1428. The intervention is justified as a restoration of the Tran dynasty.
Kina; exemplaret hittades i Mogao vid Du: China; the copy was found at Mogao near Dunhuang
Kindattus allians intar Ur och tar Ibbi-: Kindattu's alliance captures Ur and takes Ibbi-Sin prisoner
Kinesiska astronomer ser en ljusstark gä: Chinese astronomers see a bright guest star
Kinesiska astronomer ser en ny ljusstark: Chinese astronomers see a new bright star in 1054. They can make it out in daylight for several weeks; present-day astronomers associate the observation with the supernova that left behind the Crab Nebula.
Kinesiska historieskrifter daterar Gojos: Chinese histories date Gojoseon's fall to this year. Archaeological remains show that its material traditions continue afterwards.
Kirgizerna intar och plundrar uigurernas: The Kyrgyz capture and sack the Uyghur capital on the Orkhon in 840. Groups of Uyghurs subsequently leave their homeland in Mongolia.
Kirgizerna plundrar uigurernas huvudstad: The Kyrgyz sack the Uyghur capital
Klodvig I, de saliska frankernas kung, o: Clovis I, king of the Salian Franks, converts to Christianity with all his entourage. His early adoption of Roman Christianity and his later victories win him wider rule, and at his death the Frankish kingdom is among the most powerful in western Europe.
Kloritkärl tillverkade i södra Iran och: Chlorite vessels made in southern Iran and the greater Gulf region are decorated over the entire surface with abstract patterns, plant and architectural motifs, or animals and humans. The vessels are traded across the Near East, from Syria to the Indus Valley.
Klostret i Prüm, om han levde: The monastery in Prüm, if he was alive
Knut blir obestridd kung över England år: Cnut becomes undisputed king of England in 1016. Æthelred's surviving sons and Edmund's son flee abroad.
Kochkordalen i Tien Shan, nuvarande Kirg: Kochkor Valley in the Tian Shan, present-day Kyrgyzstan
Kolonnens reliefer framställer kejsarens: The column’s reliefs portray the emperor’s two wars against the Dacians.
Konciliet i Dabra Metmaq godkänner sabba: The council of Dabra Metmaq endorses Sabbath observance
Konfucianska lärda förföljs i Joseon: Confucian scholars are persecuted in Joseon
Konfucius dör enligt den traditionella d: Confucius dies according to the traditional chronology
Kongos kung Afonso klagar i brev över at: Kongo's king Afonso complains in letters that free subjects are abducted and sold. He also describes checks by royal officials to distinguish free people from captives.
Kongos kung döps 1491 och tar namnet Joã: Kongo's king is baptised in 1491 and takes the name João I. Through baptism he forges closer ties with Portugal.
Kongos kung döps som João I: Kongo's king is baptised as João I
Konstantin V sammankallar kyrkomötet i H: Constantine V convenes the Council of Hieria. The bishops support iconoclasm and promote the cross as the symbol of Christianity and imperial power.
Konstantin gör Konstantinopel till riket: Constantine makes Constantinople the empire’s capital. The sources read give 330 and 331 respectively for the change.
Konstantin låter bygga Peterskyrkan i Ro: Constantine commissions Saint Peter’s in Rome
Konstantin låter bygga den äldre Petersk: Constantine commissions Old Saint Peter’s in Rome. The museum dates its construction to 320–327.
Konstantin och Licinius medger fri relig: Constantine and Licinius grant freedom of worship
Konstantin och Licinius medger kristna o: Constantine and Licinius allow Christians and others to follow the religion they choose. The reproduced text refers to their meeting in Milan.
Konstantin samlar Romarriket under sitt: Constantine unites the Roman Empire under his rule
Konstantin samlar rikets östra och västr: Constantine brings the empire’s eastern and western parts under his rule. The museum dates the reunification to 324.
Konstantinopel anges som kejsarinnans äm: Constantinople is given as the empress’s official seat and residence.
Konstnärer i Ife gör fler figurer av män: Artists at Ife make more figures of humans and animals in stone and terracotta during the period circa 800–1000. They depict the figures with greater naturalism.
Konstnärer i Ife gör fler människo- och: Artists at Ife make more human and animal figures
Koreanska begravningar blir mer utarbeta: Korean burials grow more elaborate, with dolmen tombs
Koroibos från Elis räknas som den förste: Koroibos of Elis is regarded as the first recorded Olympic victor and is traditionally placed in 776 BC. Later Greek historians use Olympiads, the four-year periods between the Games, to date events.
Koroibos seger inleder den traditionella: Koroibos's victory begins the traditional list of Olympic victors
Korsfarare intar Jerusalem den 15 juli 1: Crusaders capture Jerusalem on 15 July 1099 and drive out the Fatimid governor. They kill Muslim, Jewish and Christian inhabitants of the city.
Korsfarare intar Jerusalem och dödar inv: Crusaders capture Jerusalem and kill inhabitants
Korsfararna intar den bysantinska huvuds: The crusaders capture the Byzantine capital Constantinople during the Fourth Crusade. The conquest breaks the city's long continuity as the centre of the Byzantine court's art and culture.
Krig bryter ut mellan Rom och dess itali: War breaks out between Rome and its Italian allies. During the conflict, new laws extend Roman citizenship.
Krig och räder från Elam avslutar kassit: Wars and raids from Elam end Kassite rule in southern Mesopotamia. During the attacks, monuments from the region’s sanctuaries are taken to Susa.
Krishna III besegrar Cholas vid Takkolam: Krishna III defeats the Cholas at Takkolam
Krishnadevaraya tar enligt Sewells bedöm: According to Sewell's assessment, Krishnadevaraya takes over the throne around 1509. He becomes ruler of Vijayanagara.
Krishnadevarayas styrkor besegrar Bijapu: Krishnadevaraya's forces defeat Bijapur's army at Raichur. Sewell dates the battle to 1520.
Kristna korsfarare besegrar almohaderna: Christian crusaders defeat the Almohads at Las Navas de Tolosa
Christian crusaders defeat the Almohads at Las Navas de Tolosa. The battle is fought near Santa Elena in the present-day province of Jaén.
Kronologin anger 279/278 utan ett enskil: The chronology gives 279/278 without a single certain year.
Kronornas sändebud avtalar i Tordesillas: The crowns' envoys reach an agreement at Tordesillas
Kronprinsen efterträder sin far, men kun: The crown prince succeeds his father, but royal relatives can seize the throne by force; the game’s primogeniture simplifies this arrangement.
Krukmakare använder nya former och dekor: Potters use new shapes and decorate vessels with concentric circles, semicircles and other geometric patterns. Multiple brushes are used together for the circular decoration. The Protogeometric style builds on earlier pottery traditions.
Krukmakare i Goryeo tillverkar ett kärl: Potters in Goryeo make a vessel bearing the year 993. In the inscription they state that the vessel is to be used in the royal ancestral shrine.
Krukmakare tillverkar ett kärl för Gorye: Potters make a vessel for Goryeo's royal ancestral shrine
Kublai blir mongolisk storkhan. Hans mak: Kublai becomes Mongol Great Khan. His exercise of power will combine Mongol traditions with Chinese forms of administration.
Kublai ger sitt välde det kinesiska dyna: Kublai gives his realm the Chinese dynastic name Great Yuan. The Southern Song Empire has not yet been finally conquered.
Kublai khans styrkor fullbordar erövring: Kublai Khan's forces complete the conquest of the Southern Song Empire. China is thereby united under the overlordship of the Mongol Yuan dynasty.
Kublai utfärdar ett påbud som gör Phags-: Kublai issues an edict making the Phags-pa script the empire's official script. The Tibetan lama Phags-pa has designed it on the khan's commission for use in a multilingual empire.
Kuckertz placerar övergången omkring mit: Kuckertz places the transition around the middle of the fourth century; 350 is an approximate chronological anchor, not a securely dated final burial. No royal pyramid burials are known at Meroe thereafter. This does not establish a single year for political collapse or an Aksumite conquest.
Kulturarvsnomineringen använder 1303. Bu: The heritage nomination uses 1303. Buang's review reports al-Attas's 22 February 1303 and Adam's 20 December 1308, as well as Blagden's older 1303–1387 range. These are competing readings of the inscription's date, not an eighty-four-year episode. The stone does not date the first arrival of Islam or demonstrate how fully its rules were enforced.
Kulturmyndigheten anger detta grundnings: The cultural authority gives this foundation year.
Kunaxa nära Babylon i nuvarande Irak; ex: Cunaxa near Babylon in present-day Iraq; exact location uncertain
Kung Indravarman I inviger templet Bakon: King Indravarman I dedicates the temple of Bakong at Roluos. He dedicates it to Shiva in the form of a linga named Sri Indresvara.
Kung Kazimir III grundar ett studium gen: King Casimir III founds a studium generale in Kraków. He promises to fund faculties of law, medicine and the liberal arts.
Kung Lý Anh Tông inrättar handelshamnen: King Lý Anh Tông establishes the trading port of Vân Đồn. The court thereby gives trade in Đại Việt's northeastern coastal region a royally established port.
Kung Sejong beordrar ett angrepp på Tsus: King Sejong orders an attack on Tsushima in 1419. The island is used as a base by Japanese pirates.
Kung Seong flyttar Baekjes huvudstad frå: King Seong moves Baekje's capital from Ungjin to Sabi, present-day Buyeo.
Kung Untash-Napirisha bygger en ny huvud: King Untash-Napirisha builds a new capital and religious complex with a ziggurat at Chogha Zanbil. Glazed blue and green terracotta covers the ziggurat's facade, and glass and ivory mosaics decorate its interior.
Kung Wuling inför ryttarbågskytte i Zhao: King Wuling introduces mounted archery in Zhao
Kung Yasovarman I låter uppföra eller sl: King Yasovarman I has Lolei's four brick towers built or completed in honour of his ancestors. His inscription carvers date several inscriptions there to 893.
Kung i Akvitanien sedan 781, Karls son,: King in Aquitaine since 781, Charles’s son, later emperor
Kung i Italien sedan 781, Karls son: King in Italy since 781, Charles’s son
Kung är svensk återgivning av källans ku: 'Kung' is the Swedish rendering of the source’s royal title.
Kung återger forskarnas benämning på Chi: King renders the scholars’ designation of Chimú’s rulers. The source does not attest a named officeholder in 1200.
Kungariket Kongo, med påvliga förbindels: Kongo kingdom, with papal connections to the Vatican
