Kungen av Larsa besegrar Isin. Segern av: The king of Larsa defeats Isin. The victory ends the rivalry between the cities and becomes the reference point for Larsa’s subsequent year names.
Kungens farbror och regent: The king’s paternal uncle and regent
Kungens son, gift med Blanka av Kastilie: The king’s son, married to Blanche of Castile
Kushanriket i Central- och Sydasien: Kushan Empire in Central and South Asia
Kushs härskare uppför palatset B 1500 vi: The rulers of Kush build palace B 1500 at Jebel Barkal.
Kustbor drabbas av jordbävning och tsuna: Coastal populations suffer an earthquake and tsunami
Kykladisk kulturtillhörighet; fynd- och: Cycladic cultural affiliation; findspot and place of manufacture are not given in the object entry
Kyrillos och Methodios kommer till Morav: Cyril and Methodius arrive in Moravia in 863 as leaders of a Byzantine mission. The emperor has sent them at the Moravian prince's request to develop Christian preaching in his territory.
Kyrillos och Methodios kommer till Storm: Cyril and Methodius arrive in Great Moravia
Kyrkan San Vitale i Ravenna invigs. Den: The church of San Vitale in Ravenna is dedicated. Mosaics adorn the octagonal church.
Kyrkomötet ger Konstantinopels biskop he: The council grants Constantinople’s bishop precedence of honour after Rome
The council grants the bishop of Constantinople precedence of honour after the bishop of Rome. In Canon III, the participants justify this on the grounds that Constantinople is New Rome.
Kyrkomötet i Nicaea godkänner vördnad fö: The Council of Nicaea approves the veneration of icons
Kyrkomötets väljare utser Martin V: The council's electors choose Martin V
Kyros den store grundar akemenidernas ri: Cyrus the Great founds the Achaemenid empire
Kyros den yngre försöker störta Artaxerx: Cyrus the Younger attempts to overthrow Artaxerxes II but is killed at Cunaxa. His attempt to seize the Persian throne fails.
Kyros den yngre stupar vid Kunaxa: Cyrus the Younger falls at Cunaxa

Källan anger Caka 1287 och ger en motsva: The source gives Caka 1287 and an equivalent within 1365. Only the year is used; the entry dates the poem's composition, not a surviving physical manuscript.
Källan anger Tollanfasen som en arkeolog: The source gives the Tollan phase as an archaeological period. The year 900 marks the start of the range and establishes neither the city's foundation nor the year of its greatest extent.
Källan anger andra månmånaden i Giáp Tý: The source gives the second lunar month of Giáp Tý and its equivalent, 544. The entry uses only the year.
Källan anger april 787 utan dag. Spelvär: The source gives April 787 without a day. The game value uses 1 January according to the dossier’s year convention.
Källan anger att flertalet kungliga begr: The source states that most royal burials took place here from this century onward. The interval concerns the beginning of this development; no single year of relocation is given.
Källan anger avresan från Gorganj våren: The source gives the departure from Gorganj in spring 309–310/922. It gives no exact day of arrival in the passage consulted.
Källan anger början av 1377. Posten gör: The source gives early 1377. The entry does not invalidate Avignon's later papal activity.
Källan anger början av det tredje århund: The source specifies the beginning of the third century AD. The entire century, 201–300, is used as a search interval; this does not state how long the intervention lasted.
Källan anger cirka 50 och beskriver våld: The source gives approximately 50 and describes the use of force as probable.
Källan anger cirka 791. Dateringen fasts: The source gives circa 791. The date establishes no exact year for the campaign.

Källan anger en process från maktövertag: The source describes a process from the seizure of power in 581 to the unification of the realm, completed by 589. It gives no exact date here for the final campaign.
Källan anger en ungefärlig byggstart. By: The source gives an approximate start of construction. Builders continue to expand the complex in later centuries.
Källan anger ett intervall för sammanbro: The source gives a range for the collapse. The contribution of drought is a research hypothesis.
Källan anger ett ungefärligt år. Detta ä: The source gives an approximate year. This is the invasion of Parthia; the earlier royal proclamation is dated separately.
Källan anger ett årtionde. Intervallet 3: The source gives a decade. The interval 370–379 represents that decade and does not attest activity in every year.
Källan anger full återgång till demokrat: The source specifies a full return to democracy in this year.
Källan anger födelse 787, tronföljarutnä: The source gives birth in 787, designation as successor in 792 and a reign of 809–813.
Källan anger födelse 788–789 och död 838: The source gives birth in 788–789 and death in 838.
Källan anger födelseåret 1188. Den 1 jan: The source gives the birth year as 1188. The first of January is a game-specific day.
Källan anger födelseåret 788, Wonseongs: The source gives the birth year as 788, Wonseong’s fourth year. The first of January is a game-specific day. The source uses both 12 and 13 years for his age at accession; no explanation of the age reckoning is supplied.
Källan anger hans dödsår som 805, efter: The source gives his death year as 805, after the bookmark.
Källan anger hela krigsintervallet. Händ: The source gives the full war interval. The event is not placed in a single arbitrarily chosen year.
Källan anger hennes födelse omkring 1175: The source gives her birth around 1175, marriage in 1193 and death in 1237 or 1238.
Källan anger juli eller augusti; ingen a: The source gives July or August; neither month is selected as certain.
Källan anger kriget som en sammanhängand: The source gives the war as a continuous period, 1180–1185. The victory therefore does not recur as a separate entry for 1185.
Källan anger muharram 536 och september: The source gives Muharram 536 and September 1141. A later paragraph in the same article has the erroneous pairing 582/1141. The dating in the battle's main paragraph agrees with Iranica's article on Khorasan.
Källan anger slutet av 792. Den 1 januar: The source gives the end of 792. The first of January is the game’s year placeholder and does not refer to a historical birthday.
Källan anger tidigt 800-tal utan snävare: The source gives the early ninth century without a narrower date. The numerical range covers the century and indicates no certain start of construction in 800.
Källan anger tillträde i den sjätte måna: The source gives accession in the sixth month of 800 and death in the seventh month of 809. No day has been converted to the game calendar.
Källan anger två möjliga år. Spelvärdet: The source gives two possible years. The game value uses the earlier year and 1 January; the day is a game convention.
Källan anger året för slaget och Valens: The source gives the year of the battle and Valens’s death. No reconstructed day-date is included.
Källan anger årtal utan att översätta en: The source gives years without converting a calendar day.
Källan anger årtalet men ingen dag. Post: The source provides the year but no day. This entry adds no independent explanation of the siege's domestic political background.
Källan belägger att al-Hakam lät sonen t: The source attests that al-Hakam had his son receive an oath of allegiance shortly before the accession in 822. It establishes no succession practice or designated heir for 800.
Källan belägger en trohetsed till sonen: The source attests an oath of allegiance to the son shortly before 822; succession practice at the start in 800 remains uncertain.
Källan belägger far–son-skiftet 1193 och: The source attests the father-to-son succession in 1193 and the collateral lines’ seizures of power in 1206 and 1211. The assessment of the game’s laws is a simplification, and the later coup is not an event that has already occurred at the start.
Källan belägger hans identitet, livstid: The source attests his identity, lifespan and relationship. It gives no location for him on the bookmark date. No game values for ability or personality have historical source support.
Källan belägger hovets stöd till buddhis: The source attests the court’s support for Buddhist texts. It does not appoint a common religious leader for 1200 or specify an exact occasion of the emperor’s own religious practice.
Källan beskriver Aetios som eunuck. Köns: The source describes Aetios as a eunuch. The male sex code indicates no fertility. The game needs to preserve this before he is used to form a family; his later military command is not backdated.
Källan beskriver Clemens vistelse som pe: The source describes Clement's stays as periodic. The entry claims no uninterrupted presence or completed papal palace in 1309.
Källan beskriver Uruk vid en ungefärlig: The source describes Uruk at an approximate point in time. The city's foundation and the individual construction years of the buildings are not established here.
Källan beskriver bebyggelsens utformning: The source describes the settlement's layout by around 2500 BC and estimates its population. It gives no individual rebuilding year or foundation year.
Källan beskriver ett dynastiskt ideal oc: The source describes a dynastic ideal and earlier departures from it; it attests no mechanical law for 800, and the game’s gender-neutral succession differs from the ideal.
Källan beskriver hans verksamhet 800 och: The source describes his activity in 800 and 801/802 and his death in 811.
Källan daterar de 85 registrerade gravar: The source dates the 85 recorded graves to 1900–1600 BC. The full interval is retained; it is not a single burial year.
Källan daterar det samlade erövringsförl: The source dates the overall conquest process to 1516–1517. The notice gives no common conquest day for both regions.
Källan daterar expeditionen till 1292. P: The source dates the expedition to 1292. The entry does not independently calculate an end year from the statement about withdrawal within a year.
Källan daterar framställningen till hela: The source dates production to the entire range. The year 932 is the project's beginning, not its completion year.
Källan daterar giftermålet till 1200. He: The source dates the marriage to 1200. Her later queenship, regency and children are not carried back to the bookmark.
Källan daterar grundandet till år 277 en: The source dates the foundation to the year 277 in the Muslim calendar and gives the equivalent as 890–891.
Källan daterar hela upproret till 755–76: The source dates the entire rebellion to 755–763. An Lushan leads its opening phase; the interval does not mean that he lives or leads it throughout those years.
Källan daterar lagen till 1351 men ger i: The source dates the law to 1351 but does not give its formal name in the section consulted. The entry does not claim that the authorities succeeded in lowering all wages.
Källan daterar ristningarna ungefärligt: The source approximately dates the carvings to the late Naqada period, around 3200 BC, and gives no personal identity for the depicted ruler.
Källan daterar styrets början till omkri: The source dates the start of the reign to around 850. It gives no separate exact year for the conquest of Tanjore.
Källan daterar utnämningen till januari: The source dates the appointment to January 1135, Injong's thirteenth regnal year, and distinguishes it from the rebellion's later end. The entry uses only the year the source gives in the AD calendar.
Källan daterar utvecklingen till hela pe: The source dates the development to the entire period. The year 800 marks the start of the range and is not a known year for any individual work.
Källan daterar återkomsten och undervisn: The source dates the return and teaching to 1191. Earlier individuals had already taught Zen in Japan, so the entry indicates no first introduction.
Källan jämför två datum inom samma år. Å: The source compares two dates within the same year. The year 987 is shared; therefore no specific day is given in the date field.
Källan kallar honom dynastins förste emi: The source calls him the dynasty’s first emir and describes the office as Abbasid governor.
Källan motsvarar år 154 med 771. Den 1 j: The source equates the year 154 with 771. The first of January is a game value; the source gives no birthday.
Källan namnger henne som kejsarinna Luo: The source names her as Empress Luo and as Chunyou’s mother.
Källan placerar persernas landstigning i: The source places the Persian landing in early September and describes the ensuing battle. No exact battle day is given here.
Källan placerar slaget i juni. Senare fr: The source places the battle in June. This record does not date the subsequent peace terms.
Källan placerar åtgärderna under Hadrian: The source places the measures during Hadrian’s reign. It gives no single exact year for them all.
Källan redovisar både ett uppror under 6: The source presents both a revolt during 60 and preparations in 60 followed by attacks in 61.

Källan skiljer erövringen i augusti från: The source distinguishes the conquest in August from the formal beginning of dominion on 1 Thoth, which it equates with 29 August. No independently chosen death days for Antony or Cleopatra are added.
Källan skriver att området var taget sen: The source writes that the area had been taken by 1215. The entry dates the attested outcome, not an exact day of assault.
Källan titulerar honom emir av Córdoba;: The source titles him emir of Córdoba; the court seat is a research proposal, and the location on the day is unknown.
Källans 26/25 f.Kr. behålls. Forskarens: The source's 26/25 BC is retained. The scholar's discussion questions the usual account of complete failure; this entry does not settle the issue of lasting Roman dominion.
Källans 387/6 återges som två kalenderår: The source's 387/6 is represented as two calendar years. The section read does not support a full account of the peace terms.
Källans fullständiga datum behålls utan: The source's full date is retained without calendar conversion. The conquest of Egypt in the following year is a separate event.
Källans hela spann 1–100 återges. Uppgif: The source’s full span of 1–100 is given. The account is attributed to Pliny.
Källans livsintervall ger födelseåret 11: The source’s lifespan interval gives the birth year as 1187. The first of January is a game-specific day.
Källans livsintervall ger födelseåret 74: The source’s lifespan interval gives the birth year as 742. The first of January is a game-specific day, since the source lacks a month and day.
Källans livsintervall ger födelseåret 76: The source’s lifespan interval gives the birth year as 761. The first of January is a game-specific day; the source text also equates the second year of the Shangyuan era with 761.
Källans ungefärliga intervall cirka 500–: The source's approximate interval of circa 500–550 is retained in full. It gives no individual year of conquest.
Källans ursprungliga dag är jisi i fjärd: The source's original day is jisi in the fourth month. Pankenier converts it to 12 March 632 BC; the date is reproduced with this attribution and is not an independent calendar calculation.
Källans årsbeteckning bevaras; den anger: The source's year notation is preserved; it does not mean that the Four Hundred rule throughout the entire span.
Källans årsspann gäller silverfyndet och: The source's year span concerns the silver discovery and the decision on naval funding. Ships built in the following years are not counted as completed in the same year.
Källorna anger 869. Händelsen återges på: The sources give 869. The event is presented at year level; no Japanese calendar day has been converted.
Källorna anger hovbasen under perioden m: The sources give the court base during the period but no itinerary for 25 December 800.
Källorna anger ingen vistelseort för den: The sources give no whereabouts for this day.

Källorna belägger huvudstaden. De anger: The sources attest the capital. They give no whereabouts for the king on the bookmark date.

Källorna ger årtal. Inget tillträdes- el: The sources give years. No accession or death date precise to the day is introduced.

Langobarder invaderar den italienska hal: Lombards invade the Italian Peninsula and establish duchies in the north and south. The Byzantines retain several areas.
Lapulapu och hans styrkor slår tillbaka: Lapulapu and his forces repel Magellan's attack at Mactan on 27 April 1521. Magellan is killed in the fighting.

Leider daterar Dhammazedis beskickning t: Leider dates Dhammazedi's mission to Sri Lanka to 1475 and the establishment of the Kalyani ordination ground in Pegu to 1476. Leigudun nära nuvarande Suizhou, Hubei,: Leigudun near present-day Suizhou, Hubei, China
Lejonporten byggs vid Mykene: The Lion Gate is built at Mycenae
Leo angreps i Rom 25 april 799 och sökte: Leo was attacked in Rome on 25 April 799 and sought out Charles in Paderborn. In December 800, accusations against him were heard in Rome before Charles. No accuser substantiated them, and Leo cleared himself by oath two days before the coronation. The conspirators were sentenced only after the coronation. An article from 1912 associates his position with Frankish protection.
Li Chunyou regerar över tanguternas Väst: Li Chunyou has ruled the Tanguts’ Western Xia since 1193. The printing of Buddhist texts continues during his reign. His mother is named Luo.
Li Feng daterar angreppet och kung Yous: Li Feng dates the attack and King You's death to spring 771 BC in the chapter's public summary. This entry assigns no exact year to the subsequent court's move to Luoyi.
Li Yuan grundar Tangdynastin: Li Yuan founds the Tang dynasty
Li Yuan, från en nordlig aristokratsläkt: Li Yuan, from a northern aristocratic family with a long record of government service, seizes the throne, restores order and founds the Tang dynasty, ruling as Emperor Gaozu until 626.
Lian tilldelar Fanshans gravfält hela de: Lian assigns this full range to the Fanshan cemetery. It dates the burial assemblage, not the foundation of Liangzhu or every tomb to the same year. The exact sequence and duration of individual burials remain unspecified.
Library of Congress anger 1454/1455. Int: The Library of Congress gives 1454/1455. The range preserves the source's bibliographical dating.
Limpopo–Shasheområdet, nuvarande Sydafri: The Limpopo–Shashe region, present-day South Africa

Lokala härskare styr självständiga städe: Local rulers govern independent cities after Akkad's fragmentation
Lokala ledare och deras allierade gör mo: Local leaders and their allies resist Alexander's rule in Bactria and Sogdiana.
Lokamahadevi bekostar Virupakshatemplet: Lokamahadevi funds the Virupaksha Temple in Pattadakal
Lorschannalerna berättar att påven Stefa: The Annals of Lorsch recount that Pope Stephen anoints Pippin and his sons Charles and Carloman with holy oil in 754. According to the text, Pippin has first promised to defend the Roman Church against the Lombards.
Louvren anger både omkring 2450 f.Kr. oc: The Louvre gives both around 2450 BC and the range 2450–2425 BC for the stela's production. This dates the memorial and establishes no separate year for the victory described by the inscription.
Louvren daterar ristningen till omkring: The Louvre dates the carving to around 1750 BC. The caption’s 1792–1750 concerns the king’s reign. The placement follows the Babylonian chronology used.
Louvren daterar stelen till Naram-Sins r: The Louvre dates the stele to Naram-Sin's reign, 2254–2218 BC. Georg Neumann uses 2261–2206 BC for the king in his discussion of the same stele. These dates provide alternative chronological frameworks for the object. The sources establish no single year for the carving or the battle, and the combined interval does not indicate a continuous period of work.
Luang Prabang får ställning som Lan Xang: Luang Prabang gains the status of capital of Lan Xang. The place becomes a royal centre on the Mekong.
Luang Prabang är huvudstad i Lan Xang: Luang Prabang is the capital of Lan Xang
Lucius Cornelius Balbus marscherar mot s: Lucius Cornelius Balbus marches against Saharan communities and captures settlements. The source discusses the expedition in connection with Garamantian territory.
Ludvig IX låter bygga Sainte-Chapelle i: Louis IX has Sainte-Chapelle built in Paris to house relics of Christ's Passion. The chapel's decoration links royal power to biblical models.
Ludvig VIII är det historiska kunganamne: Louis VIII is the historical royal name. He does not become king until 1223 according to the source; he is the king’s son at the bookmark.
Ludvig den frommes tre överlevande söner: The three surviving sons of Louis the Pious divide the Carolingian Empire at Verdun in 843. Charles the Bald receives the western part, Lothair the middle part and Louis the German the eastern part.
Ludvig den tyske och Karl den skallige s: Louis the German and Charles the Bald form a military alliance against their brother Lothair. They swear oaths at Strasbourg in Romance and Germanic languages on 14 February 842.
Ludvig och Karl svär eder i Strasbourg: Louis and Charles swear oaths at Strasbourg
Ludvigs söner delar riket i Verdun: Louis's sons divide the empire at Verdun
Lugalzagesi av Umma och Uruk angriper La: Lugalzagesi of Umma and Uruk attacks Lagash and its irrigated hinterland. A contemporary text describes the destruction. The episode forms part of the long struggle for power between Lagash and Umma.
Luther sänder sina teser mot avlaten: Luther sends his theses against indulgences
Luthers artikel om Alp Arslan och Careys: Luther's article on Alp Arslan and Carey's specialist survey give 26 August 1071. Shahbazi's article on Byzantine-Iranian relations gives 463/1071. Yarshater's general survey dates the victory over Romanos to 1069 without explaining the discrepancy. This appears to be an error in the year, but the cause of the error has not been established. Luther distinguishes an earlier Byzantine campaign at Manbij and a truce around 1069–1070 from the Battle of Manzikert. The source authors are responsible for the calendar datings.
Luthers tyska Nya testamente trycks: Luther's German New Testament is printed
Luthers översättning av Nya testamentet: Luther's translation of the New Testament is printed after revision together with Philipp Melanchthon. The September edition does not give the translator's name.
Lyngstrøms offentliga sammanfattning ang: Lyngstrøm's public abstract states approximately when local iron technology was introduced. The full conference paper has not been read.
Lý Anh Tông inrättar Vân Đồns handelsham: Lý Anh Tông establishes the trading port of Vân Đồn
Lý Bí antar kejsartiteln Lý Nam Đế, ger: Lý Bí assumes the imperial title Lý Nam Đế, names his realm Vạn Xuân and makes Long Biên its capital.
Lý Bí antar kejsartiteln och grundar Vạn: Lý Bí assumes the imperial title and founds Vạn Xuân
Lý Thái Tổ beslutar att flytta sitt hov: Lý Thái Tổ decides to move his court from Hoa Lư to Thăng Long. In his edict he emphasises the location, the flat ground and protection against floods as reasons for the move.
Lý Thái Tổ flyttar huvudstaden till Thăn: Lý Thái Tổ moves the capital to Thăng Long
Lýhovet grundar en högskola för riket: The Lý court founds a college for the kingdom

Lýhovet håller nationella examina år 107: The Lý court holds national examinations in 1075. The rulers revive Confucian studies and thereby organise a new stage in education for the kingdom's administration.
Lýhovet håller nationella ämbetsexamina: The Lý court holds national civil service examinations
Lýhovet låter bygga Litteraturtemplet: The Lý court has the Temple of Literature built
Lýhovet låter uppföra Litteraturtemplet: The Lý court has the Temple of Literature built in Thăng Long in honour of Confucius. The rulers thereby promote Confucian studies alongside the Buddhist learning that they also support.
MFA daterar bortförandet till 1159. Metr: The MFA dates the abduction to 1159. The Metropolitan Museum dates the subsequent Heiji battle to 1160. The range includes separate events during the conflict.
MIT anger byggnadsdateringen som 1472/87: MIT gives the construction dating as 1472/AH 877; no independent calendar conversion has been made.
Ma Yuan återtar kontrollen i norra Vietn: Ma Yuan regains control in northern Vietnam
Mackabéerna renar och återinviger Jerusa: The Maccabees purify and rededicate the Jerusalem temple. The event is associated with Hanukkah.

Mahayanabuddhismen vid hovet i Angkor: Mahayana Buddhism at the Angkor court

Mahmud Gawans madrasa i Bidar dateras ti: Mahmud Gawan's madrasa in Bidar is dated to 1472. It contains a library and teaching rooms, among other facilities.
Malacka blir ett viktigt handelscentrum: Malacca becomes an important trading centre in 1404–1406. The city lies on the Malay Peninsula.
Malacka växer som handelscentrum: Malacca grows as a trading centre
Malias första palats och kvarter Mu förs: Malia’s first palace and Mu Quarter are destroyed
Malikshah intar Samarkand år 1089 med st: Malikshah captures Samarkand in 1089 with support from some of the city's Muslim scholars. He imprisons the Karakhanid ruler Ahmad Khan ibn Khizr.
Malis härskare Mansa Musa anländer till: Mali's ruler Mansa Musa arrives in Cairo with large quantities of gold. The price of gold falls there as the metal reaches the market.
Mamlukerna besegrar en mongolisk styrka: The Mamluks defeat a Mongol force at Ayn Jalut. They subsequently take over the last Ayyubid strongholds in the eastern Mediterranean region.
Mamlukerna besegrar mongolerna vid Ayn J: The Mamluks defeat the Mongols at Ayn Jalut
Mamlukerna besegrar mongolerna vid Marj: The Mamluks defeat the Mongols at Marj al-Soffar
Mamlukerna intar korsfararstaden Acre. S: The Mamluks capture the crusader city of Acre. Sultan al-Ashraf orders the city's destruction.
Mamlukerna störtar den ayyubidiske sulta: The Mamluks overthrow the Ayyubid sultan Turan Shah and establish their own rule in Egypt. They had previously formed a central part of the Ayyubids' military organisation.
Mamlukerna tar makten i Egypten: The Mamluks take power in Egypt
Mamlukernas styrkor besegrar en ilkhansk: Mamluk forces defeat an Ilkhanid invasion army south of Damascus. Ghazan himself stays near the Euphrates while his army advances into central Syria.
Manchay Bajo skyddar sitt tempel mot öve: Manchay Bajo walls its temple against floods
Manchester Museum anger 664 f.Kr. för pl: Manchester Museum gives 664 BC for the sack; Larousse gives 663 BC. The helmet in Manchester was linked to the conflict through Petrie's suggestion and is not used as certain material evidence for the battle.
Mansa Musa besöker Kairo med stora mängd: Mansa Musa visits Cairo with large quantities of gold

The copying date does not establish when the teachings were first composed, and the precise provenance is uncertain.
Marajel, en förslavad bihustru till Haru: Marajel, an enslaved concubine of Harun
Marathonslätten i Attika, Grekland: The plain of Marathon in Attica, Greece

Mareda, en förslavad kvinna av sogdiskt: Mareda, an enslaved woman of Sogdian origin
Mari vid Eufrat, nuvarande Syrien: Mari on the Euphrates, present-day Syria

Marj al-Soffar, söder om Damaskus, Syrie: Marj al-Soffar, south of Damascus, Syria
Markis Yi begravs med en stor samling mu: Marquis Yi is buried with a large musical assemblage
Martin Luther skickar sina teser mot avl: Martin Luther sends his theses against indulgences to Archbishop Albrecht of Mainz. The letter is dated 31 October 1517.
Matematikern Bhāskara II skriver Līlāvat: The mathematician Bhāskara II writes the Līlāvatī in Sanskrit. He uses problems and questions in verse to teach arithmetic.
Mauryahärskaren Ashoka angriper och eröv: The Mauryan ruler Ashoka attacks and conquers Kalinga. The war becomes an important event in his reign.
Max Planck-institutet anger grundandet t: The Max Planck Institute dates the foundation to 1259. The year is not used as an exact date for when all buildings or observations were completed.
Mayapán fungerar som politisk huvudstad: Mayapán serves as political capital for a league of provinces in northwestern Yucatán. The city has a defensive wall, temples and palaces.
Mayapán leder ett förbund av provinser: Mayapán leads a league of provinces
Mañjuśrīgrha-inskriften dateras till 792: The Mañjuśrīgrha inscription dates to 792 and describes a religious vision. The researchers connect it to the Sewu temple and interpret it as evidence of rebuilding or restoration and the worship of Mañjuśrī.
Med Augustus stöd tar Juba II över styre: With Augustus's support, Juba II takes rule over the Mauretanian kingdom previously held by Bocchus.
Med kejserligt godkännande fastställer l: With imperial approval, scholars establish standard versions of Confucian texts for engraving on stone. The tablets are set up at Luoyang's Imperial Academy, forming a state-sponsored stone edition of the classics.
Medelhavet och Coracesium i Kilikien: The Mediterranean and Coracesium in Cilicia
Megaliten kommer från Wanar i nuvarande: The megalith comes from Wanar in present-day Senegal; the place of manufacture is unspecified.
Mehmed II besegrar Aq Qoyunlus härskare: Mehmed II defeats the Aq Qoyunlu ruler Uzun Hasan at Otlukbeli in August 1473. The Ottomans use artillery and muskets in the battle.
Mehmed II besegrar Uzun Hasan vid Otlukb: Mehmed II defeats Uzun Hasan at Otlukbeli
Meisami anger ramadan 447 och motsvarigh: Meisami gives Ramadan 447 and the equivalent December 1055. The source gives no exact day in the section consulted.
Meisami anger år 431 enligt den muslimsk: Meisami gives the year 431 in the Muslim calendar and the equivalent 1040. No exact day of battle is given here.
Mellersta Eufrat, däribland Habuba Kabir: Middle Euphrates, including Habuba Kabira, Sheikh Hassan and Jebel Aruda, present-day Syria
Mentuhotep II återförenar Övre och Nedre: Mentuhotep II reunifies Upper and Lower Egypt. The rulers of Thebes defeat their rivals in Herakleopolis after a period of competing kingdoms.
Merey, härskare över Rebu eller Lebu, an: Merey, ruler of the Rebu or Lebu, attacks Egypt with archers and warriors whom the Egyptian inscriptions associate with northern regions. The foreign groups' identities and political affiliations are uncertain.
Meroe blir centrum för kungliga begravni: Meroe becomes a centre for royal burials

Met daterar branden till omkring 650 och: The Met dates the burning to about 650 and calls the cause a possible internal crisis.
Met daterar invasionen till 429 och ange: The Met dates the invasion to 429 and gives no year for the capture of Carthage.
Met daterar koloniseringen till omkring: The Met dates the colonisation to about 600 BC and gives no founding year for any single city.
Met daterar posten till 879 f.Kr. utan a: The Met dates the entry to 879 BC without saying whether the year marks the move or the palace's completion.
Met och INAH placerar den 31 december 15: The Met and INAH place 31 December 1500 within the reign of 1486–1502.
Met placerar fälttåget och grundandet av: The Met places the campaign and the founding of Kairouan under 670 without separating their years.
Met placerar förlusten vid Nya rikets bö: The Met places the loss at the beginning of the New Kingdom and Egyptian control to the fourth cataract by about 1450 BC.
Met placerar innovationen tidigt i århun: The Met places the innovation early in the century; Corning places it near the middle. The numerical bounds cover their shared century, not a century-long invention process or evidence for the endpoint years.
Metallarbetare når en produktionstopp vi: Metalworkers reach a production peak at Timna's Site 34
Metallarbetare på Perus nordkust framstä: Metalworkers on Peru's north coast produce large quantities of arsenical bronze in small pear-shaped smelting furnaces around 900. They use the hard alloy of copper and arsenic for knives, chisels and needles.
Metallarbetare smälter koppar i ett stor: Metalworkers smelt copper at a large camp in Timna. Ben-Yosef interprets the installations and defensive remains as evidence that an organized society directed production.
Metmuseet daterar alliansen till cirka 1: The Met dates the alliance to circa 1427. The year is retained as an estimate.

Metmuseets kronologiska rubrik anger cir: The Met's chronological heading gives circa 1487. The conversion to the year follows the source.

Metropolitan Museum anger 330 för den ny: The Metropolitan Museum gives 330 for the new capital. Robert K. Ritner gives 331 for the formal transfer; both dates are retained.
Metropolitan Museum anger början som 146: The Metropolitan Museum gives the beginning as 1467 in the survey but 1466 in the event list.
Metropolitan Museum beskriver ett fästni: The Metropolitan Museum describes fort construction begun by Senusret I and continued by Amenemhat II. They establish neither individual years for the fortresses nor uninterrupted work throughout the interval.
Metropolitan Museum daterar byggandet av: The Metropolitan Museum dates construction of the funerary complex to around 2050–2000 BC. The museum's narrower date for Henhenet's shrine fragment, circa 2051–2030 BC, concerns a different dating subject.
Metropolitan Museum daterar statyn till: The Metropolitan Museum dates the statue to this range in its chronology for Sahure's reign. The museum gives two possible original locations, Abusir or Coptos, and establishes neither.

Metropolitan Museum knyter fälttåget til: The Metropolitan Museum associates the campaign with Amenemhat II, whose reign it dates to c. 1919–1885 BC. UCL gives 1914–1879/1876 BC. These alternative reign frameworks provide no exact year for the campaign.
Metropolitan Museum och UCL anger olika: The Metropolitan Museum and UCL give different reign intervals for Mentuhotep IV. UCL associates the expedition with the king without giving an absolute year. Metropolitan Museum placerar flytten tid: The Metropolitan Museum places the move early in Amenemhat I’s reign, which it dates to c. 1981–1952 BC. UCL gives 1976–1947 BC. Both frameworks are retained; no individual year for the move is established.
Metropolitan Museum skiljer denna kontro: The Metropolitan Museum distinguishes this control over the south from the Assyrians' withdrawal after their invasion in 664 BC. No independent conversion of regnal years has been made.

Mets historiska översikt daterar mordet: The Met’s historical overview dates the assassination to AD 235.
Mets post omfattar 634–644, 'Umars reger: The Met's entry spans 634–644, the reign of 'Umar, and dates the battle itself to 642.
Mets tidslinje ger detta intervall för r: The Met’s timeline gives this interval for the raids.
Mets tidslinje placerar byggandet vid år: The Met’s timeline places construction in the year 280; no exact day is given.
Mets tidslinje skiljer år 267 från räder: The Met’s timeline distinguishes the year 267 from the raids of 257–263.
Mets översikt daterar början av Diocleti: The Met’s overview dates the beginning of Diocletian’s reign to 284.

Mexica markerar en tempelutbyggnad: The Mexica mark a temple expansion

Mexikodalen, nuvarande Mexico City, Mexi: Valley of Mexico, present-day Mexico City, Mexico
Mieszko I lämnar den slaviska gudatron o: Mieszko I abandons belief in the Slavic gods and receives Christian baptism. The principal sources date the baptism to 966, while Thietmar of Merseburg leaves the choice between 966 and 968 open.
Mikael VIII Palaiologos tågar in i Konst: Michael VIII Palaiologos enters Constantinople after the city has returned to Byzantine rule. The imperial capital is restored after Latin rule.

Mingdynastin tar makten i Kina: The Ming dynasty takes power in China
Mingriket och Indiska oceanens sjövägar: The Ming Empire and the Indian Ocean sea routes

Mingstyret börjar ge ut papperspengar: The Ming government begins issuing paper money
Missionären Longinus återvänder till Nob: The missionary Longinus returns to Nobatia. Shortly afterwards, he continues towards Alwa, whose king has invited him.
Miwnay ber sin mor om hjälp i ett brev: Miwnay asks her mother for help in a letter
Miwnay skriver till sin mor Chatis om si: Miwnay writes to her mother Chatis about her predicament in Dunhuang. She asks for help to return to her mother.
Mleiha, nuvarande Förenade arabemiraten: Mleiha, in the present-day United Arab Emirates
Modellförslag: tidig polynesisk bosättni: Model proposal: early Polynesian settlement on the North Island
Modern forskning ger olika födelseuppska: Modern research gives different birth estimates. Castañeda also recounts differing colonial statements about the mother’s father, Epcoatzin and Moquíhuix respectively. No maternal grandfather or court service is assigned to Cuauhtémoc here.
Mohenjo Daro och Harappa blomstrar i en: Mohenjo Daro and Harappa flourish in a planned urban culture
Mongolerna angriper Qara Khitai: The Mongols attack the Qara Khitai
Mongolerna går in i Qara Khitais områden: The Mongols enter Qara Khitai territories in Central Asia. The attack follows defeated opponents of Genghis Khan seeking refuge with their neighbours.
Mongolerna intar nizari-ismailitiska fäs: The Mongols capture Nizari Ismaili strongholds
Mongolerna intar området kring Zhongdu: The Mongols capture the area around Zhongdu
Mongolerna krossar Jindynastins välde: The Mongols crush the Jin dynasty's realm
Mongolerna slår sönder Jindynastins stat: The Mongols destroy the Jin dynasty's state in northern China. The conquest is a new step in their southward expansion.
Mongolernas framväxande kansli antar uig: The emerging Mongol chancery adopts the Uyghur script. The script becomes a tool of the empire's administration.
Mongoliska arméer erövrar Dali, som vari: Mongol armies conquer Dali, which had been the capital of an independent kingdom. The city is subsequently incorporated into the political order of the Mongol Yuan Empire.
Mongoliska styrkor angriper Goryeo och n: Mongol forces attack Goryeo and reach the capital, Gaegyeong. The court subsequently seeks a settlement with the attackers.
Mongolkansliet antar uigurisk skrift: The Mongol chancery adopts the Uyghur script
Monte Albán dominerar Oaxacadalen: Monte Albán dominates the Oaxaca Valley
Monte Albán växer fram som nytt centrum: Monte Albán emerges as a new centre
Monte Albán, Oaxacadalen i nuvarande Mex: Monte Albán, Oaxaca Valley in present-day Mexico
Montezuma II kröns i Tenochtitlan: Montezuma II is crowned in Tenochtitlan
Monumentala gravar byggs i Kerma: Monumental tombs are built at Kerma
Monumentmyndighetens datering bygger på: The monument authority's dating rests on palaeographic and historical comparisons.
Mossel Bay och södra Afrikas kust: Mossel Bay and the coast of southern Africa
Motstånd möter Alexander i Baktrien och: Alexander faces resistance in Bactria and Sogdiana
Muhammad Ghuri besegrar Prithviraj Chauh: Muhammad Ghuri defeats Prithviraj Chauhan in the Second Battle of Tarain in 1192. After the battle, the Ghurids retain local rulers as vassals in several places while taking others under direct control.
Muhammad al-Nasir bär den almohadiska ka: Muhammad al-Nasir bears the Almohad caliphal title. The Almohads associate their power with religious reform; their coins mention the Mahdi and the caliphs.
Muhammad al-Nasir har efterträtt sin far: Muhammad al-Nasir has succeeded his father Abu Yusuf Yaqub al-Mansur as Almohad caliph. The Almohads rule in the Maghreb and Muslim Spain. They have courts in Marrakech and Seville, where they support Islamic learning. Religious reform is part of the dynasty’s foundation.
Muhammad ibn Qasim besegrar Dahir i Sind: Muhammad ibn Qasim defeats Dahir in Sind
Muhammad ibn Qasim besegrar Raja Dahir i: Muhammad ibn Qasim defeats Raja Dahir in Sind. Dahir dies in the battle, and Ibn Qasim continues to expand Umayyad rule in the region.
Muhammad ibn Tughlaq flyttar huvudstaden: Muhammad ibn Tughlaq moves the capital to Deogiri
Muhammad ibn Tughlaq flyttar tillfälligt: Muhammad ibn Tughlaq temporarily moves his capital from Delhi to Deogiri in the Deccan. The place receives the name Daulatabad, but the court later returns to Delhi.
Muhammad ibn Yaqub är den almohadiske ka: Muhammad ibn Yaqub is the Almohad caliph. Iranica mentions another contemporary caliph named al-Nasir in Abbasid Baghdad.
Muizzuddins styrkor besegrar Jai Chands: Muizzuddin's forces defeat Jai Chand's Gahadavala army at Chandawar. The victors subsequently plunder Asni and Benares during their advance in the Ganges region.
Mummius besegrar det achaiska förbundet: Mummius defeats the Achaean League and destroys Corinth on the Senate's orders.
Munken Eisai återvänder från Kina till J: The monk Eisai returns from China to Japan and teaches Zen Buddhism. His emphasis on meditation and restraint appeals to warriors and contributes to Zen's growing influence.
Munken Fotudeng kommer till Centralslätt: The monk Fotudeng arrives in China’s Central Plains. He preaches Buddhism there and seeks converts.
Munken Hōnen börjar förkunna en väg till: The monk Hōnen begins preaching a path to the Pure Land through invoking Amida's name. After reading Shandao's commentary, he emphasises this practice as accessible to people from different social strata.
Munken Kūkai reser till Tangriket för at: The monk Kūkai travels to the Tang Empire to study esoteric Buddhism. After his studies, he brings the teachings to Japan.
Murar och utskjutande torn skyddar en sm: Walls and projecting towers guard a narrow entrance to La Bastida, a major political and economic centre of Argaric society in southeastern Spain. Their design may reflect changes in warfare and weapons; it does not identify a particular attack.
Murasaki Shikibu beskriver i sin dagbok: Murasaki Shikibu describes in her diary how courtiers know characters from her Tale of Genji. She is still working on the tale and arranges the copying and binding of a copy for Empress Shōshi.
Museet anger 1204. Posten anger inget ex: The museum gives 1204. The entry gives no exact date and does not claim that all Byzantine successor states cease to exist.

The museum gives 969–73 for the foundation. The event concerns the mosque; the text does not date a later university to the same year.
Museet anger Erishum I:s regeringstid ti: The museum gives Erishum I’s reign as c. 1974–1935 BC. Türkiye’s UNESCO submission attributes trade reforms to him but gives no reform year. The interval dates the reign, not a continuous period of reform.
Museet anger att erövringen var fullbord: The museum states that the conquest had been completed by 1279. No exact day is given.
Museet anger att komplexet påbörjades 13: The museum states that the complex was begun in 1356. The entry gives no exact dedication date or claim of completion that year.
Museet anger cirka 1230–1235. Spannet är: The museum gives circa 1230–1235. The range is an approximate dating of the victory, not an attested five-year battle or an exact foundation year.
Museet anger cirka 386. Årtalet gäller e: The museum gives around 386. The year concerns the establishment of Northern Wei and does not date the conquest of all northern China.
Museet anger en ungefärlig byggstart. Da: The museum gives an approximate start of construction. The dating establishes no exact foundation year for the Chimú kingdom.

Museet anger endast en bred sekeldaterin: The museum gives only a broad century-level date. The numerical interval serves as the project's index and does not establish a first or last year of manufacture, a specific place of manufacture, or when people erected the stone.
Museet anger ett tillverkningsintervall: The museum gives a production range for the individual object. The full range remains; it indicates no new cultural period or specific production year.
Museet anger ett ungefärligt tillverknin: The museum gives an approximate production range for object 49.23.3. No individual production year or specific findspot within Mesopotamia is stated.

Museet anger omkring 1280. Året är ungef: The museum gives around 1280. The year is approximate and dates neither every local conquest nor all earlier K’iche’ settlements.

Museet anger omkring 800 för offerdeposi: The museum gives around 800 for the offering deposit. No exact calendar year is specified.

Museet beskriver denna ställning omkring: The museum describes this position around 1250. The entry concerns a dated political situation and indicates neither an exact accession nor Mayapán's foundation.

Muslimska stormän gör uppror mot Delhis: Muslim magnates rebel against Delhi's sultan Muhammad ibn Tughluq. The Bahmanid dynasty in the Deccan emerges from the rebellion.

Mykenes befästningar får en monumental i: Mycenae's fortifications gain a monumental entrance with a relief of two lions. The Lion Gate belongs to the expansion of the citadel's defences during the Mycenaean palatial period.
Mykenes ledande familjer gravlägger sina: Mycenae’s leading families bury their dead in Grave Circle B
Män under Fujiwara no Nobuyori och Minam: Men under Fujiwara no Nobuyori and Minamoto no Yoshitomo attack the Sanjō Palace and abduct the retired emperor Go-Shirakawa. In the Heiji conflict, Taira warriors defeat their Minamoto rivals and strengthen their position at court.

People use pottery at Thạch Lạc in present-day north-central Vietnam. Archaeologists date the beginning of the settlement sequence examined to circa 3100 BC. They have distinguished three phases with different pottery traditions and short breaks in settlement, and the dating gives no certain foundation year.
Människor använder vete och korn i Pikli: People use wheat and barley at Piklihal
Människor bor vid sjön Koorküla Valgjärv: People live by Lake Koorküla Valgjärv in present-day Estonia. Archaeologists assign this settlement phase to late Comb Ware and date it to around 3300–3200 BC.
Människor bosätter sig vid Bang Pakongs: People settle at the mouth of the Bang Pakong. During the settlement period, they trade in materials including stone and shells and supply other communities with shell beads.
Människor bosätter sig vid Khok Phanom D: People settle at Khok Phanom Di
Människor bosätter sig vid Upanca i södr: People settle at Upanca in Peru's southern Nasca region. The researchers' summary places the beginning approximately between 3200 and 3000 BC, while the individual archaeological dates have broader uncertainty.
Människor bygger gånggraven Newgrange: People build the passage tomb of Newgrange
Människor förstör Taosis murar och elitg: People destroy Taosi’s walls and elite graves
Människor grundar den bosättning som i d: People found the settlement now called Shahr-i Sokhta in eastern Iran. Archaeologists date the foundation to around this time.
Människor i Ban Non Wat begraver vuxna o: People at Ban Non Wat bury adults and children with copper-based socketed axes, vessels and shell ornaments. The deeper graves with more offerings differ from the preceding phase. Higham interprets the early metal objects as goods that probably reached the site through exchange.
Människor i Ban Non Wat håller sannolikt: People at Ban Non Wat probably keep early domestic chickens
Människor i Chap förenar odling och bosk: People at Chap combine cultivation and herding in the mountains
Människor i England insjuknar i digerdöd: People in England fall ill with the Black Death
Människor i England insjuknar och dör un: People in England fall ill and die during the plague epidemic. Afterwards, many surviving workers can demand higher wages as labour becomes scarce.
Människor i Essex och Kent gör uppror mo: People in Essex and Kent rebel against the poll tax and march on London. There they attack officials and buildings before Richard II meets them and Wat Tyler is killed.
Människor i Oaxacadalen flyttar till en: People in the Oaxaca Valley move to a new hilltop settlement. Monte Albán gains a central plaza and fortifications and becomes an important regional centre.
Människor i Paso de la Amada tillreder k: People at Paso de la Amada prepare a cacao drink
Människor i Quiriguá tillfångatar och ha: People in Quiriguá capture and behead Copán's ruler Waxaklajun Ub’ah K’awil on 3 May 738. Copán loses a king whose building projects had shaped the city.
Människor i Tchadsjöns sydvästra bäcken: People in the southwestern Lake Chad basin build up larger settlement mounds. Archaeologists interpret the change as herding groups remaining longer in the same places.
Människor i norra Europa svälter under e: People in northern Europe starve during a prolonged subsistence crisis. They face persistent rain, flooding and cold. Economic and agricultural changes probably also contribute to the crisis.
Människor i området mellan Egypten och M: People in the region between Egypt and Mesopotamia begin using scales and weights to compare the weight of goods. Researchers place the emergence of the technology around 3100–3000 BC. They date the oldest known Egyptian weight to circa 3100 BC and early weights from the Diyala region to circa 3000 BC, so they cannot give a certain invention year.
Människor lägger ned graverade stenar vi: People deposit engraved stones at Vasagård
Människor lägger pärlor i en barngrav i: People place beads in a child's grave at Kara-depe
Människor lämnar skalrika lager vid Ru D: People leave shell-rich layers at Ru Diep
Människor på ön Sai använder grupper av: People on Sai Island use groups of circular storage pits and seal them with slate slabs and clay. Archaeologists also find large storage vessels in some of the pits and date the site to around 2700 BC.
Människor river Taosis stadsmurar och pl: People tear down Taosi’s city walls and loot or damage many elite graves. He Nu interprets the destruction as possible political retaliation during the city’s late phase.
Människor som källorna kallar zanj gör u: People whom the sources call Zanj rebel in southern Iraq in 869. The participants probably include both local people and enslaved Africans, but researchers debate their origins and composition. The Abbasids regain control of the area in 883.
Människor uppför Newgrange vid floden Bo: People erect Newgrange by the River Boyne in Ireland. The passage tomb is one of the large ceremonial complexes in Brú na Bóinne.
Människor ur Mykenes översta samhällsski: Members of Mycenae’s highest social stratum are buried with weapons, vessels and jewellery made from valuable materials. The graves reveal a growing elite able to accumulate great wealth. The identities of the dead are not securely known.
Människor utvecklar Shimao till ett poli: People develop Shimao into a political centre
Människor utvecklar Shimao till ett regi: People develop Shimao into a regional political centre on the northern Loess Plateau. Archaeologist Zhouyong Sun places this emergence around 2300 BC.
Människor vid Dali i Dzjungarbergen håll: People at Dali in the Dzungarian Mountains keep domestic sheep and goats. Researchers interpret the animals' isotope values as signs that livestock are fed millet during winter around 2700 BC.
Människor vid Narensu tycks äta mer hirs: People at Narensu appear to eat more millet around 2900 BC. Researchers make this interpretation from higher carbon isotope values in the bones of buried individuals and link the millet to an older use of milk from ruminants.
Människor vid Vasagård på Bornholm lägge: People at Vasagård on Bornholm deposit engraved stone slabs in ditches and postholes over a short period. Many of the slabs have radiating motifs that researchers interpret as images of the sun. Archaeologists place the deposition around 2900 BC.
Människorna i Ceibal i nuvarande Guatema: People at Ceibal in present-day Guatemala create a public plaza around 950 BC. The researchers suggest that settled inhabitants and more mobile groups cooperate in construction and ceremonies.
Människorna vid Teouma begraver sina död: People at Teouma bury their dead in several stages
Mänskliga kvarlevor med våldsskador och: Human remains with injuries caused by violence and finds of weapons show that a major battle takes place in the Tollense Valley. The material provides unusually clear evidence of organised violence in northern Europe's Bronze Age.
Månaden återges från Salaminas historisk: The month follows Salamina's historical account; no specific day is selected.
Månpyramiden förstoras. Marknadsanläggni: The Moon Pyramid is enlarged. The Great Compound market complex and the Ciudadela religious and administrative precinct shift the centre southwards.
Mạc Đăng Dung bestiger kejsartronen 1527: Mạc Đăng Dung ascends the imperial throne in 1527. He assumes the reign name Minh Đức and begins the Mạc dynasty.
NASA anger 985. Historikern Nedkvitne re: NASA gives 985. The historian Nedkvitne reports medieval datings to both 985 and 986 and finds no reason to favour either year. He judges a solitary reference to 984 to be a probable copying error. The dating establishes no construction year for each farm.

Nabatéerriket införlivas i Romarriket: The Nabataean kingdom is incorporated into the Roman Empire

Nag el-Hamdulab, Nilens västra strand no: Nag el-Hamdulab, the west bank of the Nile north of Aswan, Egypt
Nanai-vandak skickar nyheter till Varzak: Nanai-vandak sends news to Varzakk in Samarkand
Nanai-vandak skriver till Varzakk i Sama: Nanai-vandak writes to Varzakk in Samarkand about trade and unrest in China. The letter survived near Dunhuang, but its survival does not show that it reached its recipient.
Nanak föds i Talwandi 1469. Han blir sen: Nanak is born in Talwandi in 1469. He later becomes the central founding figure of Sikhism.
Nanjing och området söder om Yangtze, Ki: Nanjing and the area south of the Yangtze, China
Nankaiområdet och Awa, Japan: The Nankai region and Awa, Japan
Nanyue, södra Kina och angränsande områd: Nanyue, southern China and adjoining areas
Narensus invånare tycks äta mer hirs: Narensu's inhabitants appear to eat more millet
Narhan vid Sarayu, norra Indien: Narhan on the Sarayu, northern India
Nasca och Pampas de Jumana, Peru: Nasca and Pampas de Jumana, Peru

National Park Service anger en uppskatta: The National Park Service gives an estimated start of construction around 990 based on groups of tree-ring dates. The major later expansions belong to the eleventh century.
National Park Service föredrar 1085 fram: The National Park Service favours 1085 over the older dating of 1064. Chemical traces in tree rings from 1085–1090 support the later dating; around 1085 is used here.
Naṣīr al-Dīn Ṭūsī grundar ett observator: Naṣīr al-Dīn Ṭūsī founds an observatory project at Maragha with Hülegü's support. The scholars are to produce updated astronomical tables for the court's needs.
Nedre och Övre Nubien, nuvarande Egypten: Lower and Upper Nubia, present-day Egypt and Sudan
Neelis daterar inskriften till 150, mots: Neelis dates the inscription to 150, corresponding to Shaka year 72. The year is not given as an independent date for every repair.
Neelis hänför uppgiften till puraniska t: Neelis attributes the account to Puranic traditions and gives an approximate date. Buddhist traditions differ.
