Nero tar sitt liv under uppror och inbör: Nero takes his own life amid rebellion and civil war. The Julio-Claudian dynasty ends.
Neros död avslutar en kejsardynasti: Nero’s death ends an imperial dynasty
Ness of Brodgar, Orkneyöarna, Skottland: Ness of Brodgar, Orkney Islands, Scotland
Ngo Quyen segrar vid Bach Dang: Ngo Quyen wins at Bach Dang
Ngo Quyen vinner slaget vid floden Bach: Ngo Quyen wins the battle on the Bach Dang River in 938. With the victory he ends the period of Chinese dynastic rule and begins a period of independence in the region.
Nidaros, Norge, och de västliga öarna: Nidaros, Norway, and the western islands
Nineve vid Tigris, nuvarande Mosul i Ira: Nineveh on the Tigris, present-day Mosul in Iraq
Nineve, en av Assyriens viktigaste kungl: Nineveh, one of Assyria's most important royal cities, is destroyed. Its role as the residence of the Assyrian kings who succeeded Sennacherib comes to an end.
Nippur tycks övergå från Lipit-Eshtars s: Nippur appears to pass from Lipit-Eshtar’s rule to Gungunum of Larsa, according to Reculeau. The author describes these changes of power as shifts in allegiance without clear signs of conquest by force.
Nokfolk framställer järn i ugnar med luf: Nok people produce iron in furnaces with air nozzles
Nokfolk i nuvarande Nigeria framställer: Nok people in present-day Nigeria produce iron in furnaces supplied with air through nozzles. Breunig describes furnaces used once and then destroyed, interpreting this as evidence of mobile specialists. Few iron objects survive.
Nokkulturens område i centrala Nigeria: The Nok culture area in central Nigeria
Nomineringen anger sjunde månmånaden 137: The nomination gives the seventh lunar month of 1377 and also writes July 1377. The entry uses only the year and does not claim that metal-type printing was invented then.
Nomineringens monumenttabell anger 1117: The nomination's monument table gives 1117 as the year of establishment and construction. The year refers to this temple, not the completion of all later additions to the complex.
Nordbor hugger trä vid L'Anse aux Meadow: Norse people cut wood at L'Anse aux Meadows
Norse people cut wood at L'Anse aux Meadows on Newfoundland in 1021. They work wood from at least three different trees with metal tools at their camp.
Nordeuropas invånare svälter under den s: Northern Europe's inhabitants starve during the Great Famine
Nordiska bosättare kommer till Grönland: Norse settlers arrive in Greenland in 985 or 986. They settle mainly along fjords near the island's southern tip. Erik the Red founds the settlement of Brattahlid.
Nordvästra Sydasien: nuvarande Pakistan: Northwest South Asia: present-day Pakistan and northern India
Nordöstra Japan, området kring Taga och: Northeastern Japan, the area around Taga and the coast of Miyagi and northern Fukushima
Norra Babylonien och nedre Diyala, Mesop: Northern Babylonia and the lower Diyala, Mesopotamia
Norra Indien, med Mewar i nuvarande Raja: Northern India, with Mewar in present-day Rajasthan
Norra Vietnam och sjövägen mot Kina: Northern Vietnam and the sea route towards China
Norra Wei flyttar sin huvudstad till Luo: The Northern Wei move their capital to Luoyang
Norra halvklotet, med belägg från Skandi: Northern Hemisphere, with evidence from Scandinavia
Norska bosättare kommer till Island omkr: Norwegian settlers arrive in Iceland around 874 according to the written tradition in later sagas. Researchers have dated cereal grains from an early settlement in Reykjavík to around 890 and shown that wood samples from the site can yield earlier dates.
Numantia faller för romerska styrkor und: Numantia falls to Roman forces under Scipio Aemilianus.
Nur al-Din Mahmud ibn Zangi låter bygga: Nur al-Din Mahmud ibn Zangi has a hospital built in Damascus. The institution treats patients and trains physicians, with a hall for medical lectures and access to medical books.
Nur al-Din bygger ett sjukhus i Damaskus: Nur al-Din builds a hospital in Damascus
Nya Karthago, nuvarande Cartagena i Span: New Carthage, present-day Cartagena in Spain
Nya kärlformer och dekor med snörintryck: New vessel shapes and cord-impressed decoration appear at Vinelz–Strandboden. In the Three Lakes region, these elements combine with local pottery traditions to produce the Auvernier-Cordé style.
Nybyggare anlägger en större bosättning: Settlers establish a major settlement on Failaka
Settlers establish a major settlement on Failaka and take part in trade through the Persian Gulf. Crawford considers it likely that they come from Bahrain.
Oba Ewuare bestiger Benins tron omkring: Oba Ewuare ascends Benin's throne around 1440. The museum attributes improvements to Benin City and changes in the organisation of palace chiefs to him.
Octavianus förföljer Antonius och Kleopa: Octavian pursues Antony and Cleopatra to Egypt, where both die in Alexandria. Egypt becomes a Roman province.
Octavianus och Agrippas flotta besegrar: Octavian's and Agrippa's fleet defeats Antony's and Cleopatra's forces at Actium. Antony and Cleopatra leave the battle area while the remaining forces lose.
Octavianus tilldelas hedersnamnet August: Octavian is awarded the honorific Augustus. The name becomes associated with the new order after the Roman Republic's struggles for power.
Odlare inför våtris vid Genkaibukten: Farmers introduce wet-rice cultivation at Genkai Bay
Offerkrav under Decius dokumenteras i Eg: Sacrifice requirements under Decius are documented in Egypt
Oghuzer tar sultan Sanjar till fånga: The Oghuz take Sultan Sanjar prisoner
Oghuziska turkmener tar sultan Sanjar ti: Oghuz Turkmens take Sultan Sanjar prisoner in 1153. They subsequently plunder Khorasan and help bring down the Great Seljuk sultanate.
Området för dagens Syrien och Egypten: The area of present-day Syria and Egypt
Oppenheim kopplar återföreningen till Me: Oppenheim links the reunification to the beginning of the Middle Kingdom around 2030 BC. UCL links it to the beginning of the period around 2025 BC. The years are period boundaries in different chronologies and give no five-year campaign.
Orchondalen, nära Çaydam, nuvarande Mong: Orkhon Valley, near Çaydam, present-day Mongolia
Orestien framförs för första gången: The Oresteia is performed for the first time
Orontesdalen, nuvarande södra Turkiet: The Orontes Valley, in present-day southern Turkey
Ortsmarkör från Getty; ingen palatskoord: Place marker from Getty; no palace coordinate or whereabouts for the ruler on the start date.
Osmanerna besegrar safaviderna vid Chald: The Ottomans defeat the Safavids at Chaldiran
Osmanerna erövrar Syrien och Egypten: The Ottomans conquer Syria and Egypt
Osmanerna intar Konstantinopel 1453. Meh: The Ottomans capture Constantinople in 1453. Mehmed II makes the city the centre of his dominion and begins an extensive building programme.
Otto I besegrar en ungersk här på Lechfä: Otto I defeats a Hungarian army at Lechfeld on 10 August 955. He thereby repels the army's incursion into his realm.
Otto I besegrar ungrarna på Lechfältet: Otto I defeats the Hungarians at Lechfeld
O’Briens framställning från 2023 anger c: O’Brien’s 2023 account gives c. 2400–1900/1800 BC for mining and smelting. His 1995 work-camp report gives 2400–1800 BC, while the 1992 mine and habitation report gives 2400–2100 cal BC. These are published archaeological intervals, not an exact foundation date or evidence of uninterrupted annual production.
PBS anger cirka 261 f.Kr.; universitetsm: PBS gives around 261 BC; the university material gives around 260 BC. No new year is calculated from regnal years, and an immediate religious conversion is not asserted.
Palats och rituella anläggningar färdigs: Palaces and ritual structures are completed in Hanyang
Palatset i Pylos förstörs av brand: Fire destroys the palace at Pylos
Palatsmuseet daterar projektet från Xipi: The Palace Museum dates the project from Xiping year four (175) to Guanghe year six (183); Tian Mi gives circa 175–183. The full approximate interval is retained. It dates preparation of the stone edition, not original composition of the classics or later reconstruction.
Palatsmuseets tidslinje skiljer tillträd: The Palace Museum timeline distinguishes the accession in 1487 from the first year of the era in 1488. The source record reproduces the original date without converting it to a day in a Western calendar. The CUHK title and summary give different starting years; both ranges cover the start date.
Palermo, Sicilien, med geografiskt inneh: Palermo, Sicily, with geographical content from several continents
Palmyras råd beslutar att de reviderade: Palmyra's council orders revised dues regulations and their older provisions to be displayed publicly in Greek and local Aramaic. The aim is to reduce disputes between tax collectors and those paying charges on goods and services.
Palmyras råd offentliggör reviderade ska: Palmyra's council publishes revised tax rules
Panangkarans inskrift avsätter mark för: Panangkaran's inscription sets aside land for Tārā's sanctuary in Kalasan
Pannonien, nuvarande Ungern, Österrike o: Pannonia, present-day Hungary, Austria and Croatia
Parantaka I blir Cholahärskare år 907 ef: Parantaka I becomes Chola ruler in 907 after Aditya I. He rules a kingdom whose core territory lies around Tanjore and the lower Kaveri.
Parker Pearson redovisar detta spann för: Parker Pearson reports this range for the earliest burials; it does not measure the duration of the burial tradition or fix the first arrival of migrants, which may have been earlier. Vander Linden places the broader early British phase at 2450/2400–2300 calBC. Neither chronology supplies an exact onset year.
Parlamentets egen historik anger 1265. P: Parliament's own history gives 1265. The entry describes neither universal suffrage nor a fully developed modern democracy.
Parnierna går in i Parthien, där härskar: The Parni enter Parthia, where its ruler Andragoras is killed. The event extends their rule over the former satrapy.
Parniernas ledare Arsakes utropas till k: Arsaces, the leader of the Parni, is proclaimed king at Asaak. The site's exact location is unknown.
Parthiska styrkor erövrar Babylon och Se: Parthian forces conquer Babylon and Seleucia. Contemporary texts begin to acknowledge Arsacid rule.
Parthiska styrkor intar Babylon och Sele: Parthian forces capture Babylon and Seleucia
Partiell täckning i Maghreb och Iberien;: Partial coverage in the Maghreb and Iberia; the eastern edge of the map is not an attested outer boundary.
Paso de la Amada, Chiapas, Mexikos Still: Paso de la Amada, Chiapas, Mexico’s Pacific coast
Paso de la Amada, regionen Soconusco, Ch: Paso de la Amada, Soconusco region, Chiapas, Mexico
Pegu antar en lankesisk ordinationstradi: Pegu adopts a Sri Lankan ordination tradition
Pegu i Nedre Burma och Sri Lanka: Pegu in Lower Burma and Sri Lanka
Penn Museum daterar tillverkningen av st: Penn Museum dates the manufacture of stone disc B16665 to around 2300 BC. Archaeologists found it in a later temple context from the Larsa period at Ur. The findspot does not identify a workshop, and the museum establishes no year for any poem or appointment of Enheduanna.
Perioden skiljs från den tidigare oligar: The period is distinguished from the earlier oligarchy of 411/410 and the restoration of democracy in 403.
Periplus beskriver Aksums växande handel: The Periplus describes Aksum’s growing trade, linked to the Red Sea through the port of Adulis.
Perpetua och Felicitas avrättas i Kartha: Perpetua and Felicitas are executed at Carthage
Persepolis bränns under Alexanders fältt: Persepolis is burned during Alexander's campaign
Persepolis bränns under Alexanders viste: Persepolis is burned during Alexander's stay in the Persian heartland.
Persepolis dokumenterar silverbetalninga: Persepolis records silver payments against rations
Perserna bryter igenom vid Thermopyle: The Persians break through at Thermopylae
Perserna återtar Egypten efter upproret: The Persians recover Egypt after the revolt
Perseus anger Koroibos som den förste ne: Perseus identifies Koroibos as the first recorded Olympic victor and traditionally dates him to 776 BC. Both Perseus and the IOC emphasize that the Games' actual beginning is unknown. The year does not prove that these were the first Games.
Persiska och turkiska styrkor besegrar h: Persian and Turkic forces defeat the Hephthalites
Persian and Turkic forces defeat the Hephthalite Empire through separate campaigns. Both the course of the war and its dating are disputed.
Persiska styrkor förstör helgedomarna på: Persian forces destroy the sanctuaries on the Athenian Acropolis. The later monumental buildings are erected after this destruction.
Persiska styrkor under Megabyzos återerö: Persian forces under Megabyzus reconquer Egypt and recover Memphis. Inarus' revolt and the Athenian relief expedition fail.
Personartikeln anger födelse 786 och död: The biographical article gives birth in 786 and death in 833.
Personen är almohaden Muhammad ibn Yaqub: The person is the Almohad Muhammad ibn Yaqub, also called Abu Abd Allah in Hazard’s table. His patronymic and dynasty must accompany the name so that he is not confused with other rulers bearing the title al-Nasir.
Personerna uppgav att de var romerska sä: The people claimed to be Roman envoys. This does not establish that they had an official Roman mission.
Personnamnet är Li Kuo. Dezong är det ve: His personal name is Li Kuo. Dezong is the established historical imperial name.
Perus nationalmuseum förlägger Chavín de: Peru’s national museum places the emergence of Chavín de Huántar around 1200 BC. The broader cultural period of 1200–200 BC does not indicate when each building was constructed.
Perus nominering anger hela intervallet: Peru’s nomination gives the full interval for construction and principal use. Earlier remains may exist in parts of the site; no exact foundation year is given.
Pesten når Konstantinopel. Prokopios upp: The plague reaches Constantinople. Procopius states that he is in the city when the epidemic breaks out.
Petronius, ståthållare i Egypten, leder: Petronius, governor of Egypt, leads two expeditions into the Nubian kingdom of Meroë. Rome describes them as counterattacks, while their strategic background is debated.
Philipp Melanchthons bekännelseskrift lä: Philipp Melanchthon's confession of faith is presented to the emperor and the princes of the empire at the Diet of Augsburg. The text defends Reformation doctrine against accusations of heresy.
Piklihal i Deccan, nuvarande södra Indie: Piklihal in the Deccan, present-day southern India
Pilgrimen Xuanzang reser till Indien och: The pilgrim Xuanzang travels to India and Southeast Asia. His translations spur the growth of Buddhism in China, and his travel account, Records of the Western Regions, remains a key source for South Asian history.
Pinggera daterar konciliet till 1450. De: Pinggera dates the council to 1450. This dates its decision on Sabbath observance, not the origin of the practice or proof of immediate acceptance by every community. No month or day is assigned.
Pippin blir frankernas kung: Pippin becomes king of the Franks
Placeringen är en uttalad inferens: hon: The placement is an explicit inference: she is the mother of Huáscar, who is dated to circa 1491, and Sarmiento describes her after Huayna’s death. The passages provide no birth dating of her own.
Platsbeskrivningen ger en ungefärlig dat: The site account dates the appearance of new pottery forms approximately. This is not the founding date of Vinelz or the first appearance of Corded Ware anywhere; the account notes earlier examples elsewhere in northern Switzerland.
Platsen anges inte i det lästa källavsni: The location is not stated in the consulted source passage.
Platsen för Parkhaus Opéra, Zürich, Schw: The site of Parkhaus Opéra, Zurich, Switzerland
Platsens officiella beskrivning anger et: The official site account gives an approximate construction date. Phaistos was already occupied earlier; this entry does not date the settlement's foundation or the later palace rebuilding to 1900 BC.
Pollenserier tyder på att landskapet i T: Pollen sequences indicate a rapid opening of the landscape for grazing animals in Thy. The Thy Project authors associate this change with the Single Grave culture.
Polsk-litauiska styrkor och deras allier: Polish-Lithuanian forces and their allies defeat the Teutonic Order at Grunwald on 15 July 1410. The order's Grand Master Ulrich von Jungingen dies in the battle.
Pompejus får ett stort befäl mot pirater: Pompey receives a major command against pirates
Pompejus går in i Judeen och intar Jerus: Pompey enters Judaea and captures Jerusalem. The event follows his earlier campaigns in the eastern Mediterranean.
Pontisk-kaspiska stäppen och växande nät: Pontic–Caspian steppe and expanding networks from Hungary to Kazakhstan
The Portuguese conquer the city of Melaka in 1511. The city lies on the strategic Strait of Malacca.
Portugiserna söker handelsrätt i Ayuttha: The Portuguese seek trading rights in Ayutthaya
Portugisiska styrkor besegrar Bijapurs h: Portuguese forces defeat Bijapur's ruler with Timayya's help in 1510. They establish a lasting stronghold in Old Goa.
Portugisiskt dekret kräver kristnande i: A Portuguese decree demands Christianisation in Ndongo
Posten använder årtalet i Waughs kronolo: The entry uses the year in Waugh's chronology and adds no exact coronation day or title of khan.
Posten gäller angreppet 1337 och ger ing: The entry concerns the attack in 1337 and gives no new continuous phase of war extending to 1453.
Posten gäller det rivaliserande valet 13: The entry concerns the rival election in 1378. It provides no new continuous event entry for the whole schism up to 1417.
Posten påstår inte att alla mongoliska f: The entry does not claim that all Mongol princes recognised Kublai or that the succession struggle was settled.
Prapanca fullbordar det gammaljavanska l: Prapanca completes the Old Javanese panegyric Nagarakretagama in honour of King Hayam Wuruk. The poem depicts the court and the king's journeys through Majapahit.
Presidentbibliotekets katalog daterar ka: The Presidential Library's catalogue dates the cathedral to 1158–1160. UNESCO gives 1158 without distinguishing the start of construction from completion.
Prins Rajakumar låter hugga Myazediinskr: Prince Rajakumar has the Myazedi inscription carved in Bagan. On the stone's four sides, the scribes use Pyu, Mon, Burmese and Pali.
Prins Shōtoku tillträder som regent åt k: Prince Shōtoku becomes regent to Empress Suiko according to the historical account presented by Shitennoji University.
Projektet anger cirka 2800 f.Kr. för ras: The project gives circa 2800 BC for the collapse that led to the rebuilding. The dating establishes no individual year.
Projektets datering omfattar två år. Ing: The project's dating spans two years. No single foundation year is selected.
Projektets datering är uttryckligen möjl: The project's dating is explicitly possible. The full range 2800–2700 BC remains and ends beyond this work block's final year.
Provinsen delas i Övre och Nedre Pannoni: The province is divided into Upper and Lower Pannonia.
Präster i Kanopos förordnar om en extra: Priests at Canopus decree an additional festival day
Prästerna på Elefantine söker stöd för a: Elephantine's priests seek support to rebuild their temple
Psamtik I tar kontroll över södra Egypte: Psamtik I takes control of southern Egypt
Ptolemaios II och Antiochos I för krig m: Ptolemy II and Antiochus I wage war against each other.
Ptolemaios II och Antiochos II för krig: Ptolemy II and Antiochus II wage war against each other.
Ptolemaios III och Seleukos II för krig: Ptolemy III and Seleucus II wage war against each other.
Ptolemaios IV besegrar Antiochos III vid: Ptolemy IV defeats Antiochus III at Raphia.
Pueblofolk bygger Cliff Palace i en klip: Pueblo people build Cliff Palace in a rock alcove at Mesa Verde. More than a hundred people live there in one of North America's large cliff dwelling complexes.
Pueblofolk bygger ett stort stenkomplex: Pueblo people build a large stone complex in three main phases. They use the large building for ceremonies, trade, storage and other communal activities.
Pueblofolk lämnar centrala Mesa Verde: Pueblo people leave central Mesa Verde
Pueblofolk lämnar centrala Mesa Verde ef: Pueblo people leave central Mesa Verde after a longer period of outward migration. Many join communities farther south and continue their traditions there.
Puglia daterar förslutningen av grav 3 t: Puglia dates Tomb 3's sealing to this year from an inventory slip. The date concerns the burial context, not the manuscripts' composition or copying. The two Laozi copies are assigned earlier copying dates, and the occupant's personal identity is not established here.
Punkten belägger ingen kontroll över hel: The point does not attest control over all of polygon 80, which also encloses independent Tlaxcala and areas unsupported by B1’s sources.
Pushyamitra störtar den siste Mauryahärs: Pushyamitra overthrows the last Mauryan ruler according to tradition
Pylos och Ano Englianos i Messenien, nuv: Pylos and Ano Englianos in Messenia, present-day Greece
Pyrrhos seglar till Sicilien och bedrive: Pyrrhus sails to Sicily and campaigns there for several years.
Pärlhirs ingår i försörjningen vid Tchad: Pearl millet forms part of subsistence around Lake Chad
Pärlhirs är belagd från omkring 1200 kal: Pearl millet is attested from approximately 1200 cal BC in Gajiganna’s phase II. This dates the archaeological evidence, rather than a securely established first year of cultivation.
På Aurelianus initiativ byggs en ny förs: A new defensive wall is built around Rome at Aurelian’s initiative.
På Caracallas uppdrag uppförs termer på: Baths are built on the Aventine in Rome at Caracalla’s command. A dedicated branch of the Aqua Marcia supplies the complex with water.
På Kermas östra gravfält, som användes a: In Kerma's eastern cemetery, used by the capital's elite, the dead come to be placed on wooden beds after an earlier practice of laying them directly on cattle hides. Honegger dates this change approximately to 2000 BC and identifies the bed tradition as Egyptian in origin. Other accounts describe the transition through relative archaeological phases rather than a precise year.
På den bolivianska sidan av Titicacasjön: On the Bolivian side of Lake Titicaca, builders begin the ceremonial complex at Chiripá. One-room rectangular buildings, some with painted walls and interior niches, surround a central patio with a sunken court.
På en hög stenstele samlas rättsbeslut o: A tall stone stele brings together judicial decisions on matters including family, property, trade and work. The text presents Hammurabi as the upholder of justice.
På stele 3 i La Venta avbildas två centr: Stela 3 at La Venta depicts two central figures facing each other, together with several smaller figures. The museum sees the relief as an example of a change in Olmec visual imagery. The figures' social status is an interpretation.
Pålhus vid Talepakemalai hör till den ti: Stilt houses at Talepakemalai belong to an early Lapita context
Påven Clemens V kommer till Avignon och: Pope Clement V comes to Avignon and stays with the Dominicans. He resides there periodically, while the leadership of the papacy develops a growing connection to the city.
Påven Gregorius XI återvänder från Avign: Pope Gregory XI returns from Avignon to Rome. An armed escort accompanies him into the city.
Påven Honorius III godkänner Franciskus: Pope Honorius III approves Francis's Rule for the Friars Minor. The Rule prescribes obedience, absence of property and chastity.
Påven Innocentius III motsätter sig Fili: Pope Innocent III opposes Philip’s attempt to repudiate Ingeborg. He holds the papal office at the bookmark.
Påven Johannes XII smörjer och kröner Ot: Pope John XII anoints and crowns Otto I emperor on 2 February 962. Otto thereby renews the western imperial office in the Carolingian tradition.
Påven Johannes XIII förrättar vigseln me: Pope John XIII performs the marriage of Theophanu and Otto II in Rome on 14 April 972. He then crowns Theophanu empress. She has come from the Byzantine imperial court.
Påven Julius II inviger Michelangelos ta: Pope Julius II inaugurates Michelangelo's ceiling paintings in the Sistine Chapel. The series of images draws its subjects from Genesis.
Påven Leo III kröner Karl den store till: Pope Leo III crowns Charlemagne emperor in Rome. The coronation takes place in St Peter's on Christmas Day in 800.
Påven Stefanus smörjer Pippin och hans s: Pope Stephen anoints Pippin and his sons
Påven Urban II uppmanar furstar och dera: Pope Urban II calls on princes and their subjects to undertake an expedition to the eastern Mediterranean region at the Council of Clermont in 1095. He links the enterprise to the forgiveness of sins. In his December letter, he names Bishop Adhemar of Le Puy as his representative for the expedition.
Påven är en extern ämbetsinnehavare och: The pope is an external officeholder and is not included in the French household’s list of people.
Påvens sändebud inrättar ett ärkebiskops: The pope's envoy establishes an archbishopric at Nidaros
Påvliga sändebud lägger en bannlysning m: Papal envoys lay an excommunication against Patriarch Michael Cerularius on the altar of Hagia Sophia in 1054. The patriarch convenes a synod that responds by excommunicating the envoys.
Påvliga sändebud och patriarkens synod b: Papal envoys and the patriarch's synod excommunicate each other
Qaitbay bekostar Ashrafiyyamadrassan i J: Qaitbay funds the Ashrafiyya Madrasa in Jerusalem during 1480–1482. He also has the fortifications of Aleppo strengthened during his reign.
Qaitbay låter bygga sitt gravkomplex i K: Qaitbay has his funerary complex built in Cairo
Qaitbay låter uppföra sitt gravkomplex i: Qaitbay has his funerary complex erected in Cairo's northern cemetery during 1472–1474. During his reign he also funds religious foundations and commercial buildings.
Qara Khitai besegrar Sanjar vid Qatwan: The Qara Khitai defeat Sanjar at Qatwan
Qara Khitais här besegrar de förenade ka: The Qara Khitai army defeats the combined Karakhanid and Seljuk forces at Qatwan near Samarkand in September 1141. The victors take Sanjar's wife prisoner and assume overlordship over Transoxiana.
Qarabagh och det ilkhanska riket i Iran: Qarabagh and the Ilkhanid realm in Iran and neighbouring regions
Qin erövrar kungariket Shu i Sichuanbäck: Qin conquers the kingdom of Shu in the Sichuan Basin.
Qinmakten låter bränna klassiska texter: The Qin authorities burn classical texts
Qins erövringar avslutar de stridande st: Qin's conquests end the Warring States period. Its ruler adopts the title of First Emperor.
Quang Nam och Thu Bon-området, centrala: Quang Nam and the Thu Bon area, central Vietnam
Quanzhou, en hamn i södra Kina: Quanzhou, a port in southern China
Qutb al-Din Aybak blir sultan i norra In: Qutb al-Din Aybak becomes sultan in northern India. He founds the Mamluk dynasty of the Delhi Sultanate.
Rajakumar låter rista Myazediinskriften: Rajakumar has the Myazedi inscription carved
Rajaraja I inviger Brihadisvaratemplet i: Rajaraja I dedicates the Brihadisvara Temple at Thanjavur
Rajendra I angriper Srivijayas hamnstäde: Rajendra I attacks Srivijaya's port cities
Rajendra I sänder en flotta över Bengali: Rajendra I sends a fleet across the Bay of Bengal against Srivijaya. Chola soldiers attack port cities on Sumatra and the Malay Peninsula during a campaign that the king later has described in inscriptions.
Rajendra I:s byggare färdigställer Briha: Rajendra I's builders complete the Brihadisvara Temple at Gangaikondacholapuram. They erect a Shiva shrine with a 53-metre-high tower and sculptures that form part of the Chola court's religious art.
Rajendra I:s byggare färdigställer templ: Rajendra I's builders complete the temple at Gangaikondacholapuram
Ramathibodi I beställer templet Wat Phut: Ramathibodi I commissions the temple Wat Phutthaisawan. The complex belongs to the Ayutthaya kingdom's early Buddhist building projects.
Ramesses III slår tillbaka ett angrepp f: Ramesses III repels an attack by the Sea Peoples
Ramses II:s egyptiska armé och Muwatalli: Ramesses II's Egyptian army and Muwatalli II's Hittite forces meet in the Battle of Kadesh. The battle becomes a central episode in the struggle for power between the kingdoms.
Rangitotos utbrott dateras till omkring: Rangitoto's eruption is dated to around 1400. Human footprints have been found in the ash on the neighbouring island of Motutapu.
Rao Jodha grundlägger Mehrangarh: Rao Jodha lays the foundations of Mehrangarh
Rao Jodha grundlägger Mehrangarh 1459. F: Rao Jodha lays the foundations of Mehrangarh in 1459. The fort is subsequently expanded in several phases.
Rapporten anger huvudstadsställning från: The report gives capital status from 1353. The entry dates neither the site's first settlement nor every step in the kingdom's emergence.
Rapportens inledning anger den 16 juli 1: The report's introduction gives 16 July 1212. The reference to Muslim flight after the defeat appears in the discussion of the material; no troop strengths or casualty figures are included.
Raqqa eller Rafiqa, sannolik hovbas: Raqqa or Rafiqa, probable court base
Rashtrakutahärskaren Krishna III besegra: The Rashtrakuta ruler Krishna III defeats the Cholas at Takkolam near Arkonam in 949. He subsequently occupies a large part of the Chola kingdom's northern territory.
Raziyya avsätts från Delhis tron: Raziyya is deposed from Delhi's throne
Raziyya loses the office of sultan in Delhi. Her attempt to rule independently has met opposition from the magnates.

Songmyndigheterna tar över utgivningen a: Song authorities take over jiaozi issuance in Sichuan
Songriket och Liaoriket, nuvarande Kina: The Song and Liao empires, present-day China
Sonni Alis Songhaystyrkor tar över Timbu: Sonni Ali's Songhay forces take over Timbuktu in 1468. They drive out the city's Tuareg rulers and incorporate the city into the Songhay Empire.
Sopara, nuvarande Nalasopara nära Mumbai: Sopara, present-day Nalasopara near Mumbai, western India
Sosos härskare utvidgar sitt välde över: Soso's rulers extend their dominion over parts of Ghana
Spannet daterar handelsbeskrivningen, in: The span dates the account of trade, not the kingdom’s foundation.
Spannet omfattar två skilda expeditioner: The span covers two separate expeditions, in 25/24 and 22/21 BC. It does not assert fighting in every intervening year, give an independently chosen peace date, or identify a particular queen without support.
Spanska trupper och tlaxcaltekiska allie: Spanish troops and Tlaxcalan allies besiege Tenochtitlan. Cuauhtémoc is captured when the city falls.
Sparta och Lakonien på Peloponnesos: Sparta and Laconia in the Peloponnese
Spartacus leder ett slavuppror i Italien: Spartacus leads a slave revolt in Italy
Spartacus och hans följeslagare gör uppr: Spartacus and his followers revolt and defeat several Roman forces. Crassus eventually suppresses the uprising.
Staden växer och dominerar dalen, synbar: The city grows and dominates the valley, apparently by force. The plaza area is levelled and monuments are built.
Stadens plan ordnas i ett rutnät och byg: The city’s plan is arranged in a grid and construction of the Pyramid of the Sun begins.
Staten Yue besegrar Wu. Wus kung Fuchai: The state of Yue defeats Wu. Wu's king Fuchai takes his own life as his kingdom falls.
Staten börjar sälja spannmål månadsvis t: The state begins monthly sales of reduced-price grain to Rome's citizens.
Staterna Han, Wei och Zhao: The states of Han, Wei and Zhao
Staterna Wu och Yue: The states of Wu and Yue
