Stela 29 i Tikal förenar en daterad insk: Stela 29 at Tikal combines a dated inscription with a richly dressed figure interpreted as a dynastic ruler.
Stela C bevarar en tidig långräkningsdat: Stela C preserves an early Long Count date
Stela C från Tres Zapotes bär den fullst: Stela C from Tres Zapotes bears the complete Long Count 7.16.6.16.18. The inscription provides early evidence of this way of expressing a long span of time.
The stela’s inscription has the Long Count date 8.12.14.8.15. Bonn gives the Julian equivalent as 8 July 292. The entry uses the year; the day of manufacture is not established.
Stora Bulgarien och stäppbulgarerna: Old Great Bulgaria and the steppe Bulgars
Stormännen medverkade i kungaval inom de: Magnates participated in royal elections within the ruling kin; neither strict primogeniture nor a free choice based on ability represents this.
Strupler placerar valet av Hattusa som h: Strupler places the choice of Hattusa as capital around 1650 BC. Herrmann and colleagues explain that 1650 is a conventional accession estimate based on generation counting, not a dated foundation. Kloekhorst interprets the court's move as following an accession at Nesa. The precise transfer year remains unknown; no reign dates are converted into a new event date.
Studien anger två absoluta dateringar fö: The study gives two absolute dates for the attack in Merneptah's fifth regnal year. These are treated as alternatives for the same attack, not as an eleven-year invasion.
Studien använder en ungefärlig datering: The study uses an approximate date and distinguishes the reform from Cao Cao’s earlier attempts.
Studien daterar stenen till 960-talet. 9: The study dates the stone to the 960s. 960–969 are the bounds of the whole decade and indicate uncertainty about the date, not that the work lasted ten years.
Studien från 2023 föredrar cirka 1632–16: The 2023 study favours approximately 1632–1610 BC, an interval containing around 56.2 percent of the combined probability. At 95.4 percent, two preferred models give 1670–1607 and, respectively, 1667–1646 plus 1643–1594 BC. The outer bounds are not a continuous confidence interval or the duration of the destruction.
Studien sammanfattar dateringen som 1065: The study summarizes the dating as 1065–825 calibrated BC. The modelled start falls within 1065–921 and the end within approximately 918–825 BC; the outer bounds therefore do not establish a continuous 240-year occupation. Irrigation may have been needed, but the identified channels may be later and their construction is not dated here.
Studien sammanfattar fynden med cirka 27: The study summarises the finds with circa 2700 calibrated BC. It dates settlement Phase 1 to 2705–2545 BC and interprets the isotopes as traces of winter feeding with millet. No exact introduction year for millet can be given.
Styrkor som Li Feng benämner Västra Rong: Forces that Li Feng calls the Western Rong enter the Wei River valley, plunder Feng and Hao, and kill King You. The Western Zhou political order ends. The event brings the royal house's long domination over much of the Yellow River region to an end.
Styrkor under Manlius Maximus och Servil: Forces under Manlius Maximus and Servilius Caepio suffer a severe defeat at Arausio.
Stäppen mellan övre Ural och övre Tobol,: The steppe between the upper Ural and upper Tobol rivers, southeast of the Ural Mountains
Stäppen norr om Svarta havet: The steppe north of the Black Sea
Su Song beskriver ett astronomiskt urver: Su Song describes an astronomical clock mechanism

Su Song describes an astronomical clock mechanism in his treatise of 1092. His water-powered clock tower uses a chain mechanism to display the time, the phase of the Moon and the positions of celestial bodies.
Suger och biskoparna inviger Saint-Denis: Suger and the bishops consecrate the new choir of Saint-Denis
Sukhothai is incorporated into Ayutthaya in 1438. The city is a centre of ceramics and bronze sculpture.
Sulla marscherar med sin armé mot Rom: Sulla marches his army on Rome
Sulla utses till diktator i Rom. Han gen: Sulla is appointed dictator in Rome. He carries out an extensive programme of legislation and changes to the administration of justice.
Sultan Ahmad Shah grundar Ahmadabad 1411: Sultan Ahmad Shah founds Ahmadabad in 1411. The city is established on the east bank of the Sabarmati River.
Sultan Malikshah inför en solkalender so: Sultan Malikshah introduces a solar calendar that researchers date to 15 March 1079 according to the source's conversion. His astronomers link the New Year, Nowruz, to the spring equinox.
Sumatra och Malackahalvön, nuvarande Ind: Sumatra and the Malay Peninsula, present-day Indonesia and Malaysia
Sumu-abum erövrar områden i norra Babylo: Sumu-abum conquers areas in northern Babylonia and the lower Diyala
Sumu-la-El bygger upp kärnan i Babylons: Sumu-la-El builds the core of the kingdom of Babylon
Sundiata Keita besegrar Sosos kung Suman: Sundiata Keita defeats Soso's king Sumanguru Kante. The victory is associated with the rise of the Mali Empire and lives on in the Mande peoples' oral traditions.
Susa och dess omgivningar, sydvästra Ira: Susa and its surroundings, southwestern Iran
Svalare och torrare förhållanden i delar: Cooler and drier conditions in parts of the Levant
Svartahavsområdet, den eurasiska stäppen: The Black Sea region, the Eurasian steppe and Karakorum
Svarte prinsen besegrar Johan II vid Poi: The Black Prince defeats John II at Poitiers
Svensk benämning på Eirenes roll som reg: Swedish designation of Irene’s role as reigning empress.
Svensk översättning av kejsartiteln i de: Swedish translation of the imperial title in the historical account.
Svensk översättning av kejsartiteln i kä: Swedish translation of the imperial title in the sources.
Svensk översättning av kungatiteln i mus: Swedish translation of the royal title in the museum texts.
Svensk översättning av wang, kung, i käl: Swedish translation of wang, king, in the source’s description of the ruler.
Sydindiska megalitkulturer från järnålde: South Indian Iron Age megalithic cultures
Sydmesopotamiska ledare gör uppror mot B: Southern Mesopotamian leaders rebel against Babylon
Synagogan i Dura-Europos byggs ut: The synagogue at Dura-Europos is enlarged
Synoden i Whitby sammanträder för att lö: The Synod of Whitby meets to settle liturgical conflicts between the Celtic and Roman branches of Christianity in England. It decides to follow the Roman church, which draws England closer to Rome and continental Europe.
Synoden i Whitby väljer romersk praxis: The Synod of Whitby chooses Roman practice
Syrisk-palestinska regionen; Corning ang: Syro-Palestinian region; Corning specifies the environs of Jerusalem
Sändebuden Zhu Ying och Kang Tai reser f: The envoys Zhu Ying and Kang Tai travel from Wu to Funan. Historians disagree about the mission's date and the Funan ruler they met.
Södra Iran och Gulfområdet tillverkar kl: Southern Iran and the Gulf region produce Intercultural Style chlorite vessels
Södra Iran och det större Gulfområdet: Southern Iran and the greater Gulf region
Södra Mesopotamien och Susa, nuvarande I: Southern Mesopotamia and Susa, present-day Iraq and Iran
Södra Mesopotamien, bland annat Larsa oc: Southern Mesopotamia, including Larsa and Uruk in present-day Iraq
Södra Songriket besegras: The Southern Song Empire is defeated
TDV anger 796 och alternativet 795. Spel: TDV gives 796 and the alternative 795. The game value uses 1 January 796; it does not reproduce a historical birth date.
TDV anger andra tronföljarutnämningen se: TDV places the second successor designation six years after 792, giving 798. Iranica gives the proclamation at the pilgrimage in 802. An earlier designation and later confirmation may explain the difference, but the passages do not resolve it.
TDV anger födelse år 145 AH (762), död å: TDV gives birth in 145 AH (762), death in 216 AH (831) and an age of 71 without specifying the calendar of the age. The difference of 216 minus 145 is 71; lunar years may reconcile the information, and no contradiction has been established. The first of January 762 is a game value, not a historical birthday.
TDV belägger äktenskapet med Zubayda. De: TDV attests the marriage to Zubayda. The recorded spouse relationship reproduces the documented relationship; an empty list of parent links means that no such links have been recorded.
TDV beskriver hanafitiska och malikitisk: TDV describes Hanafi and Maliki settings under the dynasty as a whole. This is insufficient to give 800 an exclusive state school of law or later Muʿtazilite state doctrine.
TDV säger att Harun godtog far-till-son-: TDV says that Harun accepted father-to-son succession. Kennedy stresses that the sons had no known caliphal appointment and took over during the caliphate’s later crisis. A completed succession law can therefore not be assumed in 800.
Tabell 2 i studien från 2009 anger hela: Table 2 in the 2009 study dates the whole of phase BA4 to 800–700 BC. The same study places the transition from BA3 within 810–780 and estimates the burial phase's duration at 20–133 years. These uncertainties give no exact year for the start of casting.
Tailapa II störtar Rashtrakutahärskaren: Tailapa II overthrows the Rashtrakuta ruler Karka II in 973. He founds the dynasty historians call the Chalukyas of Kalyana.
Taira och Minamoto utkämpar Genpeikriget: The Taira and Minamoto fight the Genpei War
Tairas och Minamotos krigare strider om: Taira and Minamoto warriors fight for power in Japan for five years. Minamoto Yoritomo's family wins the war, and military leaders take power from the older court government.
Tamilska köpmän dokumenterar ett gillesm: Tamil merchants record a guild meeting at Barus
Tangdynastins härskare förlorar makten: The Tang dynasty's rulers lose power
Tangdynastins härskare förlorar makten å: The Tang dynasty's rulers lose power in 907. During the following period, five short-lived military regimes rule in northern China, while several kingdoms compete in the south.
Tanghovet utfärdar tvåskattesystemet: The Tang court promulgates the two-tax system
Taylor daterar övertagandet till våren 4: Taylor dates the takeover to the spring of 40.
Taylor låter fälttåget pågå till 44 och: Taylor places the campaign’s end in 44 and dates the sisters’ defeat to around the end of 42; the museum’s chronology gives approximately 43.
Tchadsjöns sydvästra bäcken, nuvarande n: Southwestern Lake Chad basin, present-day northeastern Nigeria
Tekish besegrar och dödar Tughril III: Tekish defeats and kills Tughril III
Tekniskt id för en framtida namnlista. I: Technical ID for a future name list. No name-list file or attested name list is included. No generated identities have been created.
Technical ID for a future name list. No name-list file exists; the ID does not indicate an attested name list.
Tempelgemenskapen i Tōdai-ji inviger den: The temple community at Tōdai-ji dedicates the Great Buddha statue in a ceremony. The craftspeople had completed the image itself in 749.
Tempelgemenskapen inviger den stora Budd: The temple community dedicates the Great Buddha in Nara
Tempelinskriften daterar invigningen til: The temple inscription dates the dedication to 1186 according to Carter and colleagues. Researchers stress that the exact start of construction is unknown; the entry concerns the dedication.
Templet Ryōanji grundas 1450. Det ligger: The temple Ryōanji is founded in 1450. It lies in the hills northwest of Kyoto.
Templet i Jerusalem återinvigs: The temple in Jerusalem is rededicated
Templo Mayor hade helgedomar för Tláloc: The Templo Mayor had shrines to Tláloc and Huitzilopochtli. Ahuitzotl participated in rites and promoted the temple during his reign.
Tenochtitlan förenar sina styrkor med Te: Tenochtitlan joins its forces with Texcoco and Tlacopan and defeats Azcapotzalco. The Mexica of Tenochtitlan gain a leading position within the alliance.
Tenochtitlan, Mexikodalen, nuvarande Mex: Tenochtitlan, Valley of Mexico, present-day Mexico
Teotihuacan får ett regelbundet gatunät: Teotihuacan gains a regular street grid
Teotihuacan får ett utvidgat stadscentru: Teotihuacan gains an expanded civic centre
Terengganu, östra Malackahalvön, nuvaran: Terengganu, eastern Malay Peninsula, present-day Malaysia
Terengganuinskriften kungör islamiska rä: The Terengganu inscription proclaims Islamic legal rules
Testamentet skiljs från det senare upprä: The bequest is distinguished from the later establishment of the province of Asia.
Texten beskriver styre och institutioner: The text describes government and institutions during the reign. It does not date a particular court event to the bookmark date.
Thailändska styrkor plundrar Angkor 1431: Thai forces sack Angkor in 1431. The event weakens the Khmer centre of power.
Thebe och Itjtawy, troligen vid Lisht, E: Thebes and Itjtawy, probably at Lisht, Egypt
Thebe och Nildalen, Egypten: Thebes and the Nile valley, Egypt
Theodora återinför ikonerna i det bysant: Theodora restores icons in the Byzantine Empire in 843 and ends the final phase of the iconoclastic controversy. During the controversy, church painters had replaced depictions of Mary with crosses in church apses.
Theodosius befaller att hedniska tempel: Theodosius orders pagan temples to close
Theodosius orders pagan temples to close. The museum dates the order to 391.
Theophanu gifter sig med Otto II och bli: Theophanu marries Otto II and becomes empress
Thommens kapitelsammanfattning anger 358: Thommen’s chapter summary gives 358. No magnitude or day-date has been added.
Thommens kapitelsammanfattning anger 365: Thommen’s chapter summary gives 365. This event specifies no magnitude, exact day or reconstructed epicentre.
Thutmosis III besegrar kanaaneiska styrk: Thutmose III defeats Canaanite forces at Megiddo
Thutmosis III:s egyptiska armé besegrar: Thutmose III’s Egyptian army defeats Canaanite forces at Megiddo. Egyptian rulers subsequently consolidate their military and administrative presence in Canaan. Scholars give different absolute years for the battle.
Thyprojektets författare kopplar pollenb: The Thy Project authors link the pollen evidence to the Single Grave culture and describe the change as taking less than a century. The approximate marker does not fix a single year or an end date; the later clearance beginning around 1500 BC is separate.
Tiberius Gracchus driver igenom en jordr: Tiberius Gracchus secures a land reform
Tibetanska styrkor intar Khotan omkring: Tibetan forces capture Khotan around 791. At the same time, they face Uyghur resistance farther north.
Tibetoburmanska folk i Himalaya och nord: Tibeto-Burman peoples in the Himalayas and northeastern India
Tidiga användare väger varor med vågar o: Early users weigh goods with scales and weights
Tidiga klockbägargravar markerar en förä: Early Beaker graves mark a change in British burial practices
Tidslinjen anger endast årtalet. Posten: The timeline provides only the year. This entry adds no unsupported days for the separate engagements.
Tidslinjen anger hela kriget som 91–88 f: The timeline dates the entire war to 91–88 BC. It places the citizenship laws in 90 and 89 respectively; these do not mean that all practical questions of rights were resolved at once.
Tikal besegras i ett stjärnkrig: Tikal is defeated in a star war
Tikal besegras i ett så kallat stjärnkri: Tikal is defeated in a so-called star war. Researchers from the Caracol Project interpret the defeat as Caracol freeing itself from Tikal's overlordship.
Tikal och Caracol, nuvarande Guatemala o: Tikal and Caracol, present-day Guatemala and Belize
Tikals stela 29 bär ett inskriftsdatum f: Tikal’s Stela 29 bears an inscribed date from AD 292
Tillbakadragandet följer på senare fältt: The withdrawal follows later campaigns, several years after the defeat of 9.
Tillträdet 791 och döden 842 belägger li: Accession in 791 and death in 842 attest life at the bookmark.
Tillträdet dateras till 1792 f.Kr. i Mar: The Mari overview dates the accession to 1792 BC. Cornell lists older reign frameworks of 1848–1806, 1792–1750, 1728–1686 and 1696–1654 BC. The study it reports supports the Middle Chronology, so the alternatives have differing support.
Tillverkningsort okänd; framställningen: Place of manufacture unknown; the scene concerns Naram-Sin and the Zagros region
Timur besegrar osmanerna vid Ankara: Timur defeats the Ottomans at Ankara
Timur blir ledare för Ulus Chagatay. Han: Timur becomes leader of the Chagatai Ulus. He begins developing Samarkand as his capital.
Timur dör 1405 under förberedelserna för: Timur dies in 1405 during preparations for a campaign against China. Over the following decades, his descendants seek realms of their own and weaken the Timurid Empire.
Timur dör inför fälttåget mot Kina: Timur dies before the campaign against China
Timur erövrar Bagdad under sina västliga: Timur conquers Baghdad during his western campaigns. He thereby extends his military control to one of Iraq's great cities.
Timur erövrar Herat under sin expansion: Timur conquers Herat during his expansion in Khorasan. He thereby brings the city under his power.
Timur tar ledningen i Ulus Chagatay: Timur takes the leadership of the Chagatai Ulus
Timurs armé besegrar Delhis försvarare o: Timur's army defeats Delhi's defenders and enters the city. The plundering expedition weakens the sultanate's position.
Timurs armé besegrar den osmanske sultan: Timur's army defeats the Ottoman sultan's forces at Ankara in 1402. During his campaigns, Timur has extended his dominion over Iran and Iraq.
Timurs armé intar och plundrar Delhi: Timur's army captures and plunders Delhi
Timurs arméer bränner Aleppo och Damasku: Timur's armies burn Aleppo and Damascus during the campaigns in Syria. He takes artists away to his capital, Samarkand.
Timurs styrkor angriper Gyllene horden u: Timur's forces attack the Golden Horde during 1395–1396. They destroy the horde's major cities.
Timurs styrkor ödelägger Gyllene hordens: Timur's forces devastate the Golden Horde's cities
Titeln avser Ahuitzotl i Tenochtitlan; h: The title refers to Ahuitzotl in Tenochtitlan; the court list does not merge the separate ruling offices of the Triple Alliance.
Tiyacapantzin, även Tiyacapatzin eller T: Tiyacapantzin, also Tiyacapatzin or Te[ya]capantzin in the sources
Tollensedalen i nuvarande nordöstra Tysk: The Tollense Valley in present-day northeastern Germany
Tolv franciskanbröder anländer till Mexi: Twelve Franciscan friars arrive in Mexico. They begin missionary work to convert the Indigenous population to Catholicism.
Townsend använder termen primogenitur me: Townsend uses the term primogeniture but also describes the council’s approval and a limited dynastic circle. Torquemada describes Ahuitzotl’s election and the brothers’ order of succession. The game equivalent is uncertain and does not imply a free choice based on ability.
Traditionen förlägger Konfucius död till: Tradition places Confucius' death in this year. His life is associated with the state of Lu, and his teachings become highly influential in later Chinese philosophy.
Trajanus för sitt andra krig mot dakerna: Trajan wages his second war against the Dacians
Trajanus för sitt första krig mot dakern: Trajan wages his first war against the Dacians
Trajanuskolonnen uppförs i Rom: Trajan’s Column is erected in Rome
Treccanis översikt från 1930 beskriver h: Treccani’s overview from 1930 describes how designation and primogeniture displace election. The game’s gender-neutral rule does not correspond to the entire historical arrangement.
Tretton torn ingår i en ceremoniell anlä: Thirteen towers form part of a ceremonial complex on Peru's coast. Researchers interpret observations of the Sun against the towers as a way to organize a social and ritual calendar.
Tronen kunde gå från far till son eller: The throne could pass from father to son or to a collateral line through a coup; neither primogeniture nor a council’s choice based on ability represents these processes.
Trungsystrarnas styrkor övermannar Hanri: The Trung sisters’ forces overwhelm Han garrisons and settlements. The sisters rule from Me Linh.
Tryckare framställer en rulle med Diaman: Printers produce a scroll of the Diamond Sutra and date it to 11 May 868. They use woodblocks and begin the text with an image of the Buddha teaching Subhuti.
Träbäddar införs i Kermas gravskick: Wooden beds enter Kerma's burial practices
Träsnidare framställer omkring 80 000 tr: Woodcarvers produce around 80,000 woodblocks bearing Buddhist texts. The work is dated to 1237–1248 and linked to appeals for the Buddha's help during the war against the Mongols.
Tsushima, Iki och norra Kyushu, Japan: Tsushima, Iki and northern Kyushu, Japan
Tuareger ur gruppen Imashagan grundar Ti: Tuareg of the Imashagan group found Timbuktu around 1100. They begin with a temporary camp, and settlers subsequently develop a village at the junction of several trade routes.
Tughril går in i Bagdad i december 1055: Tughril enters Baghdad in December 1055 and deposes the Buyid emir al-Malik al-Rahim. The Abbasid caliph al-Qaim confirms him as sultan.
Tulas invånare utvidgar staden till dess: Tula's inhabitants expand the city to its greatest extent during the Tollan phase, which archaeologists date to 900–1150. Craftspeople work in neighbourhoods with homes and temples.
Tulas invånare utvidgar staden under Tol: Tula's inhabitants expand the city during the Tollan phase
Tunisiens kulturarvsmyndighet daterar by: The Tunisian heritage agency dates construction to 860–862. Archnet's narrative gives 862 and its Events field gives 860–862, but its Hijri labels differ internally. No new calendar conversion is made, and the dates do not apply to every reservoir around Kairouan.
Tuoba, som museet beskriver som en gren: The Tuoba, described by the museum as a branch of the Xianbei, establish Northern Wei. They thereby create a new dynastic government in northern China.
Två INAH-sidor anger omkring 1337 respek: Two INAH pages give around 1337 and 1338 respectively, according to the chronicles. The conflicting years are retained; no independent calendar correlation or calculation from Tenochtitlan's foundation is made.
Två alternativa läsningar av inskriftens: Two alternative readings of the inscription's date are preserved. The outer bounds do not indicate an eight-year construction period or date the kingdom's foundation.
Två bosättningar i Harappa tycks ha omge: Two settlements at Harappa appear to have been enclosed by brick walls
Två vulkanutbrott inleder en kraftig ned: Two volcanic eruptions trigger severe cooling
Tyros vid nuvarande Libanons kust: Tyre on the coast of present-day Lebanon
UCL anger mordet till 465/464, och Schmi: UCL dates the murder to 465/464, and Schmitt places Artaxerxes' accession within the same year span. Details of the court intrigue are uncertain.
UCL anger regeringstiden till omkring 10: UCL gives the reign as approximately 1070/1069–1044/1043 BC. The Metropolitan Museum uses approximately 1070 for the beginning of Dynasty 21. This entry concerns the accession; the division of power between Tanis and Thebes provides context for the ensuing rule and has no exact treaty year here.
UCL daterar den nya dynastins uppkomst t: UCL dates the rise of the new dynasty to 1270. The ancestry is presented as a political claim, not proven descent; no named founder is added without separate evidence.
UCLA anger 1812–1809 f.Kr., UCL 1798/179: UCLA gives 1812–1809 BC, UCL 1798/1797–1794/1793 and Diamond c. 1777–1773 following Shaw. The alternatives concern the same short reign and do not indicate a continuous 39-year reign.
UCLA anger regeringstiden till cirka 189: UCLA gives the reign as c. 1896–1887 BC, UCL as 1882–1872 and Manchester Museum as c. 1880–1874. The sources establish no separate foundation year.
UCT anger cirka 1100. ICOMOS återger en: UCT gives circa 1100. ICOMOS recounts a tradition about the end of the fifth century after the Hijra. The foundation narrative gives no certain individual year; the year 1100 comes from UCT's dating.
UNAM beskriver 1325 som det mest accepte: UNAM describes 1325 as the most widely accepted year and gives the equivalent Ome calli, Two House. The source establishes no day or month and distinguishes the foundation from earlier settlement.
UNAM:s intervju ger en beräknad födelsep: The UNAM interview gives an estimated birth period of 1497–1499; the Met gives 1495 with a question mark. The game year follows the beginning of UNAM’s range, and 1 January is a placeholder. No source gives the day.
UNESCO anger 1331–1332 för besöket. Post: UNESCO gives 1331–1332 for the visit. The entry reproduces this range and claims no continuous two-year stay.
UNESCO anger 532–537 för arkitekternas a: UNESCO gives 532–537 for the architects' work. The entry concerns this interval and gives no separate day of dedication.
UNESCO anger cirka 1350 i beskrivningen: UNESCO gives circa 1350 in the description and 1350 in the synthesis. The province's history gives 1351 after its own calendar discussion; no independent conversion is made.
UNESCO gives between circa 1310 and 1333. The range reflects the construction period in this source and establishes no individual foundation year for Kilwa.
UNESCO belägger den kungliga tempelmiljö: UNESCO attests the royal temple setting. Linking Aejang himself to it on the bookmark date requires an interpretation. His later royal house supports Haeinsa from 802, but that temple does not belong to the start in 800. No attested religious leader for 800 has been selected.
UNESCO beskriver samhället under 800- ti: UNESCO describes the society during the ninth to fifteenth centuries. D’Altroy places the emergence of the power that became the Chimú Empire after around 1200. Neither statement gives an exact founding year or a dated court list.
UNESCO förlägger Pan Gengs flytt till om: UNESCO places Pan Geng's move around 1300 BC. Yin Xu's longer period as a capital, 1300–1046 BC, does not indicate how long the move itself lasted.
UNESCO ger intervallet 1070–1072 för gru: UNESCO gives the range 1070–1072 for the foundation. No individual foundation day is given.
UNESCO:s bildtext beskriver 357 som grav: The UNESCO caption describes 357 as the tomb’s inscribed construction date. This event does not identify the person buried there.
Uaxactuns bildhuggare hugger ett monumen: Uaxactun's sculptors carve a monument about war
Ugarit, vid Ras Shamra nära Latakia på d: Ugarit, at Ras Shamra near Latakia on the Syrian coast
Uigurerna bildar ett rike med huvudstad: The Uyghurs establish a state with its capital at Karabalghasun. The capital lies by the Orkhon River in present-day Mongolia.
Uigurerna bildar ett rike vid Orkhon: The Uyghurs establish a state by the Orkhon
Ulugh Beg grundar en madrasa i Samarkand: Ulugh Beg founds a madrasa in Samarkand
Ulugh Beg founds a madrasa in Samarkand in 1417. The teachers give mathematics and astronomy an important place in instruction.
Under Abu Ibrahim Ahmad anlägger byggare: Under Abu Ibrahim Ahmad, builders create settling and storage pools with cisterns for drawing water. The system supplements the city's water supply during drought and serves caravans and livestock as well as residents.
Under Li Chunyou fortsätter tryckningen: Under Li Chunyou, the printing of Buddhist sutras continues; his mother Luo supported such projects during the preceding reign.
Under Maodun och hans son Jiyu samlar Xi: Under Maodun and his son Jiyu, the Xiongnu bring neighbouring peoples under their control. The confederation encompasses large parts of Mongolia, Inner Mongolia and southern Siberia.
Under Narhans period II ökar mängden jär: During Narhan Period II, the quantity of iron objects increases markedly compared with the preceding phase. The inhabitants use more numerous and varied arrowheads, among other objects. Black Slipped Ware dominates the finds from this period.
Under Qin Shi Huang genomförs en statlig: Under Qin Shi Huang, the state organizes the burning of Confucian works and other classical texts.
Under Ramesses III:s åttonde regeringsår: During Ramesses III’s eighth regnal year, groups commonly called the Sea Peoples attack Egypt by land and sea. The pharaoh repels the attack and has the victory depicted at Medinet Habu.
Under Shin Sawbus regering 1453–1472 frä: During Shin Sawbu's reign in 1453–1472, Bago is promoted as a Buddhist centre. Trade also flourishes.
Under Zara Yaqob beslutar ett koncilium: Under Zara Yaqob, a council at Dabra Metmaq rules in favor of the position associated with Ewostatewos: honoring the Sabbath alongside Sunday. The decision addresses a major dispute within the Ethiopian Church.
Under al-Hakam I:s regering tog Almugira: During al-Hakam I’s reign, Almugira, whom the source calls the second heir, received the people’s oaths of allegiance at a mosque pulpit.
Under kriget belägrar Antigonos Gonatas: During the war, Antigonus Gonatas besieges Athens.
Unesco anger det tjugofemte regeringsåre: UNESCO gives the twenty-fifth regnal year as 1009–1010.
Unescos beskrivning anger 930, medan avs: UNESCO's description gives 930, while the section on the World Heritage site's value says around 930. The dating is therefore presented as approximate.
Ungefärlig form från Historical Basemaps: Approximate shape from Historical Basemaps; no boundary is attested in detail. Einhard lists Charles’s conquests for the whole reign without years, and the Royal Frankish Annals show his itinerary in 800. Barcelona lies outside the shape: Zatun entrusted the city to Charles in 797, but on the bookmark date it was under a two-year siege that ended in the summer of 801, outside Frankish hands. Venice lies within the shape: its dukes came to Charles in 806, Pippin attacked the city in 810, and Charles gave it to Nikephoros in the peace that same year. Brittany’s submission in 799 did not last. Uniform rule is not attested.

Approximate shape from Historical Basemaps; no boundary is attested in detail. Irene ruled alone from 797 to 802. Einhard assigns the coastal cities of Dalmatia and southern Italy to the Greeks. Nikephoros recovered parts of Greece after 802, so Greece was not entirely in the empire’s hands in 800. Inland boundaries with Arabs and Bulgars are not attested.

Approximate shape from Historical Basemaps; no boundary is attested in detail. Harun reigned from 786 to 809. Einhard gives only a broad picture of his power in the east. The eastern parts of the shape, including Kabul and Multan, lack support. The caliph’s power was not uniform throughout the area.

Approximate shape from Historical Basemaps; no boundary is attested in detail. Qantara describes an Umayyad emirate in al-Andalus with Córdoba as its capital and many revolts during the first centuries. Barcelona and Lisbon lie outside the shape. Zatun entrusted Barcelona to Charles in 797, but on the bookmark date the city was under a two-year siege that ended in the summer of 801, outside Frankish hands. Unified rule over the entire shape is not attested.

Approximate shape from Historical Basemaps; no boundary is attested in detail. Qantara dates the emirate from 800 without a day, and Ibrahim’s envoy appears in the annals in 801. Qantara includes Tripolitania in the emirate and gives Sétif as a western marker, without a year. Around 28 per cent of the shape lies west of Sétif, including Tiaret, and lacks support. Tripoli lies just outside the shape. The Saharan parts lack support.

Approximate shape from Historical Basemaps; no boundary is attested in detail. The Royal Frankish Annals have Pippin give Ravenna, the Pentapolis and the entire exarchate to Saint Peter in 756. An article from 1912 adds the Duchy of Rome through a document from 781 but states that no document has survived from Pippin’s or Charles’s time. The name Papal States is that article’s term. Spoleto lies within the shape, but the annals mention a duke of Spoleto in 799.

Approximate shape from Historical Basemaps; no boundary is attested in detail. The Royal Frankish Annals and Einhard call Alfonso king of Asturias and Galicia. The extent south of the mountains, including León, is not attested.

Approximate shape from Historical Basemaps; no boundary is attested in detail. The same realm as the main part in the north. The map depicts the area as Carolingian, but the sources do not resolve the matter. Einhard counts all of Italy down to Lower Calabria among Charles’s conquests, without years and without a boundary line in central Italy. The Royal Frankish Annals show Charles arranging the affairs of Rome and Italy in the winter of 800 to 801. Chieti, just east of the shape, was taken and burned in 801.

Approximate shape from Historical Basemaps; no boundary is attested in detail. Silla had conquered most of the Korean peninsula, while Parhae held the far north. The boundary between them is not attested. An unnamed shape overlaps this one.

Approximate shape from Historical Basemaps; no boundary is attested in detail. Tang endured and had capitals in Chang’an and Luoyang, but regions had gained autonomy after An Lushan and Tibet had taken western areas. The northern and southern parts of the shape, including Liaoyang and Hanoi, lack support.

Approximate shape from Historical Basemaps; no boundary is attested in detail. The originating source’s name is Lombard duchies, but the shape concerns Benevento. Einhard says that Duke Aragis submitted to Charles, while Frankish armies attacked Benevento in both 800 and 801. Einhard places the boundary between Beneventans and Greeks in Lower Calabria, without a year. Chieti, which lies within the shape, was taken and burned in 801. The degree of independence is therefore disputed, and the duke’s name in 800 is not given.
Ungefärlig ortsmarkör från Getty för Ang: Approximate place marker from Getty for Angkor Thom. The Getty Museum calls the site Jayavarman VII’s fortified capital, and the National Museum of Cambodia dates the enclosure to the late twelfth century. The marker does not indicate a palace building.
Ungefärlig ortsmarkör från Getty för Sil: Approximate place marker from Getty for Silla’s capital. The point lies within the approved game polygon. The marker does not indicate a palace building.
Ungefärlig ortsmarkör från Getty för dag: Approximate place marker from Getty for present-day Xi’an, with Chang’an as a name variant. The point lies within the approved game polygon. The marker does not indicate a palace building.

Approximate place marker from Getty for present-day Yinchuan. The connection to the historical capital Xingqing is uncertain information from the researcher’s reading of Shen; it could not be independently verified. The marker does not indicate a palace building.
Ungefärlig ortsmarkör från Getty för ett: Approximate place marker from Getty for an attested court seat. The Met also mentions the court in Seville. UNESCO calls Marrakech the capital during 1147–1269, while Archnet describes a move of the capital to Seville in 1170. The marker does not indicate a specific palace building.
Ungefärlig ortsmarkör från Getty, ingen: Approximate place marker from Getty, with no surveyed point for a particular palace.
Ungefärlig ortsmarkör från Getty. Met da: Approximate place marker from Getty. The Met dates the king’s permanent court in Paris to 1194. The marker does not indicate a specific palace building.
Ungefärlig ortsmarkör från Getty. Punkte: Approximate place marker from Getty. The point lies within the approved game polygon.
Ungefärlig ortsmarkör från Getty. Staden: Approximate place marker from Getty. The city belongs to the pope’s territory on the map. Charles’s realm has Aachen as its game seat, and the Papal States have Rome. Charles was here on the bookmark date. The title patricius gave way to the imperial title that day.
Ungefärlig ortsmarkör från Getty. Vald s: Approximate place marker from Getty. Selected as the game seat. Charles left Aachen in March 800 and returned during the year, but on the bookmark date he was in Rome.
Ungefärlig regional utbredning; västra g: Approximate regional extent; the western boundary is uncertain.
Ungefärlig spelform för det andinska rik: Approximate game shape for the Andean empire. The museum map supports the main extent before 1500. The southern tip of the shape extends south of the map’s Maule boundary. The conquest of the northern tip lacks a securely dated year before the start date. The sources distinguish permanent presence from contacts and disputed control. The southern tip reaches 37.283° S and the northern tip 0.863° N. The eastern edge across Bolivia and northwestern Argentina lacks an attested boundary line and uniform control.
Ungefärlig spelform. Källan beskriver tr: Approximate game shape. The source describes a tributary empire and self-governing subordinate cities. Tlaxcala was independent within the area of the shape. The western coastal tail through the Colima area and the exact northern edge lack supporting evidence here. The shape omits parts of the southeastern tributary sphere. The northern edge reaches 22.896° N. The shape ends in the southeast near 93.74° W and does not cover the source’s full extent towards the coast of Guatemala.
Ungefärligt födelseår; 1 januari är ett: Approximate birth year; 1 January is a game value.
Ungefärligt kärnområde kring Chan Chan;: Approximate core area around Chan Chan; no claim of maximum extent in 1200.
Universitetets forskningsrapport daterar: The university's research report dates Ceibal's public plaza to around 950 BC. The researchers' suggestion of cooperation between settled and mobile groups is an interpretation. Later monumental construction around 800 BC belongs to a different phase.
Universitetets föreläsningssammandrag be: The university lecture abstract describes kinship through both lines. It gives no codified order for 1200 and does not attest a council choosing on ability.
Universitetets historik anger 1218 för s: The university's history gives 1218 for the establishment of the schools. Later organisational rules and papal privileges are not counted as the same event.
Universitetets post och rubriken i det ö: The university entry and the translated decree's heading supply the year. The original formula uses the king's ninth year, Apellaios day seven and day seventeen of the first month of Peret. The university's March seven conversion is retained as source metadata; the event makes no exact modern-day claim. This dates the decision, not proof of sustained calendar use.
Universitetsutgåvan anger detta månadssp: The university edition supplies this month range for an incomplete charter dated Shaka 1280, Shrawana. The year is explicit, but no exact modern day is assigned. The charter records regulations and privileges, not proof that every provision was uniformly enforced.
Untash-Napirisha bygger zigguratkomplexe: Untash-Napirisha builds the ziggurat complex at Chogha Zanbil
Uppgiften gäller kanon III i utgåvans av: The claim concerns Canon III in the edition’s section for the council of 381. Later additions discussed in the same edition are not included.
Uppgifterna gäller breda rekonstruktione: The information concerns broad reconstructions of Chimú traditions. The sources attest no named religious leader, fixed organisation or particular ruler’s religious practice in 1200.
Upprepat husbyggande och ackumulerat avf: Repeated house construction and accumulated refuse build up large settlement mounds in Orkney. Bayliss and colleagues identify this development at sites including Stonehall on Mainland and Pool on Sanday.
Upproret börjar i Kyrene och våldet spri: The revolt begins in Cyrene and violence spreads to Egypt and Cyprus.
Upproret följs av en lång period av inbö: The uprising is followed by a long period of civil war.
Upprorsmän bryter det ptolemaiska styret: Rebels break Ptolemaic rule in parts of Upper Egypt. Herwennefer and Ankhwennefer emerge as local rulers during the prolonged conflict.
Uppslagsverket anger cirka 1491. Första: The reference work gives circa 1491. The first of January is a game marker. Sarmiento gives an age of 40 at death in 1533; no independent recalculation or exact birthday is introduced.
Uppslagsverket anger den 1 augusti 988 f: The encyclopedia gives 1 August 988 for the townspeople's baptism but does not explain the calendar. The event therefore gives only the year, without a converted day.
Ur, nuvarande Irak (fyndplats; tillverkn: Ur, present-day Iraq (findspot; place of manufacture unknown)
Ur-Ninurta av Isin återtar Nippur från G: Ur-Ninurta of Isin recovers Nippur from Gungunum. He accompanies the recovery with tax exemptions and the remission of debts.
Ur-Ninurta återtar Nippur och efterskänk: Ur-Ninurta recovers Nippur and remits debts
Urban II uppmanar till ett korståg: Urban II calls for a crusade
Urban återger i sitt brev från december: In his letter of December 1095, Urban reports that he has urged the participants at the church council in Auvergne to undertake the enterprise. No exact day for the speech is given here.
Uri, Schwyz och Nidwalden sluter ett för: Uri, Schwyz and Nidwalden form an alliance
Uruk domineras av stora monumentalbyggna: Uruk is dominated by large monumental buildings
Urukagina kungör reformer i en inskrift: Urukagina announces reforms in an inscription
Urukagina låter nedteckna reformer i Lag: Urukagina has reforms recorded in Lagash. The texts promise measures including debt cancellation and protection for widows and orphans. Archival documents support the removal of maškim officials from duties in collecting debts and penalties.
Urukbosättningarna i Habuba Kabira, Shei: The Uruk settlements at Habuba Kabira, Sheikh Hassan and Jebel Aruda are abandoned. This marks a regional contraction of Uruk settlement, while communities continue elsewhere in northern Mesopotamia and in the southern Uruk cities. A climatic cause is not established.
Urukbosättningarna vid mellersta Eufrat: Uruk settlements on the Middle Euphrates come to an end
Uruks stadskultur under sent fjärde årtu: Uruk urban culture in the late fourth millennium BC
Urvalet omfattar den belagda sonen Li So: The selection includes the attested son Li Song and makes no claim to cover the whole family. The sources do not place the emperor at a specific location on 25 December 800.
Urvalet omfattar kejsaren och hans belag: The selection includes the emperor and his attested mother. The sources give no complete family or whereabouts on the bookmark date.
Urvalet återger latinska personnamn ur S: The selection reproduces Latin personal names from the Saint-Germain-des-Prés inventory, whose compilation is dated to 823–829, with a separate scholarly alternative of 823–828. These years refer to the compilation; in any future generation, only the name form may be reused, without a surname or the identity of the attested person, and evidence for the year 800 is lacking.
Utbildningsministeriets ordbok anger Qin: The Ministry of Education's dictionary gives the Qingli period, 1041–1048, without a single year of invention.
Utbrottet förstör Pompeji, Herculaneum o: The eruption destroys Pompeii, Herculaneum and Stabiae.
Utbyggnader av den kinesiska muren inled: Expansions of the Great Wall of China begin in 1474. The work is linked to Mongol incursions into northern China.
Utdraget beskriver förhandlingar från de: The excerpt describes negotiations from 23 October and entry into the city afterwards. The event is dated here to the year, without assigning the entry a day that the excerpt does not give.
Utgivaren daterar brevgruppen ungefär ti: The editor dates the group of letters to approximately 313–314 and notes debate over the dating. The surviving letter does not show that its recipient received it.
Utgivarna anger ungefär 1281 e.Kr. för i: The editors give approximately AD 1281 for the inscription's Saka 1203 date. The event concerns the recorded installation, not the start of temple construction. Chekachai Khan's identification with Kublai remains tentative and is not required for this account.
Utgrävningsprojektet placerar Khasekhemw: The excavation project places Khasekhemwy's enclosure approximately at this date. The two accounts come from the same project and do not establish an exact building year or an independent chronology.
Utgrävningsrapporten anger omkring 2700: The excavation report gives around 2700 BC for the abandonment and interprets the cause as an earthquake. The statement establishes no individual day or exact disaster year.
Utgåvan daterar Gregorius brev till omkr: The edition dates Gregory's letter to around 28 January 1077. The letter describes the recently granted absolution but gives no separate month or day for it.
Utriggare förbinder Indonesien med Östaf: Outrigger boats connect Indonesia with East Africa
The exhibition dates the battle to 1014. The oldest accounts establish no exact location; the location near Dublin rests on later testimony.
Utuhegal, kung av Uruk, besegrar gutiern: Utuhegal, king of Uruk, defeats the Gutians and their commander Tirigan. The victory restores Sumerian kingship to Uruk for a brief period.
Vallat daterar erövringen till 2004 f.Kr: Vallat dates the conquest to 2004 BC. Garcia-Ventura gives both 2004 and 2003 BC as end years for the Third Dynasty of Ur and describes the absolute chronology as debated. The interval concerns alternative years for the end of the realm.
Vallat places Shulgi in 2094–2047 BC; Sazonov gives 2093–2046 BC. These chronological frameworks concern the reign and establish no individual year for the conquest or a campaign lasting several years.
Vandalerna, ett germanskt folk, går över: The Vandals, a Germanic people, cross from Spain and invade North Africa. Their conquest is swift and brutal, and they make Carthage their capital. Once order returns, they keep Roman customs: they write Latin, live in Roman-style villas and restore baths, theatres and churches.
Vela skriver Ahuítzotl; Met skriver Ahui: Vela writes Ahuítzotl; the Met writes Ahuitzotl. No consulted source gives a dated wife or a complete household for the bookmark. Vela recounts different explanations for the death and different datings around the aqueduct; no such episode receives an exact game date.
Verkstäder i Qantir framställer glas ur: Workshops at Qantir make glass from raw materials and prepare coloured ingots. These stages are distinguished from the work of shaping finished objects in other workshops. The excavated production debris reveals specialized craft activity; the detailed reconstruction of its processes remains an archaeological interpretation.
Vespasianus blir segrare och grundar den: Vespasian emerges victorious and founds the Flavian dynasty.
Vid Hallur framträder ett skede med drej: At Hallur, a phase emerges with wheel-thrown black-and-red pottery and a small number of iron finds. The settlement shows continuity from earlier phases into the Iron Age.
Vid Nag el-Hamdulab norr om Assuan avbil: At Nag el-Hamdulab north of Aswan, carvers depict a ruler wearing the White Crown. The images are among early depictions of Egyptian kingship.
Vid Ru Diep i norra delen av centrala Vi: At Ru Diep in the northern part of central Vietnam, people leave shell-rich layers. Radiocarbon dating suggests that the surviving layers were deposited within the outer limits of 3200–2900 BC (calibrated); the Bayesian analysis indicates a probable accumulation in less than 50 years.
Vid Stenness på Orkney finns en oval ste: At Stenness on Orkney, an oval stone ring stands within an encircling ditch. Historic Environment Scotland dates the monument to around 3100–2900 BC, while ScARF dates the henge to 3100–2650 BC. The datings are based on bones from the ditch; ScARF specifies animal bones on the ditch bottom. They establish no certain construction year for the stone ring. Its function is uncertain, but a ceremonial role has been proposed.
Vid Teouma på Efate i Vanuatu behandlar: At Teouma on Efate in Vanuatu, people treat their dead through funerary sequences involving several stages. The researchers interpret the finds as examples of how survivors may value human remains even during earlier stages of such sequences.
Vid Zürichsjön bygger människor en bosät: At Lake Zurich, people build a settlement on the site of today's Parkhaus Opéra. In the oldest phase examined, archaeologists have distinguished 15 rectangular buildings. Tree rings date the phase to 3234–3226 BC.
Vid kejsar Zhaos hov möts ämbetsmän och: Officials and Confucian critics meet at Emperor Zhao's court to debate state economic policy. Their discussion includes the salt and iron monopolies and the costs of war.
Vid nuvarande Battle, nära Hastings, Eng: At present-day Battle, near Hastings, England
Vid omkring denna tid är Uruk den störst: At around this time, Uruk is the largest settlement in southern Mesopotamia. The city is dominated by large mud-brick buildings decorated with mosaics of painted clay cones.
Vijayalaya bygger upp Cholaättens rike: Vijayalaya builds the Chola dynasty's kingdom
Vijayalaya inleder sitt styre omkring 85: Vijayalaya begins his reign around 850 and acknowledges the overlordship of the Pallava rulers. He builds his kingdom around Uraiyur and Tanjore in the lower Kaveri Valley.
Vijayanagara vid Hampi, nuvarande Karnat: Vijayanagara at Hampi, present-day Karnataka in India
Vikingar anfaller klostret på Lindisfarn: Vikings attack the monastery on Lindisfarne on 8 June 793. Alcuin, at Charlemagne's court, writes about the attack to the king of Northumbria and the island's bishop.
Vilhelm I skickar ombud till lokala doms: William I sends commissioners to local courts in England in 1086 to investigate land, property and the tax base. They ask who holds the land, what it is worth and how conditions have changed since before the Conquest. Scribes collect the information in the Domesday records.
Vilhelm av Normandies här besegrar kung: William of Normandy's army defeats King Harold's English army at Hastings on 14 October 1066. Harold dies during the fighting and his men flee.
Vilhelm av Rubruck reser till mongolerna: William of Rubruck travels to the Mongol court
Vilhelm den fromme grundar klostret i Cl: William the Pious founds the monastery at Cluny
Vilhelm den fromme skänker sin egendom i: William the Pious donates his estate at Cluny to a monastery. The monks are to follow the Rule of Benedict, with Berno as the first abbot. The sources give 909 or 910 for the monastery's foundation.
Vinelz–Strandboden vid Bielsjön och Tres: Vinelz–Strandboden on Lake Biel and the Three Lakes region, present-day Switzerland
Vishnuvardhana bygger templet i Belur: Vishnuvardhana builds the temple at Belur
Vishvambhara invigs till asket av Keshav: Vishvambhara is initiated as an ascetic by Keshava Bharati in Katwa in 1510. He assumes the religious name Krishna Chaitanya.
Visiren Amenemhat leder en expedition ti: The vizier Amenemhat leads an expedition to Wadi Hammamat
The vizier Amenemhat leads an expedition to Wadi Hammamat to obtain stone for Mentuhotep IV’s sarcophagus. The participants leave rock inscriptions describing the mission.
Vulkanutbrott 536 och 540 inleder en kal: Volcanic eruptions in 536 and 540 trigger a cold period in the Northern Hemisphere. Studies of southern Norway show that the effects on cultivation and settlement vary between areas.
Väljarna vid kyrkomötet i Konstanz utser: The electors at the Council of Constance choose Oddone Colonna as pope on 11 November 1417. He takes the name Martin V and is crowned later that month.
Västjava, nuvarande Indonesien; exakt pr: West Java, present-day Indonesia; precise provenance uncertain
Västra Iran, med anknytning till Khwaraz: Western Iran, with connections to Khwarazm
Västrongstyrkor intar Zhouhuvudstäderna: Western Rong forces capture the Zhou capitals and kill King You
Våld driver judiska invånare från deras: Violence drives Jewish residents from their homes in Alexandria, accompanied by looting and killings. Philo links the persecution to the prefect Flaccus's declaration that Jews were foreigners and to the removal of their rights.
Wa i den japanska övärlden och Wei i Kin: Wa in the Japanese archipelago and Wei in China
Wagner anger 117 f.Kr. för monopolets in: Wagner dates establishment of the monopoly to 117 BC and distinguishes it from earlier preparatory appointments.
Wang Anshis reformkrets föreslår statlig: Wang Anshi's reform circle proposes state crop loans
Wang Anshis reformkrets lägger fram ett: Wang Anshi's reform circle puts forward a proposal for loans to farmers before the harvest. Farmers are to be able to repay in grain or money along with their taxes and receive a deferment after crop failure.
Wang Geon enar de senare tre rikena: Wang Geon unifies the Later Three Kingdoms
Wang Geon fullbordar enandet av de senar: Wang Geon completes the unification of the Later Three Kingdoms in 936. He has tied regional elites to Goryeo and pursued a policy that favours Silla and opposes Later Baekje.
Wang Geon grundar Goryeo år 918. Han kom: Wang Geon founds Goryeo in 918. He comes from the local elite of Gaeseong, at a time when rival rulers divide the Korean Peninsula.
Wang Mang’s reign succeeds the Western Han.
Wang Yangming får enligt den biografiska: According to the biographical account, Wang Yangming gains a philosophical insight during his exile in 1508. He begins seeking moral insight within the human mind itself.
Wang Yangmings filosofiska genombrott da: Wang Yangming's philosophical breakthrough is dated to 1508
Wang Zhen daterar sitt förord till Nongs: Wang Zhen dates his preface to the Nongshu
Wang Zhens eget förord till jordbruksver: Wang Zhen's own preface to the agricultural work Nongshu is dated 1313. The work collects and develops knowledge of agricultural technology.
Waugh anger 1395–6. Posten daterar fältt: Waugh gives 1395–6. The entry dates the campaign's devastation and establishes no single end year for the entire Golden Horde.
Waxaklahun Ubah K'awil låter bygga tempe: Waxaklahun Ubah K'awil commissions Temple 22 in Copán
William Wallace och Andrew Moray leder s: William Wallace and Andrew Moray lead the Scots to victory at Stirling Bridge. They attack when part of the English army has crossed the River Forth.
Wu sänder Zhu Ying och Kang Tai till Fun: Wu sends Zhu Ying and Kang Tai to Funan
Wuzong förbjuder metall i buddhistiska b: Wuzong bans metal in Buddhist images
Xerxes mördas och Artaxerxes I tar makte: Xerxes is murdered and Artaxerxes I takes power
Xinzhai-fasen: cirka 1850–1750 f.Kr.; äl: Xinzhai phase: c. 1850–1750 BC; an older model has wider bounds
Xiongnu bygger ut sitt stäppförbund: The Xiongnu expand their steppe confederation
Xiping-klassikerna i sten förbereds i Lu: The Xiping Stone Classics are prepared in Luoyang
Xu, nära nuvarande Xuchang i Henan, Kina: Xu, near present-day Xuchang in Henan, China
Yale/Walters-katalogens bildtext daterar: The Yale/Walters catalogue’s caption dates the expedition to 1470 BC. The Warsaw archaeological expedition gives Thutmose III’s regnal year 9. No independent conversion is made. Punt’s exact location is uncertain.
Yales utgrävare placerar övergången inom: Yale's excavators place the transition within this interval. It continues beyond the end of the batch and gives no single year for the creation of the courtyards.
Yang Jian enar Kina under Suidynastin: Yang Jian unites China under the Sui dynasty
Yang Jian tar makten i norra Kina 581. S: Yang Jian takes power in northern China in 581. By 589, he has united China under the Sui dynasty.
Yang anger två möjliga avreseår och åter: Yang gives two possible departure years and a return in 126 BC. The full span of the journey is retained.
Yaqub al-Mansur besegrar Alfonso VIII vi: Yaqub al-Mansur defeats Alfonso VIII at Alarcos
Yaqub ibn Layth belägrar och intar Herat: Yaqub ibn Layth besieges and captures Herat on 16 August 867. He had begun raiding the city in 862.
Yaqub ibn Layth inleder sitt styre år 86: Yaqub ibn Layth begins his reign in 861 according to Iranica's chronology. He becomes the first Saffarid ruler, with Sistan as his power base.
Yaqub inleder saffaridernas styre i Sist: Yaqub begins Saffarid rule in Sistan
Yasovarman I låter uppföra eller slutför: Yasovarman I has Lolei built or completed
Yax Nuun Ayiin I tillträder i Tikal: Yax Nuun Ayiin I accedes at Tikal
Yax Nuun Ayiin I tillträder som kung i T: Yax Nuun Ayiin I becomes king at Tikal. Mesoweb attributes a role in his installation to Siyaj K’ak’.
Yax Pasah tillträder som härskare i Copá: Yax Pasah becomes ruler of Copán
Yax Pasah becomes ruler of Copán. The city's artists later depict his accession on Altar Q through a meeting with the dynasty's founder.
Yax Pasaj beställer Altar Q i Copán: Yax Pasaj commissions Altar Q in Copán
